The 256 sqm 4-Bedroom + DSQ Apartment

  • Master bedroom with a walk-in wardrobe and contemporary en-suite bathroom
  • Three further en-suite bedrooms, usable as family rooms, guest rooms or a home office
  • Dedicated domestic staff quarter (DSQ) with its own separate access
  • Open-plan living and dining area leading to a private terrace
  • Fully fitted kitchen with cabinetry and extended countertops

Verified Amenities

  • Jogging track within the compound
  • Residents clubhouse and lounge
  • Indoor and outdoor children play areas
  • Five levels of access-controlled parking
  • Full backup generator serving apartments and common areas
  • Borehole water supply
  • Multiple high-speed lifts serving all 25 floors

Location and Connectivity

The building sits on Kilungu Road, off Argwings Kodhek Road in Kilimani. The drive times below are the indicative figures published for this development and will vary with traffic.

  • Cavina School – 1 min; Riara Group of Schools – 3 mins; Makini and Braeburn Schools – 7 mins

listings.content_html:
Two-bedroom apartments at Golden Mansion come in two sizes on Muthithi Road, Westlands, Nairobi: 107.57 sqm (1,158 sqft) from KES 13,302,026, and 115.7 sqm (1,245 sqft), with three washrooms and two balconies, from KES 12,610,888. Each has an en-suite master bedroom, a second bedroom, properly scaled living and dining areas and a fitted kitchen, in a 30-storey tower crowned by a heated rooftop swimming pool. Completion is scheduled for April 2028.

Listing updated: 11 October 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Unit at a Glance

Part of Golden Mansion, Muthithi Road, Westlands — see the full development page for the complete overview.

Inside the 2 Bedroom

At 107.57 sqm, the Type A3 two-bedroom has the kind of footprint that makes daily life comfortable, and the larger Type A4 adds a third washroom and a second balcony, at 115.7 sqm (1,245 sqft). The living and dining areas are scaled for family life and for having people over, the master bedroom is en-suite, and the fitted kitchen is built for everyday cooking. The size places this apartment in the upper tier of Westlands two-bedrooms — the sort of space that, in neighbouring developments, often carries a higher price.

Lifted above the five-storey podium base, the home benefits from better light, more privacy and less street noise, with a private balcony to enjoy the outlook.

Guide prices: from KES 13,302,026 for the 107.57 sqm type and KES 12,610,888 for the 115.7 sqm type. These are the lowest floors available on the developer’s price list of 1 September 2026; the larger type starts lower only because cheaper floors remain in it, and prices rise with the floor to about KES 17.11M and KES 18.78M respectively. Please request the latest price list to confirm current figures and availability.

Amenities

Residents at Golden Mansion share a full amenity package:

  • Heated rooftop swimming pool, stated by the developer as the highest residential pool in Nairobi, with panoramic city views
  • Fully equipped gymnasium
  • Hotel-style ground-floor lobby
  • Five-storey podium parking
  • Mini mart within the building
  • Children’s play area and landscaped green spaces
  • 24-hour security with CCTV and controlled access
  • Full backup generator

Location Advantage

  • Moments from Sarit Centre and Westgate Mall for shopping, dining and services
  • Close to the GTC office district, home to corporates, international organisations and diplomatic missions
  • Minutes from Waiyaki Way and the Nairobi Expressway, connecting to the CBD and JKIA
  • Short drives to Upper Hill, Kilimani, Lavington and Parklands
  • A central, well-connected position in the heart of Westlands

Payment Plan

  • Flexible off-plan instalments, spread across construction to the April 2028 completion
  • Secure the home at today’s launch pricing and pay progressively as the building rises

Please request the detailed payment schedule for the two bedroom.

Why It Works for Homeowners

For a couple or a family, this is a genuinely comfortable home in a central location. The generous footprint gives everyone room, the en-suite master adds privacy, and the shared amenities — rooftop pool, gym, hotel-style lobby — make the building a pleasant place to come home to. With Sarit, Westgate and the GTC district on your doorstep, the everyday runs smoothly.

Why It Works for Investors

The case rests on location and scarcity. Muthithi Road sits in the commercial core of Westlands, surrounded by the GTC office district, Sarit and Westgate, and the corporate and diplomatic community that clusters here — an established, high-demand setting for quality two-bedroom homes. Generously sized, well-specified apartments of this kind are not added to the Westlands market quickly, and the building’s most distinctive homes — the loft residences on floors 28 and 29, with 5.4-metre ceilings — are all listed as sold out across every loft type. As always, we would encourage independent due diligence and a review of the price list, payment schedule and title before committing.

Finishes and Specifications

  • Bosch kitchen appliances (hob, hood and oven)
  • Imported finishes throughout
  • Ceramic flooring
  • European-standard bathrooms
  • Built-in wardrobes
  • Private balcony

For the full finishes schedule and floor plan, please request the latest brochure.

Who This Unit Suits Best

  • Couples and small families who want genuine space in a central Westlands tower
  • Buyers upsizing from a one-bedroom without leaving the neighbourhood
  • Diaspora buyers wanting a substantial, well-located home that can be secured remotely

Frequently Asked Questions

How much is the 2 bedroom apartment at Golden Mansion?

On the developer’s price list of 1 September 2026, the 107.57 sqm (1,158 sqft) two-bedroom starts at KES 13,302,026 and the larger 115.7 sqm (1,245 sqft) two-bedroom, with three washrooms and two balconies, at KES 12,610,888, rising with the floor to about KES 17.11M and KES 18.78M. Request the current price list from Block Real Estate to confirm the figure and availability on your preferred floor.

How big is the 2 bedroom and what does it include?

It comes in two sizes. The 107.57 sqm (1,158 sqft) type has an en-suite master bedroom, a second bedroom, properly scaled living and dining areas, a fitted kitchen and a private balcony, and the 115.7 sqm (1,245 sqft) type adds a third washroom and a second balcony. Bosch kitchen appliances, imported finishes and ceramic flooring are standard.

What is the payment plan for the 2 bedroom?

Golden Mansion is sold on a flexible off-plan instalment plan that spreads payments across the construction period through to the April 2028 completion. Request the detailed schedule for the two bedroom.

When will the apartment be completed?

Completion is scheduled for April 2028. Golden Mansion is an off-plan tower still under construction, so ask Block Real Estate for written confirmation of the current construction programme before you commit.

Are the Golden Mansion loft residences still available?

No. The loft residences on floors 28 and 29, which have 5.4-metre ceilings, are all listed as sold out across the 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom and 3 bedroom duplex loft types. This listing is for the standard two-bedroom apartments of 107.57 and 115.7 sqm, which are available.

Can I buy the 2 bedroom with a mortgage?

Yes. Block Real Estate works with a range of mortgage partners, including Absa, Stanbic, NCBA, KCB, HFC, Standard Chartered and Prime Bank, and can point you towards the right financing conversation.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. A valid passport or Alien ID is enough to get started and Block Real Estate can assist with obtaining your KRA PIN. Stamp duty is 4 per cent of the value. Virtual viewings, the brochure, floor plans and the payment schedule are all handled remotely.

What parking and amenities come with the apartment?

Parking is provided in the building’s dedicated 5-storey podium structure. Residents share the heated rooftop swimming pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, a hotel-style lobby, a mini mart, a children’s play area, landscaped green spaces, 24-hour security with CCTV and a full backup generator.

listings.content_html:
Golden Mansion is a 30-storey residential tower on Muthithi Road, Westlands, crowned by a heated rooftop swimming pool that the developer says will be the highest in Nairobi. It offers studios of 41.22 sqm from KES 6.18M, one-bedrooms of 64.4 and 78.46 sqm from KES 8.24M, and two-bedrooms of 107.57 and 115.7 sqm from KES 12.61M, with completion expected on 30 April 2028.

Homes come with Bosch kitchen appliances and imported finishes, and the tower rises from a five-storey podium of parking, so even the lower floors sit above the street. Sarit Centre and Westgate are both about a kilometre away, and buyers reserve with KES 200,000, pay a 20% deposit and spread the balance while the tower is built.

Golden Mansion at a Glance

Golden Mansion Prices by Unit Type

Starting prices from the developer’s price list of 1 September 2026. Prices rise with the floor, so ask Block Real Estate for the current list and the floors still available before you book.

On the upper floors, studios run to about KES 7.78M, the 64.4 sqm one-bedroom to KES 10.07M, the 78.46 sqm one-bedroom to KES 11.85M, the 107.57 sqm two-bedroom to KES 17.11M and the 115.7 sqm two-bedroom to KES 18.78M. The larger two-bedroom starts below the smaller one only because cheaper floors remain available in that type.

The Homes at Golden Mansion

Golden Mansion runs from compact studios to generous two-bedrooms, with one- and two-bedrooms each offered in two sizes and the same imported specification throughout.

Studio, 41.22 sqm

The most compact way into the tower: an open-plan studio of 41.22 sqm with the same Bosch kitchen and imported finishes, and access to the rooftop pool and gym, from KES 6,180,527.

1 Bedroom, 64.4 sqm

A well-proportioned home with open-plan living and kitchen, a proper bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a modern bathroom, from KES 8,243,920. At 64.4 sqm it is a liveable one-bedroom rather than a studio with a partition. See the 1 bedroom apartments.

1 Bedroom, 78.46 sqm

The larger one-bedroom adds about 14 sqm over the standard layout, for a roomier home from KES 9,574,045.

2 Bedroom, 107.57 sqm

Over 107 sqm with an en-suite master bedroom, living and dining areas scaled for family life and entertaining, and a fitted kitchen built for daily use, from KES 13,302,026. See the 2 bedroom apartments.

2 Bedroom, 115.7 sqm

The larger two-bedroom adds a third washroom and a second balcony, at 115.7 sqm, from KES 12,610,888 on the lower floors available.

The lofts on the top floors

The tower’s most distinctive homes are the loft residences on the top floors, with 5.4-metre double-height ceilings, from one-bedroom lofts of 66.87 sqm to three-bedroom duplex lofts of about 155 sqm. They were listed as sold out, so ask us whether any have been released.

Architecture: 30 Floors Above Westlands

At 30 storeys, Golden Mansion is among the taller residential towers in Westlands. Upper-floor homes look across Westlands towards the Ngong Hills, the Karura Forest canopy and the CBD skyline, and the five-storey podium lifts every residential floor above street level, for better light, more privacy and less street noise.

Finishes and Specifications

  • Bosch kitchen appliances: hob, hood and oven as standard
  • Imported finishes: materials sourced to international standards rather than builder-grade equivalents
  • Ceramic flooring: durable and easy to maintain
  • European-standard bathrooms: imported sanitary ware, fittings and fixtures
  • Built-in wardrobes: storage without losing floor space
  • Balconies: private outdoor space, with two balconies in the larger two-bedroom

Amenities at Golden Mansion

The amenities are built around convenience, wellness and security, with the heated rooftop pool as the centrepiece and everyday needs met inside the building.

Pool, fitness and outdoor

  • Heated rooftop swimming pool
  • Fully equipped gym
  • Landscaped green spaces
  • Children’s play area

Building and services

  • Hotel-style lobby
  • High-speed lifts
  • Mini mart in the building
  • Five levels of podium parking
  • 24-hour security with CCTV and controlled access
  • Full backup generator

Location: Muthithi Road, Westlands

Golden Mansion is on Muthithi Road in the commercial and lifestyle core of Westlands, within walking distance of Sarit Centre, Westgate and MP Shah Hospital, with Waiyaki Way and the Nairobi Expressway a short drive away.

  • Westlands centre: about 600 m
  • MP Shah Hospital: about 700 m
  • Sarit Centre: about 800 m
  • Westgate Mall: about 1 km
  • Aga Khan University Hospital: about 2 km
  • Nairobi CBD: about 3.2 km
  • UN offices, Gigiri: about 3.7 km
  • The Village Market: about 4 km
  • Upper Hill: about 4 km
  • International School of Kenya: about 6 km
  • JKIA: about 15 km

Straight-line distances from the site; road distances are longer and travel times vary with Westlands traffic.

Payment Plan

Golden Mansion is sold off plan: reserve a unit with KES 200,000, pay a 20% deposit when you sign, then spread the balance across the construction period, so you secure today’s price and pay as the tower rises.

  • Reservation: KES 200,000 to reserve your unit
  • Deposit: 20% on signing the sale agreement
  • Balance: instalments over the construction period
  • Completion: expected on 30 April 2028

Ask Block Real Estate for the full instalment schedule for the apartment you are considering.

Why Golden Mansion?

  • A 30-storey tower on Muthithi Road, about a kilometre from Sarit Centre and Westgate
  • A heated rooftop pool that the developer says will be Nairobi’s highest
  • Studios from KES 6.18M, one-bedrooms from KES 8.24M and two-bedrooms from KES 12.61M
  • One- and two-bedrooms in two sizes each, the larger two-bedroom with three washrooms
  • Bosch kitchens, imported finishes and European-standard bathrooms
  • A hotel-style lobby, gym, mini mart and five levels of podium parking

Golden Mansion for Investors

Golden Mansion’s case is height and specification in central Westlands: a 30-storey tower with a heated rooftop pool, Bosch kitchens and a hotel-style lobby, about a kilometre from Sarit Centre and Westgate. In our view, quality one-bedrooms in Westlands towers let for about KES 55,000 to 85,000 a month and two-bedrooms for KES 100,000 to 160,000, so at an illustrative KES 65,000 a month a one-bedroom bought at KES 8.24M would gross about 9.5% a year before costs. As an off-plan purchase completing in April 2028, weigh the developer’s record and the construction programme, and treat rents and resale values as unguaranteed.

After management, maintenance and vacancy, that illustration nets closer to 7%, and it depends on the rent and occupancy you achieve at handover. Ask us for current Westlands comparables before you commit.

Who Golden Mansion Suits Best

  • Investors who want a central Westlands studio or one-bedroom in a high-specification tower
  • Diaspora buyers building a Nairobi portfolio, with the purchase handled remotely
  • Young professionals working in Westlands, Parklands or along the UN corridor
  • Couples and small families who want a two-bedroom of up to 115.7 sqm with a pool and play area in the building

It suits less well buyers who need to move in before mid-2028, anyone who wants a standalone home with a garden, and buyers looking for a quiet low-rise setting.

Due Diligence

Block Real Estate has reviewed the Golden Mansion offering documentation. Have your own advocate review the sale agreement and title documents before you sign; Block Real Estate can introduce you to qualified property lawyers.

How much is an apartment at Golden Mansion?

On the developer’s price list of 1 September 2026, 41.22 sqm studios start at KES 6,180,527, the 64.4 sqm one-bedroom at KES 8,243,920, the larger 78.46 sqm one-bedroom at KES 9,574,045, the 107.57 sqm two-bedroom at KES 13,302,026 and the larger 115.7 sqm two-bedroom at KES 12,610,888. What is the difference between the two 1-bedroom and the two 2-bedroom types?

The Type A2 one-bedroom is 64.4 sqm and the Type A1 is 78.46 sqm. The Type A3 two-bedroom is 107.57 sqm, and the Type A4 two-bedroom is 115.7 sqm with three washrooms and two balconies.

Are the Golden Mansion loft residences still available?

The loft residences on the top floors, with 5.4-metre double-height ceilings, run from one-bedroom lofts of 66.87 sqm to three-bedroom duplex lofts of about 155 sqm. They were listed as sold out, so ask Block Real Estate whether any have been released.

Does Golden Mansion really have Nairobi’s highest rooftop pool?

listings.content_html:
Pandora Residences is a 2, 3 and 4 bedroom apartment development by A1 Corporation on Muthangari Drive, Nairobi, opposite The Address offices. Prices start at KES 12.91 million for a 2 bedroom of 85 sqm, rising to 199.56 sqm four bedrooms. Completion is December 2028, with a 1.7-acre retail boulevard on site.

Listing updated: 23 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

About Pandora Residences

Pandora Residences, marketed by the developer as A1 Pandora, is a residential development by A1 Corporation on Muthangari Drive, directly opposite The Address offices. The scheme combines apartments with a 1.7-acre retail boulevard and a 3,000 sqm central garden, so a good deal of the ground plane is given over to shared space rather than parking and driveways.

Four layouts are offered: a 2 bedroom, a 2 bedroom with study, a 3 bedroom with study and DSQ, and a 4 bedroom with DSQ. Apartments are specified with double-height ceilings, floor-to-ceiling glazing and smart home controls for lighting and climate. The 2 bedroom units are described with built-in appliances and marble feature walls; the 4 bedroom units with violet marble finishes.

This is an off-plan purchase. Handover is given as December 2028, so everything on this page is the specification and price list as published for the current release, and not a description of a completed building.

Price List by Unit Type

Prices below are the developer figures published for this release. Ranges reflect floor level and layout. Please confirm the current price list with us before you reserve, as off-plan price lists are revised between phases.

Square-foot figures are converted from the developer sqm areas at 10.7639 sq ft per sqm and rounded. Bathroom counts per unit type are not published; we confirm them against the current floor plans on enquiry.

Payment Plan and Off-Plan Risk

  • Deposit: 20% of the purchase price on booking.
  • Balance: spread in instalments until completion. The instalment schedule is set out in the sale agreement.
  • Handover: December 2028.

December 2028 is more than two years out from the date of this listing. That is a long exposure, and it is worth being plain about what it means. You will be paying towards a building that does not yet exist, against a date that the developer sets and can revise. Off-plan handover dates in Nairobi commonly move.

Before you commit, we would ask your advocate to check the title and the approved development plans, to confirm the developer track record, and to establish what the sale agreement says about delay: whether there is a grace period, what compensation applies if the date passes, and what your exit is if it passes by a wide margin. Pay only into the account named in the sale agreement, and try to tie instalments to construction milestones rather than to calendar dates alone.

The Investment Case

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that entry is KES 12,910,000 for an 85 sqm 2 bedroom on Muthangari Drive, the payment plan starts at a 20% deposit with the balance spread to a December 2028 handover, and the scheme is by A1 Corporation with a 1.7-acre retail boulevard and a 3,000 sqm garden inside the site. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building’s management rules and on applicable regulations — worth confirming before you buy.

Verified Amenities

Everything listed here is drawn from the developer material for Pandora Residences. As with any off-plan scheme, the amenity schedule can be varied during construction, so confirm the final list in the sale agreement.

  • 1.7-acre retail boulevard within the development, described as a landscaped retail street rather than a conventional mall frontage.
  • 3,000 sqm central garden.
  • Heated indoor and outdoor swimming pools.
  • Spa with saunas and massage rooms.
  • 400 sqm fitness centre, yoga studio and meditation zone, and a running track within the complex.
  • Cinema lounge (the Pandora Theatre), a reading lounge and book bar, a recreation club and coffee bar, and a residents’ restaurant and café.
  • Kids’ facilities: the Little Explorers Room plus indoor and outdoor playgrounds.
  • Co-working spaces and meeting rooms.
  • Services: full backup generator, borehole water with purifier, 24-hour security, CCTV and a concierge.

Location and Connectivity

Muthangari Drive runs through the Westlands and Lavington belt on the western side of Nairobi. The site is directly opposite The Address offices, and sits within reach of the Westlands, Lavington and Kilimani commercial areas.

We are not giving drive times for this listing. The developer material does not publish any, and Nairobi journey times on this side of town vary so widely between peak and off-peak that a single figure would mislead more than it helps. If timings to a specific school or office matter to your decision, tell us where and we will drive the route with you at the hour you would actually travel.

Compare Nearby

  • Verona Apartments, Muthangari Drive — studio to 3 bedroom apartments and Sky Villas from KES 6.7M, the closest direct comparison on the same road.
  • Verona Apartments 2 bedroom, Muthangari Drive — from KES 16M at 96 to 120 sqm.
  • Verona Apartments 3 bedroom, Muthangari Drive — from KES 31.5M at 205 to 210 sqm.
  • Lesto Residences, Ojijo Close, Westlands — 1 and 2 bedroom apartments from KES 6.9M, completion expected April 2027.
  • The Moment Residences, School Lane, Westlands — studio to 3 bedroom apartments from KES 5.55M.
  • Browse everything we have listed in the area: Westlands property.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Pandora Residences located?

Pandora Residences is on Muthangari Drive in Nairobi, directly opposite The Address offices, in the Westlands and Lavington belt.

How much do apartments at Pandora Residences cost?

Prices start at KES 12,910,000 for a 2 bedroom of 85 sqm and run to KES 34,520,000 for a 4 bedroom plus DSQ of 199.56 sqm. These are the figures published for this release, so confirm the current price list with us before you reserve.

What is the payment plan at Pandora Residences?

A 20% deposit is payable on booking and the balance is spread in instalments until completion. The exact instalment schedule is set out in the sale agreement, so read it with your advocate before you commit.

When will Pandora Residences be completed?

The developer gives handover as December 2028, which is more than two years away. Until then you are buying a plan and a payment schedule, not a finished home.

What happens if handover slips past December 2028?

Off-plan handover dates in Nairobi do move. Ask for the completion date, any grace period and any compensation for delay to be written into the sale agreement, and have your advocate confirm what remedy you have if the date passes.

What protections does an off-plan buyer have?

Ask to see the title, the approved development plans and the developer track record, pay only into the account named in the sale agreement, instruct your own advocate, and try to keep payments tied to construction milestones rather than dates alone.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. Non-residents can buy apartments in Kenya on leasehold terms. You will need a KRA PIN, identification documents and a Kenyan advocate, and payments should move through traceable banking channels. We can run the whole process remotely and send progress updates by email or WhatsApp.

Does Pandora Residences have a swimming pool?

Yes. The development is planned with heated indoor and outdoor swimming pools, alongside a spa with saunas and massage rooms, a 400 sqm fitness centre and a yoga studio.

listings.content_html:
CANTO — Where School Lane Meets the Nairobi Skyline

There’s a five-minute walk in Westlands that changes everything. It starts at your front door on School Lane and ends at Sarit Centre — Nairobi’s most established retail, dining, and lifestyle hub. Between that front door and those mall doors, you pass coffee shops, restaurants, offices, and the kind of everyday convenience that most Nairobi residents spend an hour in traffic trying to reach. At CANTO, you simply walk.

This is a 1-bedroom residence designed for the buyer who understands that in Westlands, the right address isn’t about square metres alone — it’s about what those square metres unlock. A walkable neighbourhood. A building that handles your gym, your workspace, your entertainment, and your rooftop pool. And a price point that makes premium Westlands living genuinely accessible.

Starting from USD 68,000. Completion November 2028. Parking included.

The 1-Bedroom Layout: Efficient by Design, Comfortable by Experience

CANTO’s 1-bedroom apartments measure 56–57 sqm gross (45–46 sqm net) — a footprint that’s been planned with the discipline of maximising every usable metre rather than inflating numbers with unusable corridor space.

The living and dining zone flows as a single, open-plan space — wide enough to furnish comfortably for daily life, work-from-home setups, or hosting a few friends without feeling cramped. The kitchen integrates into this flow with a clean, modern aesthetic that prioritises function: prep space, storage, and the kind of layout that makes cooking at home feel natural rather than inconvenient.

The bedroom is positioned for separation and quiet — set apart from the living area so that the apartment functions as a genuine 1-bedroom home rather than a studio with a partition wall. The bathroom is contemporary in finish and practical in layout, designed for the daily routines that matter more than show.

This is a home that furnishes well, photographs well for rental listings, and lives well on a Tuesday evening. It’s the kind of layout that appeals equally to an owner-occupier who values smart urban living and an investor who wants a unit that tenants immediately say yes to.

The Building: A Lifestyle Stack from Ground Floor to Rooftop

CANTO doesn’t ask you to choose between work, wellness, and downtime — it puts all three under one roof.

Ground Floor and Resident Spaces. A co-working space and coffee bar handle the mornings when you’d rather not commute. A residents’ lounge and outdoor sitting area give you a social space that isn’t your apartment. The management office is on-site — because responsive building management isn’t a luxury, it’s a baseline.

Entertainment and Recreation. An indoor cinema for evenings when you’d rather stay in than go out. Indoor games and a mini basketball court for the kind of active leisure that burns energy without requiring a drive. Rooftop mini golf and a BBQ lounge for weekend socialising with the Nairobi skyline as your backdrop.

Wellness. A fully equipped gym eliminates the external membership you’d otherwise need — and at Westlands gym prices, that saving adds up fast. Separate sauna and steam rooms for men and women provide the recovery and relaxation that a serious wellness routine demands.

The Rooftop. A heated swimming pool with a dedicated pool deck — the centrepiece amenity. Heated, because Nairobi’s evenings are cool enough to make an unheated rooftop pool a feature you admire but never use. CANTO’s pool is built to be used.

Prayer Area. A quiet, dedicated space within the building for residents who value this as part of their daily life.

School Lane, Westlands: The Address That Works Hardest

Location is the one thing about a property that can never be upgraded, renovated, or repositioned. CANTO’s location on School Lane in Westlands is the kind of address that does the heavy lifting for you — whether you’re living here or leasing.

Sarit Centre is a 5-minute walk. Not a 5-minute drive, not “5 minutes in light traffic.” A walk. Supermarkets, banks, restaurants, pharmacies, cinemas, fashion retail — the full spectrum of daily life, accessible on foot.

Westgate Mall and the broader Westlands commercial district are within immediate reach. GTC Mall, The Alchemist, Sankara, and the Westlands dining scene that has become Nairobi’s most diverse are all part of your neighbourhood.

For commuters, School Lane connects to Waiyaki Way, Ring Road Parklands, and the Nairobi Expressway — three arterial routes that link Westlands to the CBD, Kilimani, Upper Hill, and JKIA.

For investors, this connectivity translates directly into tenant demand. Westlands is Nairobi’s most sought-after address for corporate tenants, expatriates, and young professionals — the tenant profiles that pay premium rents, maintain properties well, and renew leases consistently.

The Investment Case

A 1-bedroom apartment in a quality Westlands development with this amenity package and this location rents for KES 55,000–85,000/month (approximately USD 420–650). Furnished and positioned for the corporate or short-stay market, the upper end of that range is realistic for a well-presented CANTO unit.

At a conservative USD 500/month (approx. KES 65,000):

  • Annual rental income: USD 6,000
  • Gross yield on USD 68,000 entry price: 8.8%
  • Net yield (after management, maintenance, vacancy): approximately 6.5–7%

The off-plan entry price is the key advantage. Buyers who secure a unit at USD 68,000 today are locking in a price that comparable completed developments in Westlands already exceed. By the November 2028 completion date, the combination of construction-phase appreciation and the premium that finished, occupied buildings command over off-plan pricing creates a meaningful capital gain before the first tenant even moves in.

Pricing and Payment

The 20% booking fee secures your unit. The remaining 80% can be structured as a lump sum or spread across monthly or milestone-based instalments over the construction period — up to 3 years. This flexibility makes CANTO accessible to buyers who prefer to pay progressively rather than commit the full amount upfront.

Reserve Your Unit

CANTO’s 1-bedroom apartments combine a walkable Westlands address, a comprehensive amenity package, and a sub-USD 70,000 entry price — a combination that won’t last once construction progresses and early-bird pricing adjusts.

listings.content_html:
Studio & 1 bedroom apartments for sale in Westlands don’t get more convenient than Canto. Set along School Lane in the heart of Westlands, Canto is a focused, investment-friendly tower of studios and 1-bedroom apartments within walking distance of Sarit Centre, offices and the area’s best lifestyle spots. Reservations are open with flexible terms — from cash upfront to payment plans of up to three years.

Designed for efficient city living, Canto suits young professionals, first-time buyers, diaspora buyers seeking a Nairobi base, and investors targeting compact, high-demand units in one of Nairobi’s strongest rental markets. Compare other apartments for sale in Westlands, or view the dedicated 1-bedroom units at Canto.

Why These Studio & 1 Bedroom Apartments for Sale in Westlands Stand Out

Westlands remains Nairobi’s highest-performing rental and resale market, driven by demand from corporates, expatriates and professionals. Canto’s compact studio and 1-bedroom layouts hit the most liquid price points in the area, supporting both strong occupancy and long-term capital appreciation as neighbourhood infrastructure and amenities continue to improve.

  • Energy efficiency: sustainable materials and energy-efficient systems for lower utility bills.
  • Smart-home ready: remote control of lighting, climate and security.
  • Community spaces: shared areas designed to foster social interaction.

Project Snapshot

Unit Sizes & Prices

  • Studio: 36–39 sqm gross (29.76–32.05 sqm net), 1 bathroom — from USD 49,000.
  • 1 Bedroom: 56–57 sqm gross (45.44–46.15 sqm net), 1 bathroom — from USD 68,000.

Layout & Finishes

The residences are planned for efficient, modern living — clean circulation, practical storage and layouts that suit both short- and long-stay use, with integrated kitchens and concealed storage. Request the latest spec sheet to confirm materials, fittings and appliance schedules.

Amenities

  • Wellness: steam and sauna facilities (separate for men and women).

Location — School Lane, Westlands

Canto sits on School Lane in Westlands, a short walk from Sarit Centre and minutes from Westgate, the CBD, the UN complex and major hospitals (drive times vary with traffic) — one of the most walkable, amenity-rich addresses in Nairobi.

Payment Plan & Terms

  • Payment from cash upfront to up to 3-year installments.

  • Estimated completion November 2028.

Who It Suits

These studio & 1 bedroom apartments for sale in Westlands are ideal for singles, couples and small families, plus investors targeting compact, high-demand typologies for furnished or long-stay rental. Whether you want a Nairobi base or an efficient investment, Canto offers an accessible entry into a thriving urban community.

Enquire Today

listings.content_html:
Berkeley Homes Apartments is an off-plan development on Oloitoktok Road, Kileleshwa, Nairobi, offering studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments from KES 4.2 million (approximately USD 32,500). Units range from 40 sqm to 101 sqm, and residents share a rooftop swimming pool, gym and terrace deck. Completion is indicated for April 2028.

Listing updated: 23 September 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

About the Development

Berkeley Homes Apartments sits in a quiet, tree-lined pocket of Kileleshwa along Oloitoktok Road, a short drive from the Nairobi Arboretum and within easy reach of Westlands, Lavington and the Nairobi CBD. The development is sold off-plan, with completion indicated for April 2028.

The scheme mixes compact studios with one and two-bedroom apartments across nine layouts, so the range runs from a 40 sqm studio at the entry price up to a 101 sqm two-bedroom. The developer describes the architecture as striking and the finishes as refined, with layouts planned around natural light and usable floor area rather than raw square metres.

Price List by Unit Type

Prices are quoted in Kenya Shillings. The USD 32,500 shown against the entry price is an approximate conversion of KES 4.2 million at roughly 129 shillings to the dollar; the shilling figure is the one that governs a sale agreement, and the dollar equivalent will move with the exchange rate on the day you pay.

Studio Apartments — 40 sqm, from KES 4.2M

The 40 sqm studio is the entry unit at Berkeley Homes and the layout the from-price refers to. It is a single open living and sleeping space with a fitted kitchen, suited to a single occupant or a couple who want a low-maintenance home in Kileleshwa without stretching to a one-bedroom.

One-Bedroom Apartments — 50 and 60 sqm, from KES 5.3M

Two one-bedroom layouts are offered. The standard plan is 50 sqm from KES 5.3 million, and the more generous plan is 60 sqm from KES 6.23 million. Both are aimed at single professionals and couples who want a separate bedroom and a defined living area.

Two-Bedroom Apartments — 73 to 101 sqm, from KES 6.5M

The two-bedroom range is the widest at Berkeley Homes, running through six layouts: a 73 sqm compact plan from KES 6.5 million, Type A at 75 sqm from KES 7.15 million, Type B at 80 sqm from KES 7.82 million, Type C at 82 sqm from KES 8 million, Type D at 85 sqm from KES 8.8 million, and a 101 sqm premium plan from KES 9.39 million. Floor plans differ between types, so it is worth comparing the drawings side by side rather than choosing on size alone.

Amenities

  • Rooftop swimming pool with views over the surrounding suburbs
  • Rooftop gym and an expansive terrace deck
  • Patio gaming zone
  • Cafe and restaurant on site
  • Residents lounge and a landscaped courtyard
  • Kids play area in a safe, enclosed environment
  • Reception area with telecom services
  • High-speed lifts serving all floors
  • Full backup generator and borehole water supply
  • Ample parking for residents and visitors
  • 24-hour security and controlled access

Location and Connectivity

Oloitoktok Road runs through one of the quieter parts of Kileleshwa, the leafy corridor that sits between Kilimani, Lavington and Westlands. The Nairobi Arboretum is a few minutes away, and the road network gives straightforward access to Westlands, Lavington and the Nairobi CBD for work and schools. As with any Kileleshwa address, traffic at peak times is the thing to test for yourself: we would suggest driving your likely commute at the hour you would actually be making it.

Payment Plan

A 20% deposit secures a unit on booking, with the balance payable in instalments over the remaining construction period. Because this is an off-plan purchase, confirm the current instalment schedule, the completion programme and the terms of the sale agreement with your advocate before you commit.

The Investment Case, Honestly

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that Berkeley Homes sits on Oloitoktok Road in Kileleshwa, within easy reach of Westlands, Lavington and the Nairobi CBD; that the mix runs from a 40 sqm studio to a 101 sqm two-bedroom across nine layouts; that the finishes are described by the developer as refined, with fitted kitchens and layouts planned around natural light; and that the scheme is sold off-plan for completion in April 2028 on a 20% deposit. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building’s management rules and on applicable regulations — worth confirming before you buy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Berkeley Homes Apartments located?

Berkeley Homes Apartments is on Oloitoktok Road in Kileleshwa, Nairobi, a short drive from the Nairobi Arboretum and within easy reach of Westlands, Lavington and the Nairobi CBD.

What is the starting price at Berkeley Homes?

Prices start at KES 4,200,000, approximately USD 32,500, for a 40 sqm studio apartment. The largest listed layout, a 101 sqm two-bedroom, starts at KES 9,390,000.

What unit types and sizes are available?

There are nine layouts: a 40 sqm studio, one-bedroom apartments of 50 sqm and 60 sqm, and two-bedroom apartments of 73, 75, 80, 82, 85 and 101 sqm.

What is the payment plan at Berkeley Homes?

A 20 percent deposit secures a unit on booking and the balance is payable in instalments over the remaining construction period. Confirm the current schedule in writing before you commit.

When will Berkeley Homes be completed?

The development is sold off-plan with completion indicated for April 2028. Ask us for the latest construction programme before you sign, because off-plan dates can move.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. Buyers based outside Kenya purchase here regularly. You will need a Kenyan PIN, identification documents and an advocate to act for you, and funds are normally remitted through a Kenyan bank account. Ask your advocate to confirm the title terms for this development before you pay a deposit.

Can I pay in US dollars or must I pay in Kenya Shillings?

The price is set in Kenya Shillings at KES 4,200,000 and the USD 32,500 figure is an approximate conversion at roughly 129 shillings to the dollar. The shilling amount is what governs the sale agreement, so the dollar equivalent will move with the exchange rate on the day you pay.

What amenities are included at Berkeley Homes?

The development has a rooftop swimming pool, a rooftop gym and terrace deck, a patio gaming zone, an on-site cafe and restaurant, a residents lounge, a landscaped courtyard, a kids play area, high-speed lifts, a backup generator, borehole water, parking and 24-hour security.

listings.content_html:
Lesonia Residences — The Kileleshwa Address That Breathes

Kileleshwa has always been the neighbourhood that people describe as “leafy” and mean it. Not as a marketing word. As a fact. The streets are shaded, the compounds are planted, and the pace is noticeably slower than the Westlands and Kilimani corridors that sit on either side of it. It’s why families stay here for decades and why tenants who discover Kileleshwa rarely move back to busier neighbourhoods.

Lesonia Residences sits at the junction of Tinderet Avenue and Gatundu Road — a corner of Kileleshwa that captures everything the neighbourhood is known for (quiet, green, residential) while adding something it’s been missing: a modern development with the lifestyle infrastructure that today’s buyers and tenants expect as standard.

An art space coffee bar. A heated infinity pool. A business display and exhibition area. A rooftop lounge. These are the spaces that turn a building into a place people want to be — not just a place they sleep.

Apartments range from 1-bedroom (55 sqm) at KES 5.5M to 3-bedroom (155 sqm) at KES 18.3M. Completion is December 2028.

Tinderet Avenue & Gatundu Road: The Junction That Connects Without Congesting

The specific value of Lesonia’s location is the junction itself. Tinderet Avenue and Gatundu Road intersect to create dual-access routing — a practical advantage that anyone who has been stuck on a single-entry Kileleshwa side-street during rush hour will immediately appreciate. From this junction, you have clean routes to four of Nairobi’s most important residential and commercial corridors.

Westlands — including Sarit Centre, Westgate Mall, and the commercial district — is accessible via the Kileleshwa–Westlands link roads without touching the congested main arteries. Lavington and its schools, malls, and residential calm are a short drive south. Kilimani — with its restaurants, offices, and the Yaya Centre ecosystem — is directly reachable via the Gatundu Road corridor. The CBD and Upper Hill connect through multiple route options, giving residents the flexibility to choose based on real-time traffic.

The neighbourhood itself delivers what Kileleshwa always delivers: established trees, quiet streets, a mix of families and professionals, and proximity to strong schools (Riara, Braeburn, Hillcrest, and several international options are within the catchment). Valley Arcade — Kileleshwa’s café-and-boutique village — adds the walkable social character that newer developments on the city’s periphery simply can’t offer.

For investors, Kileleshwa’s tenant profile is among the most stable in Nairobi. Families sign multi-year leases. Professionals renew. Vacancy rates in quality Kileleshwa buildings are consistently among the lowest in the city — because once a tenant settles into this neighbourhood, the cost of moving rarely outweighs the comfort of staying.

The Apartments: Seven Unit Types from KES 5.5M

Lesonia offers seven configurations across three bedroom categories — enough variety to serve first-time buyers, growing families, and portfolio investors within a single development.

1-Bedroom Apartments — From KES 5,500,000

Three 1-bedroom options spanning 55 to 68 sqm — a range that accommodates meaningfully different lifestyles within the same bedroom count. The Type A at 55 sqm is a compact, well-planned home that works for a single professional or a studio-upgrade buyer entering the ownership market for the first time. At KES 5.5M, it’s one of the most accessible entry points into Kileleshwa — a neighbourhood where comparable completed units already trade above KES 7M.

The Type B (65 sqm) and Type C (68 sqm) add the space that separates a functional apartment from a comfortable one — wider living areas, more storage, and the kind of proportions that photograph well on Airbnb and present well during viewings. For investors targeting the short-stay or furnished rental market, the 1-bedrooms at Lesonia combine a Kileleshwa postcode (which attracts a quality guest profile) with amenities — the art space coffee bar, heated pool, and rooftop lounge — that create the listing content which drives bookings.

2-Bedroom Apartments — From KES 12,500,000

At 110–115 sqm, the 2-bedrooms are generously scaled for the category. These are apartments where the living and dining area doesn’t feel like a compromise, the master bedroom is properly sized, the second bedroom functions as a genuine room rather than a token, and the kitchen has the counter space and storage that daily cooking demands.

For couples and small families, the 2-bedroom at Lesonia offers the Kileleshwa lifestyle — green, quiet, well-connected — at a price point that sits below the neighbourhood’s premium tier. For investors, the 2-bedroom is the most versatile configuration in the Kileleshwa rental market: it attracts young families, professional couples, and expatriates equally, creating broad demand and consistently low vacancy.

3-Bedroom Apartments — From KES 17,100,000

The 3-bedrooms are full family homes. At 150–155 sqm, these apartments accommodate three properly sized bedrooms, a living and dining area scaled for daily life and entertaining, and the circulation space that makes a home feel unhurried rather than tight. The Type B adds 5 sqm over the Type A — modest on paper, meaningful when you’re furnishing a living room or fitting a dining table for six.

In the Kileleshwa rental market, quality 3-bedroom apartments in modern, amenity-rich buildings attract the tenants every landlord wants: families who stay, professionals on corporate housing allowances, and diplomatic staff whose employers pay top-tier rents. The 3-bedrooms at Lesonia are positioned to capture exactly this demand.

The Amenity Package: Art, Wellness, Business, and the Spaces Between

Lesonia’s amenity offering goes beyond the standard pool-gym-sauna checklist. The development includes several spaces that are rare in the Kileleshwa market — and it’s the rare ones that create the identity, the tenant preference, and the premium that generic buildings can’t command.

Art Space Coffee Bar & On-Site Restaurant. This is the amenity that gives Lesonia its character. A ground-floor café and dining space designed around the intersection of art, coffee, and community. For residents, it means a morning flat white without leaving the compound, a casual lunch option when cooking feels like too much effort, and a social anchor that builds the kind of resident community that makes people proud of where they live. For investors, it means a building with a soul — and tenants notice.

Business Display & Exhibition Area. A genuinely unique amenity. This is a curated space within the development for residents who run businesses, practice creative disciplines, or want a professional venue for small-scale exhibitions, product displays, or client showcases. In a city where finding appropriate small-event space is either expensive or impractical, having one in your building is a meaningful advantage — particularly for the entrepreneurial residents that Kileleshwa increasingly attracts.

Business Centre & Meeting Rooms. Professional workspace within the development for the remote and hybrid-work population. Video calls, client meetings, focused deep work — all handled in a purpose-built setting that eliminates the choice between your kitchen table and a noisy café.

Heated Infinity Swimming Pool. A heated pool that works year-round — because Nairobi’s evenings and mornings are cool enough to make unheated pools a feature you admire in brochures but skip in practice. The infinity edge and elevated position add the visual impact that makes this pool an amenity residents actually use and guests comment on.

Gym, Yoga Studio & Sauna. A fully equipped fitness centre covering strength, cardio, and functional training. A dedicated yoga studio for the flexibility, mobility, and mindfulness practice that has moved from niche to mainstream among Nairobi’s health-conscious professional class. A luxury sauna for post-workout or end-of-day recovery.

Rooftop Chill Spot, Lounge & BBQ Area. The rooftop is designed as a destination within the building — a lounge for evening relaxation, a barbecue area for weekend entertaining, and the kind of elevated outdoor space that serves as both a personal retreat and a social venue. Views over Kileleshwa’s tree canopy are the backdrop.

Indoor Games & Recreational Lounge. Social downtime within the building — board games, table games, and the kind of casual recreation that builds community among residents without requiring formal events.

Children’s Paradise & Outdoor Play Area. Safe, dedicated play space for younger residents — supervised, weather-protected, and designed to give families the confidence that children can play within the compound without concern.

Clubhouse & Landscaped Gardens. The clubhouse serves as the residents’ communal living room — events, gatherings, and the informal social interactions that make a building feel like a community. The landscaped open-floor gardens bring the greenery that Kileleshwa is known for inside the compound walls.

Building Infrastructure. Borehole water supply for reliable access independent of county supply. Full backup generator ensuring uninterrupted power to apartments, lifts, and common areas. High-speed lifts. Comprehensive CCTV surveillance with 24/7 manned security. Ample parking for residents and guests.

The Investment Case

Kileleshwa’s rental market is characterised by stability rather than volatility — tenants stay, vacancy is low, and rents hold their value even when other Nairobi markets soften. The neighbourhood’s family-friendly character and proximity to quality schools create a demand floor that protects investors through market cycles.

The off-plan entry prices represent a significant discount to where comparable completed Kileleshwa apartments currently trade. Buyers who secure units at today’s pricing and hold through the December 2028 completion will benefit from construction-period appreciation — historically 15–25% in quality Kileleshwa developments — before rental income begins.

The 1-bedroom Type A at KES 5.5M deserves particular attention from entry-level investors. Sub-KES 6M for a new-build apartment in Kileleshwa with this amenity specification is a price point that won’t exist once construction is visibly underway and early units begin to sell out.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Lesonia Residences located? Lesonia is at the junction of Tinderet Avenue and Gatundu Road in Kileleshwa, Nairobi — a well-connected corner of the neighbourhood with dual-access routing to Westlands, Kilimani, Lavington, and the CBD.

What are the apartment prices? 1-bedrooms from KES 5,500,000, 2-bedrooms from KES 12,500,000, 3-bedrooms from KES 17,100,000. Seven unit types are available across three bedroom categories.

What makes Lesonia different from other Kileleshwa developments? The art space coffee bar and on-site restaurant, the business display and exhibition area, and the heated infinity pool create a lifestyle package that goes well beyond the standard amenity set. These spaces give the building an identity — and identity drives tenant preference and retention.

When will the building be completed? December 2028.

Is Lesonia a good investment for diaspora buyers? Kileleshwa’s stable tenant market, low vacancy rates, and strong rental demand make it one of the safest Nairobi neighbourhoods for remote ownership. The off-plan pricing provides an entry discount, and Block Real Estate offers full property management services for owners who live abroad.

Can I use the apartments for Airbnb or short-stay rental? The 1-bedroom apartments are well-suited for furnished short-stay hosting. Kileleshwa attracts a quality guest profile — professionals, families, and visitors who prefer a residential neighbourhood over the hotel-district intensity of Westlands — and Lesonia’s amenities (coffee bar, pool, rooftop lounge) create the listing content that drives bookings and reviews.

Secure Your Apartment at Off-Plan Pricing

Contact us for the full brochure, floor plans, availability schedule, and payment plan details. We’ll match you to the right unit type for your budget, your lifestyle, and your investment goals.

listings.content_html:
Ivy Park Residences on Kirichwa Road, Kilimani, offers 3-bedroom apartments with a DSQ at 142 sqm (1,528 sqft), the largest homes in the development, priced from KES 15.62 million cash or KES 16.12 million on instalments. Completion is October 2028, and every home faces the central landscaped courtyard.

Listing updated: 23 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

Bathroom count and tenure for this unit are not published in the developer material we hold, so we have left them out rather than guess. Both are confirmed at enquiry.

About the 3 Bedroom + DSQ Apartment

This is the largest home at Ivy Park and the only one in the development at 142 sqm. It is a full family house arranged on a single floor: three bedrooms, an open-plan living and formal dining space framed by expansive windows, a fitted kitchen with ample storage built for busy family cooking, and a generously sized, private master suite with contemporary fittings.

The domestic staff quarter has its own separate access, which is what makes it work in practice: live-in help are accommodated without either household losing privacy, and where that is not required the room becomes a quiet home office or guest space. Combined with the three bedrooms, that gives the plan the scale of a suburban family home with the security, lift access and shared amenities of an apartment building.

Like every home at Ivy Park, it takes its outlook from the courtyard at the centre of the building rather than from the street. Interiors combine warm tones and natural textures. Floor plans and current availability are shared on request.

About Ivy Park Residences

Ivy Park is designed from the inside out. Rather than fitting apartments behind a facade and calling the leftover space a common area, the architects started with a central landscaped courtyard, water elements, seating and mature planting, and built the residences around it. The development is by Ivy Group Properties Company Limited and covers 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, including DSQ configurations, with a single completion date of October 2028.

Verified Amenities

Every amenity below is described in the Ivy Park development material. We have deliberately left out anything we could only trace to a website tag rather than to the developer’s own description of the building.

  • Central landscaped courtyard with water elements and quiet seating areas, bringing light and fresh airflow to every home.
  • Two-level rooftop. The lower level holds a residents’ lounge, an indoor bar, a ping-pong zone, the pool corner and a rooftop garden. The upper level holds an open-air rooftop cinema, a BBQ terrace and panoramic viewing decks.
  • Wellness suite: a spacious, fully fitted gym with natural light, a dedicated yoga room and a residents’ spa.
  • Ground-floor cafes, shops and daily essentials a few steps from the lobby.
  • Children’s play zones, dedicated and purpose-built for younger residents.
  • Security and infrastructure: 24/7 manned security with CCTV, full backup generator, borehole water supply, high-speed lifts, broadband-ready infrastructure and ample secure parking for residents and guests.

Location and Connectivity

Kirichwa Road runs through the residential heart of Kilimani, set back from the commercial intensity of Argwings Kodhek and Ngong Road but close enough to draw on both. It has kept its residential character as the neighbourhood around it has densified, which matters more for a family home than for any other unit type here.

Ivy Park Residences on Kirichwa Road, Kilimani, is a 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartment development by Ivy Group Properties, priced from KES 6,820,000 cash for a 62 sqm one-bedroom and rising to KES 15,620,000 for a 142 sqm three-bedroom plus DSQ. Completion is October 2028, and every apartment faces a central landscaped courtyard.

Development at a Glance

Bathroom counts per layout and the tenure of the title are not stated in the developer material we hold, so we have left those rows out rather than guess. Both are confirmed at enquiry.

About Ivy Park Residences

Most apartment buildings in Kilimani are designed from the outside in: the architect draws the facade, fits the units behind it, and whatever space is left over becomes the common area. Ivy Park reverses that order. The design begins with a central landscaped courtyard, with water elements, quiet seating and mature planting, and the residences are built around it. Apartments face inward toward greenery and light rather than outward toward the next building’s wall.

That is not a cosmetic distinction. It changes the light an apartment receives, the air that moves through it and the sound that reaches it. The development is by Ivy Group Properties Company Limited, sits on Kirichwa Road in Kilimani, and covers 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments including DSQ configurations, all under a single completion date of October 2028.

Price List by Unit Type

Ivy Park offers four unit types across three bedroom categories, with both cash and instalment pricing published by the developer.

The KES 500,000 differential between cash and instalment pricing is the same across every unit type. Buyers who settle within 30 days pay the lower figure; buyers who prefer the construction-linked schedule pay the published premium for that flexibility. Both routes lead to the same apartment.

1 Bedroom, 62–76 sqm, from KES 6.82M cash

The 1-bedroom range spans 62 to 76 sqm, a wide enough spread to give real choice inside a single category. The entry 62 sqm unit is arranged as open-plan living and dining with a defined bedroom and a fitted kitchen, and it takes its orientation from the courtyard rather than the street, which is what stops a compact plan from feeling closed in. At the top of the range, the 76 sqm layouts approach the footprint of many Nairobi two-bedroom apartments.

2 Bedroom, 98–115 sqm, from KES 10.78M cash

At 98 to 115 sqm, the standard 2-bedrooms are proportioned for couples and small families. Living and dining areas are scaled for daily use and for hosting, bedrooms take adult furniture without crowding, and the kitchen is laid out for real cooking rather than reheating.

2 Bedroom + DSQ, 108–128 sqm, from KES 11.88M cash

The DSQ turns a couple’s apartment into a flexible family home. The domestic staff quarter takes live-in help, a home office, a guest room, or the storage and utility space that families with young children accumulate. At 108 to 128 sqm these units match many Kilimani three-bedrooms on floor area at a lower price point.

3 Bedroom + DSQ, 142 sqm, from KES 15.62M cash

The largest home at Ivy Park. At 142 sqm it is a full family home with three bedrooms, living and dining scaled for a family, and a domestic staff quarter, inside a courtyard-oriented building with the full rooftop and wellness package.

Verified Amenities

Every amenity below is described in the Ivy Park development material. We have deliberately left out anything we could only trace to a website tag rather than to the developer’s own description of the building.

  • Central landscaped courtyard with water elements, seating areas and mature planting, at the heart of the building, with apartments facing into it for light and cross-ventilation.
  • Two-level rooftop. The lower level is the social floor: a residents’ lounge, an indoor bar, a ping-pong zone and a rooftop garden. The upper level holds an open-air rooftop cinema, a BBQ terrace and an open lounge with panoramic viewing decks.
  • Wellness suite: a fully equipped gym with tall windows and natural light, a dedicated yoga room, a residents’ spa and a swimming pool.
  • Ground-floor cafes, shops and daily essentials integrated at the base of the building, so coffee, dining and everyday errands sit inside the compound.
  • Children’s play zones, indoor and outdoor, purpose-built so children can play within the building.
  • Security and infrastructure: 24/7 manned security with CCTV, full backup generator, borehole water supply, high-speed lifts, broadband-ready infrastructure and ample secure parking for residents and guests.

Location and Connectivity

Kirichwa Road runs through the residential heart of Kilimani, set back from the commercial intensity of Argwings Kodhek and Ngong Road but close enough to draw on both. It is quieter and greener than the higher-density streets nearer Ngong Road, and it has kept that residential character as the neighbourhood around it has densified.

  • Yaya Centre, Kilimani’s retail and lifestyle anchor, is within immediate reach.
  • The restaurants, cafes and bars along Wood Avenue and the wider Kilimani dining scene are walkable.
  • The diplomatic zone along Dennis Pritt Road, with its embassies and international organisations, is a short drive.
  • Westlands, Lavington, Upper Hill and the CBD are reachable without complex routing, because Kirichwa Road connects to the arterials that move through Nairobi’s core without sitting on them.
  • Schools within the daily commute radius include Braeburn, Riara and St. Austin’s, alongside several international school options.

We have quoted only the reference points stated in the Ivy Park material and have not published drive times, because they vary with the hour of the day. We would rather you tested them on a viewing than took a number from a brochure.

Payment Plans

Option A, cash plan. A 20% deposit within 7 days of booking, with the 80% balance cleared within 30 days. This is the route that holds the lower published price on every unit type, KES 500,000 below the instalment figure.

Option B, construction-linked instalments. A 20% deposit within 7 days, then 10% at month 3, 20% at month 6, 10% at month 8, 10% at month 12, and the final 30% at handover in October 2028. Payments are tied to construction milestones and spread from booking to handover in October 2028, which is what makes the purchase workable for buyers funding it from salary or business income rather than from a single capital outlay.

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that Ivy Park Residences is a courtyard-oriented development on Kirichwa Road in Kilimani by Ivy Group Properties Company Limited, offering 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments from 62 sqm to 142 sqm, with DSQ options on the larger homes, priced from KES 6,820,000 to KES 15,620,000 on the cash plan or KES 7,320,000 to KES 16,120,000 on construction-linked instalments, in a building with a two-level rooftop, a gym, a yoga room, a spa, a pool, ground-floor retail and 24/7 security, completing in October 2028. Listing updated: 14 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Unit at a Glance

The five-bedroom homes at Gaia Brookside are the development’s most expansive — homes with the space and feel of a house, in a calm, green setting. Set along Brookside Gardens Drive in Westlands, each is all en-suite and comes with a DSQ, minutes from the full life of Westlands but tucked into one of its quieter, leafier pockets.

Available in two sizes, the five-bedroom layout pairs a generous open-plan living and dining space with a separate kitchen and a wet bar, five en-suite bedrooms, a dressing room to the master, a store room, a guest cloakroom, a DSQ, and multiple large balconies — served by a private lift lobby, all on a single level. Developed by Wonder Properties and completing in June 2028, it’s an off-plan opportunity for households that want maximum space in a restful, green home.

Gaia’s design philosophy is about harmony between the home and its natural surroundings — natural-looking materials, textured stone, warm timber and lush planting, with expansive windows that draw in natural light. The five-bedroom homes carry that feeling through, on a scale that suits large households and those who entertain.

The layout is genuinely generous: an open-plan living and dining area, a separate kitchen and a wet bar; five bedrooms, each en-suite, with a dressing room to the master; a store room, a guest cloakroom, and a DSQ with its own WC. Multiple large balconies extend the living space outdoors, and a private lift lobby adds to the sense of exclusivity — all arranged on a single level. The two sizes share this layout, with the larger home offering more generous proportions; the floor plan for your chosen size confirms the exact arrangement.

Sizes and Prices

This page covers the 5-bedroom, all-en-suite residences, each with a DSQ, starting at KES 45,000,000.

Prices are guide “from” figures and vary by floor, position and finish. Floor plans, the current price list and remaining availability are shared on request — please ask us for the latest at point of enquiry.

Amenities

Gaia Brookside offers an extensive set of lifestyle, wellness and family amenities.

Wellness and Fitness

Heated swimming pool, fitness centre, yoga studio, serenity spa and wellness suites, and an on-site health centre.

Rooftop Lifestyle

A lounge and bar, koroga and BBQ area, jogging track, rooftop sports (tennis court and snookball area), relaxation decks and a helipad.

Everyday Convenience

Concierge and lobby reception, conference centre, coffee shop, an elemental garden courtyard, a children’s play area and a dedicated pet area.

Location Advantage

Gaia Brookside sits in Brookside — a quiet, leafy pocket of Westlands off Lower Kabete Road and General Mathenge Drive, with quick access to Ring Road Parklands and the Nairobi Expressway:

  • Shopping and dining: Close to Westgate Shopping Mall, Sarit Centre, GTC, and Westlands favourites like The Alchemist, Artcaffe, Fogo Gaucho and Bao Box

  • Balance by quarterly instalments through to completion in June 2028

Exact instalment amounts, dates and any terms are confirmed in your offer and sale agreement. Ask us for the current payment schedule at point of enquiry.

For a large family, the appeal is house-sized space with the ease of an apartment: five en-suite bedrooms, a dressing room to the master, a wet bar, a store and a DSQ, in a secure, amenity-rich building, in a calm and leafy part of Westlands that’s still close to schools, hospitals and shopping. The wellness amenities mean much of everyday life can happen without leaving home, and the nature-led design makes for a genuinely restful place to come back to.

Why It Works for Investors

We keep our investor guidance honest: we don’t publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell — and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that these are large, distinctive, all-en-suite homes in an established, high-demand part of Nairobi, from a developer with a track record across several Nairobi schemes. As with any off-plan purchase, weigh the usual considerations — construction timelines, payment staging and the developer’s delivery record — and do your own due diligence. We’re glad to help you review comparable sales and rentals and connect you with independent advisers.

The five-bedroom homes are designed around natural materials and natural light:

  • A feature stone kitchen and dining area
  • Five en-suite bedrooms, with a dressing room to the master

The detailed finish schedule, appliance specification and exact bathroom configuration are confirmed on the specification and floor plans. Renders and brochure images are illustrative — please request the latest brochure and the floor plan for your chosen size at point of enquiry.

  • Large families who need substantial, house-sized, all-en-suite space with a DSQ
  • Households who entertain and want a wet bar and generous living areas
  • Wellness-minded buyers drawn to the spa, gym, pool and green, nature-led setting

On Brookside Gardens Drive in Brookside, Westlands — a leafy pocket off Lower Kabete Road, minutes from Westgate, Sarit Centre, MP Shah Hospital and the Nairobi Expressway.

How much is a 5 bedroom apartment at Gaia Brookside, Westlands?

There are two sizes. The 365 sqm (3,929 sqft) home is KES 45,000,000 to KES 48,200,000, and the 387 sqm (4,166 sqft) home is KES 51,000,000 to KES 55,280,000. Both are all en-suite and each includes a DSQ. Prices vary by floor, position and finish.

What does the price include and what is the payment plan?

Prices are guide from figures for the residence itself. A 20% deposit is payable within 7 days of reservation, with the balance by quarterly instalments through to completion in June 2028. Exact instalment amounts and dates are confirmed in your offer and sale agreement.

They are arranged on a single level, not as duplexes. All five bedrooms are en-suite, with a dressing room to the master, a store room, a guest cloakroom and a DSQ with its own WC. Exact bathroom counts are confirmed on the floor plans at the point of enquiry.

When will the 5 bedroom apartments be completed?

June 2028. Gaia Brookside is an off-plan development currently under construction, and we can share the latest construction update at the point of enquiry.

Stamp duty of 4% of the purchase price applies on transfer, and we will walk you through the full cost breakdown before you commit.

No. Gaia Brookside on Brookside Gardens Drive is a Wonder Properties development. It is a different scheme from Brookside Oak Residency on Muguga Green, Brookside One Residency, Brookside Drive Residences on Brookside Drive, and Lumiere on School Lane.

What parking and amenities come with a 5 bedroom home?

The development provides ample resident parking with access-card entry, and a private lift lobby serves the residence. Amenities include a heated pool, spa and wellness suites, fitness centre, yoga studio, on-site health centre, concierge, coffee shop, conference centre, children’s play area, pet area, and a rooftop with a lounge and bar, jogging track, tennis court, snookball area, koroga and BBQ area, relaxation decks and a helipad.

Some developments simply add homes to a city. Enaki Forestside adds a way of living to it. Set within Enaki, Africa’s first residential resort, this new phase places one to four-bedroom residences beside a 23,000 sq. ft. private forest, inside a 22-acre sanctuary anchored by a six-acre botanical garden. It is a rare proposition for Nairobi: genuine forest-edge living, positioned minutes from the city’s most established diplomatic and business addresses.

For those who want a home that restores as much as it accommodates, and for investors who understand the long-term value of scarcity and location, Enaki Forestside is worth a serious look.

Project Snapshot

Development Enaki Forestside (third phase of Enaki, following Townside and Parkside)
Location Between Nyari, Gigiri and Kitisuru, within Nairobi’s UN-approved Blue Zone
Unit Types One, two, three and four-bedroom residences
Starting Price From KSh 18.6 million
Completion Q4, 2028
Development Size 22 acres overall, including a six-acre botanical garden and a 23,000 sq. ft. private forest
Development Type Mixed-use residential resort with parks, cafés and wellness amenities

Exact unit sizes, floor-by-floor pricing, service charge structure and payment milestones are to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Buyers are advised to request the current brochure, floor plans and price list before making a decision.

A Development Designed for Restorative City Living

Enaki was conceived on a simple premise: that city life and nature don’t need to be traded off against each other. Across its 22 acres, the development weaves residences, parks, cafés and wellness spaces around a six-acre botanical garden, creating a rhythm of daily life that feels unusually unhurried for a Nairobi address.

Forestside is the newest chapter in that story. Here, homes sit directly beside a 23,000 sq. ft. private forest, with forest-edge dining, alfresco lounges and green retreats built into the everyday experience. It is designed less as a collection of apartments and more as a small, self-contained town, one where residents can step from their front door into genuine green space without leaving the neighbourhood.

For homeowners, this translates into a quieter, more grounded pace of life. For investors, it reflects a broader shift already visible in Kenya’s real estate market, where wellness-led, nature-integrated developments are increasingly setting the benchmark for premium residential demand.

Unit Types

Enaki Forestside offers a range of residences designed to suit different household sizes and life stages:

One-Bedroom Residences – A refined, low-maintenance option for professionals and downsizers who want forest-edge living without a large footprint.
Two-Bedroom Residences – A versatile choice for couples, small families, or buyers who want extra space for a home office or guest room.
Three-Bedroom Residences – Designed for growing families who value space, privacy and proximity to green amenities.
Four-Bedroom Residences – The development’s largest configuration, suited to larger families or those seeking a more expansive forest-edge home.

Prices start from KSh 18.6 million. Specific pricing by unit type and floor, along with detailed floor plans, is available in the official floor plan document or on request from Block Real Estate.

Amenities

Enaki Forestside residents have access to the wider Enaki resort environment, including:

A 23,000 sq. ft. private forest exclusive to the Forestside phase
A six-acre botanical garden at the heart of the development
Forest-edge dining and alfresco lounge spaces
Parks and landscaped green spaces throughout the 22-acre site
Cafés and wellness-focused amenities
A mixed-use neighbourhood layout designed to support daily life without leaving the development

Further amenity details, including specific wellness facility offerings, retail mix and clubhouse features (where applicable), should be confirmed with the latest marketing materials at the point of enquiry.

Location Advantage

Enaki Forestside sits between Nyari, Gigiri and Kitisuru, three of Nairobi’s most established and secure residential neighbourhoods, and within the UN-approved Blue Zone. This positioning places residents close to embassies, international schools, and the UN complex, an area long associated with stability and strong long-term property demand.

The development benefits from direct access to Westlands via the Westlands–Redhill Road and the Nairobi Expressway, keeping the city’s main business, retail and dining district within easy reach while preserving a sense of distance from its congestion and noise.

For homeowners, this means a genuinely quiet, green address that doesn’t compromise on connectivity. For investors, it means a location with the kind of enduring appeal that tends to underpin resilient property values over time.

Payment Plan

Specific payment plan structures, including deposit requirements and construction-linked instalment schedules, are to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Prospective buyers are encouraged to request the current payment schedule directly, as terms may vary by unit type and stage of construction ahead of the Q4 2028 completion date.

Why It Works for Homeowners
A genuinely different pace of life. Forest-edge dining, alfresco lounges and a private forest give residents daily access to nature that is rare within Nairobi’s city limits.
A secure, established neighbourhood. Positioned between Nyari, Gigiri and Kitisuru, in the Blue Zone, the location carries a long-standing reputation for safety and quality of life.
Everyday convenience built in. Parks, cafés and wellness amenities mean residents don’t need to leave the development for daily essentials.
Easy access to the city. The Westlands–Redhill Road and Expressway connection keeps Westlands, and the wider city, within comfortable reach.
Room to grow. With one to four-bedroom options, families can find a home suited to their current needs, with room to move within the development as those needs change.
Why It Works for Investors
Scarcity of concept. As Africa’s first residential resort, Enaki offers a positioning that is genuinely difficult to replicate, particularly the forest-edge setting unique to this phase.
A track record within the same development. Forestside follows two completed phases, Townside and Parkside, giving buyers the reassurance of a developer with a delivered history on this specific site.
Address strength. Nyari, Gigiri and Kitisuru have long been associated with stable, high-value residential demand, supported by proximity to embassies and international institutions.
Connectivity without compromise. Expressway and Westlands–Redhill Road access supports the kind of convenience that tends to sustain tenant and buyer interest over time.
Diversified unit mix. A spread from one to four-bedroom residences allows investors to align unit selection with different tenant or resale profiles.

As with any off-plan investment, buyers should request the latest brochure, price list and payment schedule, and seek independent advice before committing. Block Real Estate does not make specific projections regarding rental yield, occupancy or capital appreciation for this development.

Finishes and Specifications

Detailed finishes and specifications for Enaki Forestside are to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Buyers are advised to request the official brochure and specification sheet, available alongside the floor plans, for full details on fittings, fixtures and finishing standards.

Who This Development Suits Best

Enaki Forestside is well suited to:

Families and professionals who want a quieter, nature-led lifestyle without leaving Nairobi
Buyers who value long-term address strength in an established, secure diplomatic-zone location
Downsizers or first-time premium buyers drawn to the one and two-bedroom options
Larger families seeking three or four-bedroom homes with genuine green space nearby
Investors looking for a distinctive, low-supply concept within a proven development
