What makes Enaki Forestside different from the earlier Enaki phases? Forestside residences are set beside a 23,000 sq. ft. private forest, with forest-edge dining and alfresco lounge spaces designed around that setting.

What is included in the price? Specific inclusions, finishes and specifications are to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Buyers should request the latest brochure and specification sheet.

Is a payment plan available? Payment plan details are to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Please contact Block Real Estate for the current payment schedule.

How do I get the full floor plans and pricing? Full floor plans are available here, or you can request the latest floor plans, price list and brochure directly from Block Real Estate.

Enaki Forestside offers a rare kind of address in Nairobi, one where forest, garden and city life sit side by side. Whether you’re searching for a home that restores your everyday pace, or an investment with genuine long-term positioning, our team at Block Real Estate can walk you through the latest floor plans, pricing and payment terms.

listings.content_html:
Golden Apple is an off-plan twin-tower development in Kilimani, Nairobi, roughly 200 metres from The Junction Mall on the Ngong Road corridor. It offers 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from KES 6,600,000, sized 66 to 145 sqm, with completion scheduled for 2028 and a heated swimming pool on site.

Listing updated: 24 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

About Golden Apple

Golden Apple is a two-tower residential scheme of 587 apartments in Kilimani, Nairobi. The developer describes Block A as 23 floors and Block B as 24 floors, each with its own pair of reception halls and lifts, so arrivals, deliveries and visitor traffic are shared across two entrances rather than funnelled through one.

The unit mix runs from a 66 sqm one bedroom to a 145 sqm three bedroom, which is an unusually wide range for a single address. It means a first-time buyer and a family of five can be looking at the same building, and it is the main reason we hold separate pages for each unit category rather than one price list.

Price List by Unit Type

These are the from-prices on the price list we hold. Prices on off-plan schemes move, so treat every figure below as a starting point and confirm the current list with us before you commit.

One Bedroom — from KES 6,600,000

Five layouts, from 66 sqm to 85 sqm. Two are standard one bedrooms at the 6.6M entry price. The other three add a separate study — a real room, not an alcove — which buyers use as a home office, a guest room or storage. Full detail on the 1 bedroom apartments at Golden Apple page.

Two Bedroom, All Ensuite — from KES 13,200,000

Both two bedroom layouts, 110 sqm and 115 sqm, are all ensuite: each bedroom has its own bathroom rather than sharing one off a corridor. See the 2 bedroom all-ensuite apartments page.

Three Bedroom, Master Ensuite — from KES 16,600,000

Two layouts at 138 sqm and 145 sqm, with the master bedroom ensuite. The bathroom count for the remaining bedrooms is not stated on the price list we hold and is confirmed at enquiry. See the 3 bedroom apartments at Golden Apple page.

Verified Amenities

The following are the amenities listed for Golden Apple by the developer and carried consistently across every unit page in this development:

  • Heated swimming pool
  • Gym
  • Yoga room
  • On-site restaurant
  • Ground-floor commercial area
  • Rooftop garden
  • Kids playroom
  • Leisure area
  • Shared laundry facility
  • Landscaped gardens and water features
  • CCTV surveillance
  • Intercom to reception
  • High-speed lifts
  • Two reception halls per block
  • Vehicle chip access system for parking

Finishes, appliance inclusions, wardrobe provision, parking allocation and the service charge are not published for this development. Ask us for the current specification sheet before you reserve.

Location and Connectivity

Golden Apple is in Kilimani, Nairobi, at the southern edge of the area where it meets the Ngong Road corridor. The map position stored on this listing places the site roughly 200 metres from The Junction Mall, so the mall is genuinely within walking distance rather than a drive. We publish the distance rather than a walking time because pavement routes and the Ngong Road crossing decide how long that walk actually takes.

A note on the roads, because earlier copy on this page described the site as the point where Riara Road and Kingara Road meet. Those two roads do not meet each other: both run north off Ngong Road, Riara Road heading up towards Lavington and Kingara Road towards Dagoretti Corner. Riara Road proper, in its Lavington stretch, sits about 2.6 km from the coordinates recorded for this development. Please confirm the exact plot address with us before you travel to site.

From this stretch of Ngong Road, residents reach Kilimani, Lavington, Dagoretti Corner, Adams Arcade, Upper Hill and the Nairobi CBD on established arterial routes. Prestige Plaza and Adams Arcade add retail beyond The Junction. Schools, hospitals and supermarkets in this catchment are long established rather than promised.

The Investment Case

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that Golden Apple is an off-plan scheme of 587 apartments in Kilimani with a from-price of KES 6,600,000 for a 66 sqm one bedroom, a size range of 66 to 145 sqm, completion indicated for 2028, and a location roughly 200 metres from The Junction Mall on the Ngong Road corridor. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building’s management rules and on applicable regulations — worth confirming before you buy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where exactly is Golden Apple, and how far is The Junction Mall?

Golden Apple is in Kilimani, Nairobi, at the southern edge of the area on the Ngong Road corridor. The map position stored on this listing places it roughly 200 metres from The Junction Mall. Riara Road and Kingara Road both run north off Ngong Road and do not meet each other, so please confirm the exact plot address with us before travelling to site.

How much do apartments at Golden Apple cost?

One bedroom apartments start from KES 6,600,000, two bedroom all-ensuite apartments from KES 13,200,000 and three bedroom master-ensuite apartments from KES 16,600,000. These are from-prices on the list we hold — confirm the current price list with us.

What unit types and sizes are available?

Nine configurations across three categories: five one bedroom layouts from 66 to 85 sqm, three of them with a separate study; two all-ensuite two bedroom layouts at 110 and 115 sqm; and two master-ensuite three bedroom layouts at 138 and 145 sqm.

Is there a studio apartment at Golden Apple?

No studio appears on the price list we hold. The smallest unit is a 66 sqm one bedroom from KES 6,600,000. If a studio is released later we will add it to this page.

When is Golden Apple due for completion?

Completion is indicated for 2028. This is a developer-supplied date on an off-plan scheme, so ask us for the current construction update before you commit.

What is the payment plan?

The payment plan has not been published for this development. Reservation fee, deposit, instalment structure, legal fees, stamp duty, service charge and parking allocation are all confirmed at enquiry.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. Kenyan law allows non-citizens to hold leasehold interests, and diaspora buyers purchase off-plan here regularly. You will need identification, KRA registration and a Kenyan bank account or an approved remittance route, and you can appoint a lawyer under power of attorney to sign on your behalf. We will walk you through the steps and recommend you take independent legal advice.

What amenities are included?

A heated swimming pool, gym, yoga room, restaurant, ground-floor commercial area, rooftop garden, kids playroom, leisure area, shared laundry, landscaped gardens and water features, CCTV, intercom, high-speed lifts, two reception halls per block and a vehicle chip access system for parking.

Golden Hill Type B; The 3-Bedroom with the Private Forest Terrace

3 Bedrooms · 4 Washrooms · DSQ · Private Elevator · Master Suite with Private Terrace

Three Bedrooms. One Terrace That Changes Everything.

Every residence at Golden Hill connects to the forest. The Type B makes that connection personal. The master suite opens onto a private terrace that faces directly into the canopy — your own outdoor extension of the most private room in the house. Morning coffee above the tree line. Evening quiet with nothing between you and the forest but air.

Golden Hill price:

Unit A_379.39 sqm (4 bedroom,5 washroom and DSQ)
65,786,226_96,744,450/=

Unit B_230.47 sqm(3 bedroom,4 washroom and DSQ)

This is the detail that separates the Type B from every other 3-bedroom apartment in Nairobi. Other developments offer balconies. Some offer views. The Type B offers a private outdoor room attached to your bedroom, overlooking indigenous forest that can never be built on, never be obstructed, and never be taken away.

The Layout: Open Living, Private Sleeping

The Type B is designed around a clear spatial principle: the social spaces are open, the private spaces are protected, and the transition between them is seamless.

Open living and dining. The main living area is configured as a single, flowing space where cooking, eating, relaxing, and hosting happen within the same generous footprint. The openness is deliberate — it maximises natural light from the forest-facing windows, creates a sense of scale that enclosed rooms cannot match, and supports the way modern families actually use their homes. The kitchen connects to the dining area, which connects to the living room, which connects to the forest through floor-to-ceiling glass. The circulation is intuitive, the proportions are generous, and the forest is visible from every angle.

Three bedrooms. Each bedroom is a properly scaled room with the dimensions, storage, and privacy that a family needs. The master suite is the standout — a private retreat with its own bathroom and the terrace that defines the Type B experience. The second and third bedrooms serve children, guests, or a dedicated home office with equal effectiveness.

Four washrooms. A 4:3 washroom-to-bedroom ratio means the master is fully en-suite, additional bedrooms have dedicated or direct bathroom access, and a guest washroom serves the living areas without intruding on private spaces.

DSQ. Detached staff quarter providing accommodation, guest suite flexibility, or separated home office space — the same practical advantage that every Golden Hill residence includes.

Private elevator. Dedicated elevator hall serving only your residence. From underground parking to your front door without shared corridors, communal lobbies, or encounters with neighbours. Privacy as infrastructure, not aspiration.

The Master Terrace: Why It Matters

A private terrace attached to a master bedroom sounds like a luxury feature. At Golden Hill, it’s something more fundamental — it’s a daily relationship with the forest that no interior space can replicate.

The terrace faces the canopy. In the morning, the light is green-filtered and soft. The sound is birds and wind through leaves. The temperature is cooler than the rooms behind you because the forest creates its own microclimate. You stand outside your bedroom and you are, for that moment, not in Nairobi. You’re in the forest. And then you step back inside, close the door, and the city is 20 minutes away whenever you need it.

For couples, the master terrace becomes the private space within the private space — the place where the day begins and ends without an audience. For families, it becomes the parents’ retreat — a physical reminder that the home serves everyone, but this corner of it serves only you.

No other 3-bedroom apartment in Nairobi offers this combination: a private outdoor space, facing a protected forest, attached to the master bedroom, in a building where your elevator is yours alone.

The Type B Buyer

The Type B is for buyers who want the full Golden Hill experience — the forest, the private elevator, the 102-home exclusivity, the slope-smart architecture — in a 3-bedroom configuration that matches their household size without oversizing their home. Not every family needs four bedrooms. Some families are two adults and one child. Some are a couple with a guest room. Some are professionals who want one bedroom for sleeping and one for working, with a third held in reserve.

The Type B gives these buyers everything the development offers without paying for rooms they don’t use — and the private master terrace ensures the 3-bedroom doesn’t feel like a compromise. It feels like the configuration that was designed first.

It is also the Type B’s terrace that creates its distinct investment identity. In the resale market, the terrace is the feature that prospective buyers remember after viewing all four types. It’s the feature that photographs beautifully for listings. And it’s the feature that justifies a premium over standard 3-bedroom apartments anywhere in Nairobi, because the terrace doesn’t just overlook greenery — it overlooks a forest that will exist as long as the building does.

Shared Amenities

Heated infinity pool merging with the forest canopy. Scenic fitness centre with floor-to-ceiling forest views. Spa and relaxation rooms. Private residents’ lounge. Multi-generational garden spaces, riverside lawns, reading and meditation areas, children’s playground. Underground parking (two spaces per household average). 24-hour manned security, standby generator, on-site water storage, high-speed elevators. 102 households sharing every facility — exclusivity by arithmetic, not by marketing.

Golden Hill Type A — The 4-Bedroom Forest Residence

4 Bedrooms · 5 Washrooms · DSQ · Private Elevator · Floor-to-Ceiling Forest Views

The Flagship Home at the Forest Edge

The Type A is Golden Hill’s defining residence — the configuration that most fully expresses what this development was designed to be. Four bedrooms, five washrooms, a DSQ, your own private elevator, and great rooms framed by floor-to-ceiling windows that put the forest canopy inside your home.

Golden Hill price:

Unit A_379.39 sqm (4 bedroom,5 washroom and DSQ)
65,786,226_96,744,450/=

Unit B_230.47 sqm(3 bedroom,4 washroom and DSQ)

51,108,916_66,970,303/=

This is not an apartment with a nice view. This is a home engineered around the view — every room oriented, every window positioned, every sight line calculated to ensure the forest is not just visible but present. When you sit in the great room, the trees are not outside your window. They are part of your room.

What Defines the Type A

The Great Rooms. The living spaces in the Type A are described as “great rooms” rather than “living rooms” because the scale justifies the word. These are expansive, open-plan spaces where a family gathers daily and hosts comfortably — where the dining table seats eight without crowding the sofa, where children play on the floor while adults sit at the counter, where a Sunday afternoon unfolds without anyone needing to leave the room. Floor-to-ceiling windows on the forest-facing elevation ensure the great room is flooded with natural light and framed by canopy views from morning to evening.

Four Bedrooms. Each bedroom is a genuine room — sized for adult furniture, built-in storage, and the clearance that makes a bedroom feel like a retreat rather than a container. The master suite is the private anchor of the home — a room you close the door on and the rest of the house disappears. The additional three bedrooms accommodate children, guests, extended family, or the home office that modern professional life demands. Every bedroom benefits from the natural light and forest orientation that defines the entire development.

Five Washrooms. A washroom count that matches or exceeds the bedroom count eliminates the morning queue, the guest awkwardness, and the compromises that families in underbathed homes accept as normal. Five washrooms across a 4-bedroom residence means the master is fully en-suite, additional bedrooms have direct or dedicated bathroom access, and guests never need to use a family bathroom.

DSQ. The detached staff quarter is a practical necessity for Kenyan family living — accommodation for household staff that provides them with privacy and dignity while keeping them within the compound. The DSQ also functions as a self-contained guest suite, a home office with separation from the main house, or additional storage and utility space.

Private Elevator. Your own dedicated elevator hall. You descend from your residence to the underground parking without passing through a shared corridor, a communal lobby, or another resident’s landing. The elevator is yours — not shared with a floor, not shared with a wing. This is the privacy standard that separates a luxury home from a luxury-branded apartment, and it is standard across every residence at Golden Hill.

The Forest Relationship

The Type A’s forest-facing orientation is not decorative. It is structural. The floor-to-ceiling windows are positioned to maximise the panoramic view of the adjacent indigenous forest — one of Nairobi’s last remaining natural forests, protected land that cannot be developed, obstructed, or diminished. The view you buy today is the view you own permanently.

What this means in practice: your morning light is filtered through a tree canopy. Your ambient sound is birdsong rather than traffic. Your air quality is measurably better than surrounding neighbourhoods. And the psychological effect of living alongside a forest — the reduction in stress, the improvement in sleep quality, the daily sense of calm — is documented, real, and cumulative.

Golden Hill’s slope-smart architecture ensures the Type A residences are terraced into the hillside, meaning upper units look over lower ones toward the canopy rather than into the back of another building. Every Type A enjoys an unobstructed forest view regardless of floor position.

The Amenities You Share with Only 101 Other Households

With 102 homes in the entire development, every shared amenity at Golden Hill feels private. The heated infinity pool that appears to merge with the forest canopy beyond it. The scenic fitness centre with floor-to-ceiling forest views. The spa and relaxation rooms. The private residents’ lounge. Multi-generational garden spaces, riverside lawns, reading and meditation areas, family event lawns, and children’s playgrounds integrated into the natural landscape.

Underground parking averages two spaces per household. 24-hour manned security. Standby power generator. On-site water storage. High-speed elevators.

102 families sharing these facilities means you will never queue for the pool, never wait for a gym machine, and never feel like you live in a complex. You live in an estate.

Who the Type A Serves

The Type A is for families who have reached the point where home is no longer a stepping stone — it is a destination. A place where children grow up with forest air and space to run. A place where weekends are spent on riverside lawns rather than in shopping malls. A place where the private elevator, the great rooms, and the five washrooms are not luxuries but the baseline of how you choose to live.

It is also an irreplaceable asset. Forest-edge land in Nairobi is finite and diminishing. The 102 homes at Golden Hill will never be expanded, and no comparable development can be built because no comparable land exists. The Type A is not just a home — it is a position in a market of permanent scarcity.

listings.content_html:
Golden Hill is a 102-home luxury development on Donyo Sabuk Avenue in Upper Westlands, on the edge of one of Nairobi’s last remaining natural forests. Three-bedroom homes of 230 to 288 sqm start at KES 39,493,339 and four-bedroom homes of 379 to 515 sqm run to KES 126,027,936, with handover targeted for November 2028.

Every residence has a DSQ, a private elevator that opens into the home and floor-to-ceiling forest views. Block Real Estate is the authorised sales agent for Golden Hill.

Golden Hill at a Glance

Golden Hill Prices: Four Residence Types

Prices vary within each type by floor, orientation and forest aspect. Request the current price sheet and the list of available residences from Block Real Estate before you commit.

Golden Hill: 102 Homes Where Nairobi Ends and the Forest Begins

Nairobi is running out of forest. That’s not sentiment, it’s geography. The city has expanded in every direction, absorbing the green corridors that once separated neighbourhoods, converting farmland into apartment blocks, and pushing the tree line further from the centre with every passing year. The pockets of indigenous forest that remain inside the greater Nairobi footprint are finite, protected, and irreplaceable. They will never be reproduced.

Golden Hill sits on the edge of one of these last remaining forests: 102 luxury residences designed not beside the trees, but into them. The buildings follow the natural contours of the land. The facades blend with the canopy. The waterways are preserved, not piped underground. Every residence faces the forest, and every morning begins with the sound of birds rather than traffic.

This is not a development that happens to have some landscaping. This is a development whose entire reason for existing is the forest it borders, and every architectural, engineering, and design decision has been made to honour that relationship rather than exploit it.

Developed by SkyPeak Limited, part of Xiangfeng Group, and set on Donyo Sabuk Avenue in Upper Westlands, Golden Hill is a collection of 3 and 4-bedroom homes with DSQ, private elevator access per residence, floor-to-ceiling forest views, and an amenity ecosystem that includes a heated infinity pool, scenic fitness centre, spa, and multi-generational garden spaces integrated into the natural terrain.

There are 102 homes. There will only ever be 102 homes. And the forest isn’t getting any bigger.

Location: Donyo Sabuk Avenue, Upper Westlands

Golden Hill sits on Donyo Sabuk Avenue in Upper Westlands, between Peponi Road and General Mathenge Drive, overlooking Karura Forest. Westgate, Sarit Centre and the Westlands office district are a short drive away.

  • Westgate Mall: about 1 km
  • Sarit Centre: about 1 km
  • MP Shah Hospital: about 2 km
  • UN offices, Gigiri: about 2 km
  • The Village Market: about 2.5 km
  • Aga Khan University Hospital: about 3 km
  • Rosslyn Academy: about 3 km
  • International School of Kenya: about 4.5 km
  • Nairobi CBD: about 5 km
  • JKIA: about 16 km

Straight-line distances from the site; road distances and travel times are longer and vary with traffic. At this price, stand on the site yourself: Block Real Estate arranges private visits.

Forest-Edge Living

Every luxury development in Nairobi claims proximity to green space. Golden Hill is different because the relationship between the residences and the forest is not proximity, it’s integration. The development doesn’t overlook a park across the road. It doesn’t face a landscaped garden designed to look natural. It sits on the physical boundary where Nairobi’s urban fabric meets indigenous forest, and the architecture is built to dissolve that boundary rather than mark it.

  • The air is different. Forest-adjacent properties benefit from cleaner air, lower ambient temperatures, and the kind of acoustic insulation that no amount of soundproofing can replicate. The forest absorbs the noise, filters the pollution, and creates a microclimate that is cooler and fresher than surrounding neighbourhoods.
  • The views are permanent. Forest is protected land. Unlike a view over low-rise buildings that could be blocked by a new tower next year, the forest view from Golden Hill cannot be built out. That is the rarest feature any Nairobi property can offer.
  • The connectivity is intact. Golden Hill’s forest-edge position does not mean isolation. The development keeps its access to Nairobi’s transport links, commercial centres, supermarkets, hospitals, schools, and leisure destinations. Every urban convenience is within reach, but when you close your front door, you leave all of it behind.

The Architecture: Slope-Smart Design and Forest Integration

Golden Hill’s architectural philosophy begins with a principle that most Nairobi developers ignore: the land comes first. Rather than flattening the site, pouring a concrete platform, and building on top of it, Golden Hill’s design follows the natural contours of the terrain.

Slope-smart design means the buildings are terraced into the hillside, stepping down with the gradient rather than fighting it. This approach achieves three things simultaneously. First, it preserves the natural waterways and drainage patterns that sustain the adjacent forest ecosystem. Second, it creates a cascading profile where upper residences look over the roofs of lower ones toward the forest canopy. Third, it reduces the visual mass of the buildings: from the forest side, Golden Hill appears to emerge from the landscape rather than dominate it.

The facades blend with the greenery: material choices, colour palettes, and surface textures are selected to complement the natural tones of the forest rather than contrast with them. Floor-to-ceiling windows are standard across all residence types, not as an aesthetic gesture but as a functional connection to the forest that defines the entire concept.

The Residences: Four Types, 102 Homes

Golden Hill offers four residence types, each a full family home with DSQ, multiple bathrooms, and the spatial generosity that the word “luxury” promises but rarely delivers. With only 102 homes across the entire development, density is low, privacy is genuine, and the sense of exclusivity is structural rather than cosmetic.

Every residence includes a dedicated private elevator, one elevator hall per home, not a shared lift serving a floor of four or six apartments. You step from your car in the underground parking into your own elevator and arrive at your own front door without passing a corridor, a neighbour, or a shared landing.

Type B: 3 Bedrooms, 4 Washrooms, DSQ | 230.47 sqm | From KES 39,493,339

The entry point into Golden Hill. Three bedrooms, four bathrooms, DSQ, and an open living and dining configuration that brings the forest into the heart of the home. The master suite includes a private terrace, an outdoor extension of the bedroom for morning coffee above the canopy. View the Type B residence.

Type C: 3 Bedrooms, 4 Washrooms, DSQ | 287.97 sqm | From KES 51,108,916

The Type C introduces a circular flow design, where rooms connect in a continuous loop rather than branching off a central corridor. This removes dead-end circulation and lets natural light in from several directions. Three balconies extend the living space outdoors, and panoramic windows keep the forest in view from every room.

Type A: 4 Bedrooms, 5 Washrooms, DSQ | 379.39 sqm | From KES 65,786,226

The flagship residence. Four bedrooms, five bathrooms, a DSQ, private elevator access, and floor-to-ceiling windows framing forest views from the expansive great rooms, which are scaled for both family evenings and formal hosting. View the Type A residence.

Type D: 4 Bedrooms, 5 Washrooms, 2 Living Rooms, DSQ | 514.82 sqm | KES 126,027,936

The most expansive configuration. Four bedrooms, five bathrooms, DSQ, two living rooms, and 360-degree views of both the forest and the Nairobi skyline. An expansive private terrace wraps the residence, and the dual living rooms separate formal entertaining from everyday family life.

Landscape: Jacaranda-Inspired, Forest-First

Golden Hill’s landscape design takes its cue from Nairobi’s Jacaranda blooms, the purple canopy that transforms the city every October, and is built on nature-first design principles that treat the existing terrain as an asset rather than a problem to be solved.

Shaded pathways wind through the compound following the natural topography. Open lawns occupy the flatter ground for family recreation and community gathering. Water features follow the existing watercourses rather than creating artificial ones, and the planting palette uses indigenous, climate-appropriate species that support local biodiversity.

Amenities at Golden Hill

Golden Hill’s amenities extend the forest-living experience: every shared space is positioned and oriented to keep the connection to the trees, and with only 102 homes sharing them they stay quiet and uncrowded.

Pool and wellness

  • Heated infinity pool
  • Spa and relaxation rooms
  • Scenic gym with forest views

Family and social

  • Private residents’ lounge
  • Riverside lawns and family event lawns
  • Reading and meditation gardens
  • Kids’ indoor and outdoor play areas

Building and security

  • A private elevator for every home
  • Underground parking, about two spaces per home
  • 24-hour manned security
  • Standby power generator
  • On-site water storage
  • Elegant lobbies

Payment Plan

Golden Hill is sold off plan: reserve your residence, pay the deposit when you sign, then spread the balance while the towers are built.

  • Reservation: KES 1,000,000 to secure a residence
  • Deposit: 20% on signing the sale agreement
  • Balance: instalments during construction
  • Completion: handover targeted for 30 November 2028

Ask Block Real Estate for the developer’s current payment schedule for the residence you choose before you reserve.

Why Golden Hill?

  • 102 homes on the edge of a protected forest, in Upper Westlands
  • A private elevator that opens into every home
  • A DSQ in every residence, from 230 to 515 sqm
  • A heated infinity pool, a spa and a gym with forest views
  • Floor-to-ceiling windows and terraces facing the canopy
  • Block Real Estate is the authorised sales agent

Golden Hill for Investors

Golden Hill’s case rests on scarcity: protected forest cannot be built on, so homes on its edge with lasting views are in short supply. With only 102 residences, resale stock will stay thin, which tends to support pricing when homes do come to market. As an off-plan purchase with handover targeted for November 2028, weigh the developer’s track record and the construction timeline, and treat future value as unguaranteed.

Nairobi’s population is growing and demand for quality family homes in green, private, secure settings is rising, while the supply of forest-edge residential land is fixed. A 1-bedroom in Westlands competes with every other 1-bedroom in Westlands; a forest-edge home at Golden Hill competes with a far smaller pool, because comparable sites cannot be created.

Ask us for current Westlands comparables and for SkyPeak’s completed-project record before you commit.

Who Golden Hill Suits Best

  • Established families who want a private, secure home with room for everyone
  • Senior professionals who want forest views and a private elevator to the door
  • Diaspora Kenyans building a legacy asset and a future family home in Nairobi
  • Long-term investors who value scarcity over short-term yield

It suits less well buyers who need to move in before late 2028, buyers looking for a small apartment or a quick rental yield, or anyone who wants to walk to Westlands’ malls and nightlife.

More Homes at Golden Hill and Nearby

  • Golden Hill Type B: 3-bedroom forest residence with master terrace and DSQ, 230.47 sqm from KES 39.49M
  • Golden Hill Type A: 4-bedroom forest residence with private elevator and DSQ, 379.39 sqm from KES 65.79M

More properties in Westlands

  • Brookside Oak Residency, Muguga Green: 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from KES 8.2M
  • Zoa Samima Apartments, Raphta Road: 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from KES 11.54M
  • Golden Mansion, Muthithi Road: 1 to 3 bedroom apartments from KES 6.5M
  • Diplomat Residencies, Peponi Road: 1 and 2 bedroom apartments from KES 5M
  • Browse all properties for sale in Westlands

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a home at Golden Hill cost?

The Type B of 230.47 sqm starts at KES 39,493,339 and runs to KES 53,598,103. The Type C of 287.97 sqm runs from KES 51,108,916 to KES 66,970,303. The Type A of 379.39 sqm runs from KES 65,786,226 to KES 96,744,450, and the Type D of 514.82 sqm is listed at KES 126,027,936. Prices vary by floor, orientation and forest aspect.

Golden Hill is on Donyo Sabuk Avenue in Upper Westlands, Nairobi, overlooking Karura Forest, about 1 km from Westgate Mall and Sarit Centre. Block Real Estate arranges private site visits.

A KES 1,000,000 reservation secures a residence, a 20% deposit is paid on signing the sale agreement, and the balance is paid in instalments during construction. Ask Block Real Estate for the current schedule for the residence you choose.

The developer broke ground on 24 February 2026 and targets handover on 30 November 2028. As with any off-plan purchase, check construction progress on site and the completion clauses in the sale agreement.

There are 102 residences across four types, which keeps density low and privacy high. Types B and C are 3-bedroom homes with 4 washrooms and a DSQ. Types A and D are 4-bedroom homes with 5 washrooms and a DSQ, and the Type D also has two living rooms.

Does every home at Golden Hill have a private elevator?

Yes. Each residence has a dedicated private elevator and its own elevator hall, so you travel from the underground parking to your front door without passing through a shared corridor or landing. Underground parking averages two spaces per household.

Who is the developer of Golden Hill?

Golden Hill is developed by SkyPeak Limited, part of Xiangfeng Group. Block Real Estate is the authorised sales agent. Ask us for the developer’s completed-project record as part of your due diligence.

What amenities does Golden Hill offer?

A heated infinity pool, a spa with relaxation rooms, a gym with forest views, a private residents’ lounge, riverside and family event lawns, reading and meditation gardens, and indoor and outdoor play areas for children. The building has 24-hour manned security, a standby generator, on-site water storage and high-speed elevators.

Can I buy at Golden Hill from abroad?

Yes. Block Real Estate arranges virtual viewings, emails the brochure, floor plans and price list, and works with your advocate in Kenya so the reservation, sale agreement and payments are handled remotely.

A well-placed one bedroom apartment can be the simplest, most practical way to own in Nairobi. Avana Oasis, at 521 Riara Road, offers two one-bedroom sizes of 60 sqm and 70 sqm, in a development designed around light, warm timber and quiet, considered living.

The residences start from KES 7.1 million for the 60 sqm home and KES 8.4 million for the 70 sqm home. Buyers can secure a unit with a 20% reservation fee and spread the balance over 36 months in quarterly instalments. Beyond the front door, residents share a heated lounge pool, a gym, a yoga and wellness space, a library, a cafeteria and concierge service.

Whether you are buying your first home, downsizing, or adding a smaller unit to your portfolio, these one-bedroom residences sit in a central address with malls, schools, hospitals and major roads close by.

Project Snapshot

A Development Designed for Calm, Considered Urban Living

The one-bedroom homes at Avana Oasis are designed to feel generous without being large. The brochure highlights open layouts that let light reach every corner, warm timber panelling against a clean, pale palette, and proportions considered carefully even at a one-bedroom scale.

Some residences also include a private balcony, outdoor space that belongs to your home rather than the building. Downstairs, the shared spaces do the work of a larger house: a garden walk for a slow evening, a library for quiet, a lounge pool for weekends, and a yoga and wellness space for the morning.

It is a way of living that trades square metres for quality of light, material and setting.

Unit Types

Design details

  • Open layouts planned so natural light reaches every corner
  • Warm timber panelling against a pale, clean palette
  • Living room, bedroom and bathroom designed with a consistent material language
  • Private balconies in selected residences

The brochure shows four plan types (A1 to A4), and interior visuals for A2, A3 and A4. Which plan type corresponds to which size, along with bathroom counts, kitchen layouts and balcony availability per unit, is to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Please request the latest floor plans.

Why It Works for Homeowners

  • A manageable entry point. Starting from KES 7.1M, the one-bedroom residences suit first-time buyers and those right-sizing.
  • Thoughtful, light-filled design. Open layouts, pale palettes and warm timber make the homes feel bigger and calmer than their footprint suggests.
  • Amenities that extend your space. A pool, gym, library, yoga space and cafeteria mean you do not need a large home to have room to live.
  • A phased payment structure. A 36-month quarterly plan after the reservation fee can make the purchase easier to plan around, subject to the final schedule.
  • A connected address. Malls, schools, hospitals and major roads are within easy reach, which suits a busy, low-maintenance routine.
  • Choice of two sizes. The 60 sqm and 70 sqm options let buyers match space to budget.

Why It Works for Investors

Smaller units can be a practical way to enter a well-known Nairobi neighbourhood, and Avana Oasis pairs them with a strong amenity offering.

  • Lower entry price. One-bedroom residences from KES 7.1M and KES 8.4M give investors a more accessible ticket size.

  • Established demand drivers. Proximity to malls, schools, hospitals and major roads supports general interest in the area.

These are the developer’s own projections. They are not guaranteed, and Block Real Estate has not independently verified them. Actual income depends on furnishing costs, occupancy, management fees, service charges and market conditions. At Avana Oasis, 521 Riara Road, Nairobi, close to The Junction Mall, Prestige Plaza, Yaya Centre and Lavington Mall.

Two sizes: 60 sqm and 70 sqm.

The 60 sqm residence starts from KES 7.1M and the 70 sqm from KES 8.4M. Confirm exact unit pricing at point of enquiry.

A 20% reservation fee within 2 weeks of reservation, then the balance in quarterly instalments over 36 months.

The brochure shows private balconies in selected residences. Confirm which units have them at point of enquiry.

A heated lounge pool, fitness gym, yoga and wellness space, kids club, library, cafeteria, residents and garden lounges, meeting room, concierge and valet parking, among others.

Oasisquorra Homes Ltd, which describes itself as a Chinese real estate development company building residential, commercial and mixed-use projects in Kenya.

The developer projects 14% to 18% for one-bedroom units depending on size and furnishing, but these are not guaranteed. We recommend requesting the basis for the figures and taking independent advice.

When will the development be complete?
To be confirmed at point of enquiry.

Are the apartments sold furnished?
Not confirmed. Please ask what is included with each residence.

No. The developer states that it is illustrative and subject to change. Confirm all details with the developer and your advocate.

If a light-filled one bedroom on Riara Road sounds like the right fit, speak to the Block Real Estate team. We will share the latest floor plans, price list and payment schedule, help you compare the 60 sqm and 70 sqm options and arrange a private viewing.

listings.content_html:
Kings Pinnacle offers exclusive 2 & 3 bedroom apartments in Westlands, Nairobi. Low-density living, rooftop lounge, prime Jalaram Road location. Enquire with Block Real Estate.Kings Pinnacle – Luxury 2 & 3 Bedroom Apartments in Westlands, Nairobi

Tucked along Jalaram Road in the heart of Westlands, Kings Pinnacle is a low-density residential development built for those who want more space, more privacy, and a genuinely liveable address in one of Nairobi’s most established neighbourhoods. Developed by Kings Developers Limited and launched on 15th July 2026, the project is limited to just 36 residences — 18 two-bedroom and 18 three-bedroom apartments — a deliberate choice that sets it apart from the high-density apartment blocks that have come to define much of Westlands’ skyline.

Whether you’re a family looking for a long-term home, a professional wanting proximity to the business district, or an investor targeting Nairobi’s executive rental market, Kings Pinnacle is worth a closer look.

Project Snapshot

For the most current pricing, unit availability, floor plans and payment structure, please request the latest brochure from our team.

A Development Designed for Considered, Low-Density Living

Kings Pinnacle isn’t trying to be everything to everyone — and that’s part of its appeal. With a limited collection of two-bedroom en-suite apartments and three-bedroom units complete with a self-contained domestic staff quarter, the development is built around a quieter, more private residential experience. Each typical floor holds just two apartments — one two-bedroom and one three-bedroom — arranged around a private central lobby served by two high-speed elevators.

The architecture leans into a biophilic design approach: large windows, private balconies, decorative façade screens, landscaped terraces and rooftop greenery all work together to bring natural light, ventilation and a sense of openness into everyday living. It’s a building designed to feel calm rather than crowded — a rare quality in Westlands’ current apartment landscape.

Unit Types

Two-Bedroom En-Suite Apartments — Approx. 1,200 sq ft

Designed with privacy in mind, both bedrooms are positioned away from the main entertainment area, making the layout comfortable for hosting guests.

  • Two en-suite bedrooms
  • Two full bathrooms
  • Separate guest cloakroom
  • Open-plan living and dining room
  • Semi-open fitted kitchen with breakfast counter
  • Pantry and storage provision
  • Laundry and utility yard
  • Built-in wardrobes
  • Private balcony
  • Large windows with natural lighting and ventilation

Best suited for: professionals, couples, smaller families, downsizers, and investors targeting long-term executive tenants.

Three-Bedroom Apartments with DSQ — Approx. 1,600 sq ft

Built for family living, this unit type includes a self-contained domestic staff quarter with its own separate entrance and bathroom — a practical addition for households that need it.

  • Three en-suite bedrooms
  • Self-contained DSQ with separate entrance and bathroom
  • Guest cloakroom near the entrance
  • Spacious living and dining area
  • Modern fitted kitchen with breakfast counter
  • Inbuilt pantry
  • Laundry and utility yard
  • Built-in wardrobes
  • Large private balcony with elevated city views

Best suited for: families, diaspora purchasers, senior professionals, and investors targeting larger executive households.

Exact unit numbers, floor positions and remaining availability should be confirmed at point of enquiry.

Launch Pricing by Floor

Kings Pinnacle’s residential units begin from the 5th floor upward, with the ground to 4th floors reserved for secure resident parking. Launch pricing is tiered by floor level as follows:

2-Bedroom Apartment (includes 1 parking space)

3-Bedroom Apartment (includes 2 parking spaces)

Pricing above reflects launch-phase rates and is subject to change as units are sold; we understand pricing may be revised at intervals during the sales period. Buyers should confirm current pricing and unit-specific availability directly with our team before proceeding.

Amenities

Kings Pinnacle’s shared spaces are designed to support both everyday family life and a more social, lifestyle-led way of living:

  • Landscaped rooftop lounge and social terrace with panoramic Westlands views
  • Firepit-style relaxation space
  • Rooftop serving and refreshment counter
  • Pergola and sheltered seating areas
  • Multi-purpose community hall
  • Children’s outdoor play area
  • Landscaped communal spaces
  • Two high-speed elevators
  • Secured resident entrance with 24-hour professional security
  • Generator backup for common areas
  • Integrated waste-segregation facilities

The rooftop lounge in particular stands out as a genuine lifestyle amenity — a shared space for sunset relaxation, casual gatherings or private celebrations, rather than an afterthought tacked onto the building’s design.

Location Advantage

Positioned on Jalaram Road, close to the Oshwal Community Centre and cricket grounds, Kings Pinnacle sits within one of Nairobi’s most connected and established residential and commercial pockets.

Convenient access to:

  • Westlands business district
  • Waiyaki Way and the Nairobi Expressway
  • Parklands, Kileleshwa and Nairobi CBD

Nearby lifestyle, education and healthcare destinations:

  • Westgate Shopping Mall and Sarit Centre
  • Oshwal Academy, Consolata School and Nairobi School
  • MP Shah Hospital and Avenue Hospital
  • Nairobi Arboretum and Karura Forest

For professionals working in Westlands, multinational-company employees, and families prioritising school proximity, this location offers a practical balance of connectivity and residential calm — the kind of address that tends to hold its appeal over time.

Payment Plan

Kings Pinnacle offers a structured instalment plan for buyers purchasing off-plan:

  • 20% deposit to secure your preferred unit
  • Balance payable over 36 months, commencing 1st August 2026
  • Instalments are arranged through post-dated cheques or a standing order

Groundbreaking is expected in early 2027, with completion anticipated within three years of that date. As with any off-plan purchase, we recommend requesting the latest official price list, payment schedule and sale agreement from our team, and reviewing the construction timeline and developer track record before committing.

Why It Works for Homeowners

For buyers looking for a place to actually live, Kings Pinnacle offers a combination that’s harder to find in Westlands than it should be: generous unit sizes, genuine privacy between bedrooms and living spaces, and a low-density building with only two apartments per floor. The separate guest cloakrooms, private balconies and (for the three-bedroom units) self-contained DSQ all point to a design that has thought through daily household life rather than just the show-flat moment.

The rooftop lounge, community hall and children’s play area add a layer of shared lifestyle amenity that suits families and individuals who want more than just four walls — without the density of larger apartment complexes nearby.

Why It Works for Investors

Westlands remains one of Nairobi’s most established rental and resale markets, with sustained demand from professionals and multinational employees drawn to its business district location. Kings Pinnacle’s limited unit count of 36 residences may appeal to investors seeking a lower-density asset in a high-demand micro-location, and the mix of two- and three-bedroom configurations offers some flexibility in targeting different tenant profiles.

Buyers purchasing during the launch phase should note that pricing is tiered by floor level, and the developer has indicated that rates may be revised as units are sold. This is a feature of the sales structure rather than a guarantee of value growth, and it should be weighed alongside your own market research.

As with any property investment, prospective buyers should conduct independent due diligence on rental demand, pricing trends, the developer’s track record and comparable developments in the area. We’re happy to share what market information is available on request, but we do not make specific claims about rental yields, occupancy, or capital appreciation — these should be assessed with your own advisors.

Finishes and Specifications

Kings Pinnacle’s interiors are designed around a warm, contemporary palette combining timber-style finishes, clean white surfaces and large glazed openings.

Proposed specification includes:

  • Quality fitted wardrobes
  • Branded sanitary fittings
  • Modern fitted kitchens with high-quality countertops
  • Tiled kitchen splashbacks
  • Semi-open kitchen layouts with breakfast counters
  • Premium floor and wall finishes
  • Large windows for natural lighting and ventilation
  • Private balconies
  • Dedicated laundry areas

Please note: furniture, décor and appliances shown in architectural renders are illustrative only. Final included finishes, fittings and appliances should be confirmed through the official specification schedule and sale agreement.

Who This Development Suits Best

  • Families seeking a low-density home close to leading schools
  • Professionals and multinational employees working in or near Westlands
  • Diaspora buyers looking for a well-located Nairobi asset
  • Downsizers wanting space without the upkeep of a standalone house
  • Investors targeting Nairobi’s executive rental market
  • Buyers who value privacy, natural light and shared lifestyle amenities over high-density living

FAQ

Where exactly is Kings Pinnacle located? Kings Pinnacle is located on Jalaram Road in Westlands, Nairobi, close to the Oshwal Community Centre and cricket grounds.

How many units are in the development? The development is limited to 36 residences in total — 18 two-bedroom apartments and 18 three-bedroom apartments — with two units per typical floor.

What unit sizes are available? Two-bedroom apartments measure approximately 1,200 sq ft (111.5 sqm), while three-bedroom apartments measure approximately 1,600 sq ft (148.6 sqm) and include a self-contained domestic staff quarter.

What is the starting price? Launch pricing starts from Ksh 14,000,000 for a two-bedroom unit and Ksh 18,000,000 for a three-bedroom unit, with prices increasing on higher floors. Please enquire for the latest unit-specific and floor-specific pricing, as launch rates are subject to revision as units sell.

Does the price include parking? Yes. Two-bedroom units include one parking space and three-bedroom units include two parking spaces, located across the ground to 4th floors.

Is a payment plan available? Yes. The standard plan requires a 20% deposit to secure a unit, with the balance payable over 36 months from 1st August 2026, arranged via post-dated cheques or a standing order. Contact our team to confirm current terms.

What amenities does Kings Pinnacle offer? Amenities include a rooftop lounge and social terrace, a multi-purpose community hall, a children’s play area, two high-speed elevators, 24-hour security, generator backup for common areas, and integrated waste-segregation facilities.

Is this development suitable for rental investment? Westlands is an established rental market with consistent demand from professionals and multinational employees. We recommend independent due diligence on rental performance and comparable properties before making an investment decision.

When is the expected completion date? Groundbreaking is expected in early 2027, with construction anticipated to take approximately three years thereafter. Buyers should confirm the latest timeline with our team, as off-plan schedules can shift.

Call to Action

Interested in Kings Pinnacle? Get in touch with Block Real Estate for the latest brochure, floor plans, pricing and payment schedule.

Mogotio Oasis is an off-plan development at 11 Mogotio Road, Westlands, Nairobi, directly behind the Global Trade Centre. Studio, one, two and three-bedroom apartments are for sale from KES 5,800,000, completing June 2028, with floor areas confirmed at enquiry. The developer is the Oasis Group; residents share a swimming pool, gym and yoga room.

Listing updated: 24 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

Floor areas, bathroom counts, the payment schedule and the tenure on offer are not published in the material we hold for this listing, so we have left those rows out rather than print a figure we cannot stand behind. All four are confirmed at the point of enquiry, in writing.

About Mogotio Oasis

Mogotio Oasis is a new-build apartment development at No. 11 Mogotio Road in Westlands, next door to Reliable Towers. Mogotio Road runs behind the Global Trade Centre, which puts the building inside the Westlands commercial core while keeping it off the arterial roads that carry the traffic.

One point worth stating plainly, because the two are easy to confuse: Mogotio Oasis is a separate development on its own plot behind the GTC. It is not an apartment within the Global Trade Centre complex. If it is apartments inside the GTC itself that you are after, that is a different listing, and it is linked further down this page.

The development spans the full range of Westlands apartment demand, from a studio at KES 5,800,000 through to a three-bedroom at KES 18,300,000. Completion is scheduled for June 2028, so every unit is an off-plan purchase reserved now and handed over on completion.

Price List by Unit Type

These are from-prices. The price payable varies by floor level, orientation and the unit itself, and off-plan availability changes, so ask us for the current price list and remaining availability before you commit.

Studio — from KES 5,800,000

The studio is the entry point into the building: a single open living and sleeping space with its own bathroom and kitchen, and no separate bedroom. At KES 5,800,000 it is the lowest ticket on this stretch of Mogotio Road. The floor area is not published, and on a studio that number matters more than on any other layout, so ask for the plan before you reserve.

1 Bedroom — from KES 7,800,000

The one-bedroom adds a separate bedroom off the living space. It is the layout that suits a single professional or a couple working in the Westlands office cluster, where the GTC, Dunhill Towers and the Waiyaki Way offices are close enough to walk.

2 Bedroom — from KES 12,300,000

The two-bedroom serves couples, small families and anyone who needs a second room for a home office. Bathroom count and whether either bedroom is en suite are not published, so confirm both on the floor plan.

3 Bedroom — from KES 18,300,000

The three-bedroom is the family layout and the top of the range at KES 18,300,000. As with the smaller homes, the floor area, the bathroom count and whether a DSQ is included are all confirmed at enquiry rather than stated here.

Verified Amenities

The list below is limited to amenities the development itself sets out for Mogotio Oasis. Where a facility is named but its specification is not published, we say so rather than fill the gap.

  • Swimming pool — a resident pool within the development
  • Fully equipped gym — a residents gym inside the building, so no external membership is needed
  • Yoga room — a dedicated quiet space separate from the gym floor
  • Children’s play area — a dedicated play space for younger residents
  • Landscaped relaxation spaces — designed outdoor areas within the grounds
  • A golf facility — listed among the resident amenities, but the specification is not published. It could be a putting green, a practice facility or a simulator, and those are very different things. We are asking the developer to confirm it in writing, and we would not advise treating it as a reason to buy until that confirmation is in your hands.

You may see other facilities attached to this listing elsewhere on the site. If a facility is not in the list above, we have not been able to source it from the development material, and you should not assume it forms part of the scheme. Ask us and we will confirm what is actually included.

Location and Connectivity

The stored map pin for this listing places Mogotio Oasis on Mogotio Road within about 150 metres of the two neighbouring Mogotio Road developments we also market, which is consistent with the address. We have deliberately not published a metre distance to the GTC itself: the pin held against our separate GTC Residences listing sits some way off this one, and until we have reconciled the two we would rather describe the relationship as the street does — Mogotio Road runs behind the Global Trade Centre — than quote a figure we cannot stand behind. Ask us and we will confirm the walking route.

We do not publish drive times to the landmarks below. Nairobi journey times on the Westlands corridor vary by a factor of several between an early Sunday morning and a Friday evening on Waiyaki Way, so a single quoted figure would mislead more than it informs. What we can state is which landmarks sit near the address:

  • Global Trade Centre (GTC) — immediately in front of the development, with its offices, mall and the JW Marriott
  • Villa Rosa Kempinski — within the same immediate cluster
  • Sarit Centre and Westgate Mall — both within the Westlands retail core to the north-west
  • Waiyaki Way and the Nairobi Expressway — the access points for the CBD, Upper Hill, Kilimani and JKIA
  • Ring Road Parklands — an alternative route towards Parklands and the northern suburbs

The Developer: the Oasis Group

Mogotio Oasis is being developed by the Oasis Group, whose earlier projects include City Oasis, Riara Oasis, Riara One, 108 Riverside, Metricon Home Oasis and Urban Oasis. On an off-plan purchase the developer is the variable that matters most, and a portfolio of buildings you can drive to and walk through is diligence you can do yourself. Ask us for the addresses and go and look at them.

That track record reduces execution risk. It does not remove it, and no off-plan purchase anywhere is risk-free.

The Investment Case

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that this is a central Westlands address on Mogotio Road, on its own plot directly behind the Global Trade Centre and inside the Westlands commercial cluster; that the entry price of KES 5,800,000 for a studio is the lowest on this stretch of road among the developments we market; and that the developer, the Oasis Group, has completed six earlier projects you can visit. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building’s management rules and on applicable regulations — worth confirming before you buy.

Buying from Abroad

A valid passport or Alien ID is enough to begin. Block Real Estate can register your KRA PIN, handle the paperwork on your behalf, arrange a video walkthrough of the site, and coordinate with your advocate through reservation, payment and transfer. Stamp duty applies on transfer and we will set out the full cost breakdown before you commit.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does an apartment at Mogotio Oasis cost?

Studios start from KES 5,800,000, one-bedroom apartments from KES 7,800,000, two-bedroom apartments from KES 12,300,000 and three-bedroom apartments from KES 18,300,000. These are from-prices and they vary by floor and orientation, so confirm the current price list with us before you reserve.

Where exactly is Mogotio Oasis?

At 11 Mogotio Road, Westlands, Nairobi, next to Reliable Towers and directly behind the Global Trade Centre. It is a separate development on its own plot behind the GTC, not an apartment inside the GTC complex itself. Sarit Centre, Westgate and the Waiyaki Way and Nairobi Expressway access points are all nearby.

When will Mogotio Oasis be completed?

Completion is scheduled for June 2028. This is an off-plan purchase, so you reserve a unit now and take handover on completion. Off-plan timelines can move, so ask us to confirm the current construction stage before you commit.

What payment plan is available at Mogotio Oasis?

The deposit and instalment terms are not published on this listing, so we do not quote them. Request the current payment schedule from Block Real Estate, and budget separately for statutory costs including stamp duty on transfer.

What protections do I have when buying off-plan at Mogotio Oasis?

Instruct your own advocate before you pay anything. Ask for the title on which the development sits, the approved development plans, the sale agreement and the completion date written into it, and what happens to your money if the programme slips. The developer, the Oasis Group, has completed earlier projects you can visit and inspect, which is useful diligence but is not a guarantee. We will put every answer in writing.

What size are the apartments at Mogotio Oasis?

Floor areas per layout are not published on this listing, so we do not state them. Request the current floor plans and unit schedule from Block Real Estate to confirm the square metres for each studio, one, two and three-bedroom layout before you reserve.

Does Mogotio Oasis have a golf club?

A golf facility is listed among the resident amenities for the development. The specification is not published, so we cannot say whether it is a putting green, a practice facility or a simulator. Ask us to confirm it in writing from the developer before you treat it as a reason to buy.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. Diaspora buyers regularly purchase off-plan in Westlands. A valid passport or Alien ID is enough to begin, Block Real Estate can register your KRA PIN and handle the paperwork, arrange a video walkthrough of the site, and coordinate with your advocate through reservation, payment and transfer. Call or WhatsApp 0725 937 686 or email loyd@block.ke.

More Apartments on Mogotio Road and in Westlands

  • Luckinn Ivy Residence, Mogotio Road — 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments of 78 to 172 sqm from KES 9.9M
  • Oak West Residency, Mogotio Road — 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from KES 8.1M, completing November 2027
  • GTC Residences — apartments inside the Global Trade Centre itself, a separate development from Mogotio Oasis
  • Browse all property for sale in Westlands

Book a Viewing at Mogotio Oasis

Speak to Block Real Estate for the floor plans, the current price list and remaining availability, the payment schedule and the tenure on offer — or to arrange a site visit on Mogotio Road. Tell us which layout you have in mind, from the studio to the three-bedroom, and we will send the current options with everything confirmed in writing.

Call or WhatsApp 0725 937 686 · Email loyd@block.ke · Block Real Estate, Upper Hill Gardens, Suite D15, Upper Hill, Nairobi · View this listing: Mogotio Oasis, Mogotio Road

listings.content_html:
Karura Forest Views is a twin-tower development on Ring Road at the Eldama Ravine Roundabout, Westlands, Nairobi, offering 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 bedroom duplex apartments for sale from KES 6,970,000. Homes range from 82 sqm to 335 sqm, look out over Karura Forest, and share a rooftop running track, swimming pool, gym and on-site supermarket.

Listing updated: 14 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

Some addresses in Nairobi ask you to choose between a green outlook and a central location. This one doesn’t. Set in a landmark twin-tower development on Ring Road at the Eldama Ravine Roundabout — on the quiet border between Parklands and Westlands — these apartments look out over the tranquil canopy of Karura Forest, while sitting a short walk from Oshwal Centre and a few minutes from Sarit Centre, Westgate and two of the city’s leading hospitals.

The development spans a full range of homes, from efficient one-bedroom apartments through to substantial family residences and a five-bedroom duplex. Whether you are a professional buying your first place, a family in need of real space, a diaspora buyer looking for a Nairobi base, or an investor weighing a well-located asset, there is a layout here designed with you in mind. With only three units per floor across the two towers, the everyday experience is one of genuine privacy rather than a crowded corridor.

Project Snapshot

  • Location: Ring Road, at the Eldama Ravine Roundabout — Parklands / Westlands border, Nairobi
  • Outlook: Panoramic views over Karura Forest
  • Development: Landmark twin-tower residential development
  • Homes available: 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5-bedroom (duplex) apartments
  • Sizes: From 82 sqm (883 sqft) to 335 sqm (3,606 sqft)
  • Pricing: From KES 6.97M
  • Layout density: Three units per floor, across two towers
  • Completion: December 2028 (to be confirmed at point of enquiry)
  • Payment: Up to 3 years — 30% deposit, balance over the remaining period; buyer-proposed plans considered
  • Diaspora buyers: Passport or Alien ID is enough to begin; Block handles the KRA PIN and paperwork

A Development Designed for Modern Urban Living

This is a building designed to work as a small, self-contained community. Commercial shops, a café and a supermarket sit within the development itself, so much of daily life happens without leaving home. Above them, the residential floors are kept deliberately low-density — three units per floor — which gives every home a sense of space that carries beyond the front door.

The homes themselves are built around how people actually live. Across the range you’ll find spacious lounges, contemporary kitchens designed as proper working spaces, and comfortable en-suite master bedrooms. The larger family units add separate dining areas and a DSQ (domestic staff quarters), while the five-bedroom duplex is arranged over two levels for households that want the feel of a house with the convenience of an apartment.

And then there is the forest. Waking up to green rather than concrete, in a part of Westlands this well connected, is a quality-of-life difference that is genuinely hard to replicate elsewhere in the city.

Unit Types and Prices

Every home in the development shares the same core specification — modern finishes, a spacious lounge, a contemporary kitchen and an en-suite master — with the larger units adding a separate dining area and a DSQ. The combined range is below.

A short guide to who each layout tends to suit:

  • 1 Bedroom (82 sqm): Well-suited to professionals and first-time buyers, or as a compact, well-located home in an established rental area.
  • 2 Bedroom (120–160 sqm): A flexible choice for couples and small families, with a range of sizes to match your space and budget.
  • 3 Bedroom (200 sqm): A comfortable family home with room to grow, in a secure, amenity-rich building.
  • 4 Bedroom (230 & 250 sqm): Substantial family residences with a separate dining area, en-suite master and a DSQ — the space of a house with the ease of an apartment.
  • 5 Bedroom Duplex (335 sqm): The largest home in the development, arranged over two levels for households that want maximum space and privacy.

Floor plans, the current price list, unit-by-unit availability and the specific configuration of each layout (including bathroom counts and DSQ inclusion) are shared on request — please ask us for the latest at point of enquiry.

Amenities

The development is designed for convenience and lifestyle in equal measure:

  • Commercial shops and offices on site
  • Café and supermarket
  • Multi-floor parking, plus ample visitor parking
  • High-speed lifts (number to be confirmed at point of enquiry)
  • Gym and steam room
  • Rooftop running track
  • Swimming pool
  • Community hall
  • Children’s playground
  • Power backup generator
  • CCTV and security intercom

Having a supermarket, café and shops within the building is the kind of detail that quietly improves daily life — particularly for families, busy professionals and anyone who values not having to drive out for the small things.

Location Advantage

This stretch of Ring Road sits on the border of Parklands and Westlands, one of Nairobi’s most established and well-connected neighbourhoods. It is a genuinely walkable, well-serviced part of the city, and the forest outlook gives it a calm that is rare this close to the commercial centre.

  • Everyday shopping and leisure: A short walk to Oshwal Centre and The Oval; a five-minute drive to Sarit Centre and Westgate Mall
  • Healthcare: Close to Aga Khan University Hospital and MP Shah Hospital
  • International institutions: Minutes from the US Embassy and the UN headquarters
  • Green space: Direct views over Karura Forest, with the forest itself nearby for walking, cycling and weekends outdoors

This is a mature, diverse area that has long drawn diplomats, expatriates, medical professionals and senior corporate tenants and residents. That established profile is one of the reasons the location holds its appeal for both those who want to live here and those buying with the longer term in mind.

Payment Plan

The development offers up to three years of payment flexibility:

  • 30% deposit to secure your unit
  • Balance spread across the remaining period

You are also welcome to propose your own payment plan. If it is approved, you secure the unit immediately — a practical option for buyers whose cash flow doesn’t fit a standard schedule.

Exact instalment structures, dates and any applicable terms are confirmed in your offer and sale agreement. Ask us for the current payment schedule at point of enquiry.

Why It Works for Homeowners

The appeal is straightforward: secure, amenity-rich homes in a neighbourhood that already has the schools, hospitals, shopping and social life you need close at hand. The range of sizes means the building suits you at different life stages — from a first one-bedroom to a family four-bedroom or the duplex — and the low density (three units per floor) means privacy without isolation.

The forest outlook is the part that is hard to replicate. For buyers who want a settled, long-term Nairobi home rather than a stepping stone, waking up to green in a part of Westlands this well connected is a quality-of-life difference that tends to matter more the longer you live somewhere.

Why It Works for Investors

We keep our investor guidance honest: we don’t publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell — and no one can guarantee them. What we can point to is the underlying fundamentals of the asset.

The location sits in an established, high-demand corridor with a deep and varied tenant base — diplomatic, medical, corporate and expatriate. Forest-edge sites along this part of Ring Road are limited, which supports the long-term distinctiveness of a well-built home here. The spread of unit types also gives you options: smaller units suit a different tenant profile and entry point than the larger family homes, so you can match your purchase to your strategy.

For your own due diligence, we’re happy to help you review recent comparable sales and rentals in the area and connect you with independent advisers. We’d always encourage you to run your own numbers before committing.

Across the range, homes are delivered with modern finishes throughout:

  • Spacious lounge, with a separate dining area in the larger units

  • En-suite master bedroom
  • DSQ (domestic staff quarters) included in the larger family units

Prices start at KES 6,970,000 for a 1 bedroom of 82 sqm. Commercial shops and offices, a cafe and supermarket, multi-floor parking plus ample visitor parking, high-speed lifts, a gym and steam room, a rooftop running track, a swimming pool, a community hall and a children’s playground, backed by a power backup generator and CCTV with security intercom.

Development at a Glance

Amber Bay Heights is a contemporary residential development on General Mathenge Drive, offering studio, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments for sale in Westlands, Nairobi.

Designed for residents who value city convenience, well-planned living spaces and access to lifestyle amenities, the development places homeowners and investors within easy reach of Westlands’ established business, shopping, dining and entertainment destinations.

The advertised price range and availability may change as units are reserved or released. Buyers should request the latest price list, floor plans and payment schedule before making a purchase decision.

A Development Designed for Connected Urban Living

Amber Bay Heights is positioned for buyers who want to live close to the centre of Westlands without giving up the privacy and comfort of a modern residential development.

Its General Mathenge Drive location makes it suitable for professionals working within Westlands and surrounding commercial districts, homeowners who want everyday conveniences nearby, and investors considering Nairobi’s corporate accommodation and residential rental markets.

Inside the development, a broad mix of apartment sizes allows buyers to choose according to their lifestyle, budget and intended use. The studios and one-bedroom apartments provide compact urban living, while the two and three-bedroom residences offer additional space for couples, families and buyers who work from home.

Shared lifestyle areas, including a rooftop swimming pool, sky lounge, landscaped garden and fitness facilities, extend the living experience beyond the individual apartment.

One-Bedroom Apartments

  • Price: From KES 8.18 million
  • Deposit: From 30%
  • Balance: Payable within the construction period

At 64.94 sqm, the one-bedroom layout offers more generous living space than a conventional compact city apartment. It may suit professionals, couples, first-time buyers and investors looking for a unit that can serve both long-term tenants and owner-occupiers.

Two-Bedroom Apartments

  • Size: 128.23 sqm (1,380 sq ft)
  • Price: From KES 16.16 million
  • Deposit: From 20%

The comparatively spacious 128.23 sqm layout may also appeal to buyers moving from older, larger apartments who still want a modern development in a central Westlands location.

Three-Bedroom Apartments

The three-bedroom apartments provide the development’s most spacious standard accommodation. They are likely to suit families, senior professionals, diaspora buyers and homeowners looking for a primary residence in Westlands.

Buyers should request the latest price list to confirm which three-bedroom configurations fall within the advertised KES 21.5 million to KES 22.46 million range.

The development is positioned within convenient reach of major Westlands destinations, including Sarit Centre, Westgate Shopping Mall and the Global Trade Centre. Residents can access shopping, dining, offices, hospitality facilities and entertainment without needing to travel across the wider city for everyday requirements.

listings.content_html:
The three-bedroom homes are the most spacious residences at Cambridge Garden — generous, family-sized apartments designed for buyers ready to settle in for the long term. At 158 sqm with a full DSQ, they offer the room and flexibility a growing household needs, in one of Nairobi’s most established and well-connected neighbourhoods.

Prices start from KES 16.1M, with flexible payment terms to completion in October 2028.

The Home

This is comfortable family living with space to spare — three bedrooms, a dedicated servants’ quarter (DSQ), a modern fitted kitchen and a private balcony, all arranged over a generous 158 sqm. It’s a home designed to grow with you rather than one you’ll quickly outgrow. For exact dimensions and layout drawings, request the current floor plans.

Penthouses

Cambridge Garden is crowned by four exclusive penthouses on the top floor — the development’s most premium homes. Penthouse sizes, layouts and pricing are to be confirmed; if you’d like to be among the first to review them, register your interest with us and we’ll share the details as soon as they’re released.

Who It Suits

The three-bedroom home is well suited to:

  • Families wanting a spacious, settled home in a central neighbourhood
  • Buyers ready for the long term who value room to grow
  • Households needing a DSQ for live-in help, guests or a home office
  • Discerning owner-occupiers seeking a larger apartment in an established address

A Central Kilimani Address

On Kindaruma Road, between Car City and Deja Vu Auto Limited, Cambridge Garden offers families the best of central living — Yaya Centre and Prestige Plaza close by for shopping and dining, established schools, hospitals and services nearby, and quick links via Ngong Road and Argwings Kodhek Road to Upper Hill, the CBD and Westlands. Kilimani’s enduring standing as a residential neighbourhood makes larger, well-placed homes like these a considered choice.

Shared Facilities

Residents enjoy the full range of amenities across the development:

  • Rooftop swimming pool and rooftop garden
  • Fully equipped gym
  • Children’s indoor play area
  • Three high-speed lifts
  • Ground, mezzanine and two-level basement parking
  • Borehole and city council water
  • Full backup generator
  • CCTV surveillance and 24-hour security
  • Dedicated hanging line area

Payment Plan

Choose the structure that suits you:

  • Cash purchase: 20% deposit within seven days, balance within 30 days
  • Instalment purchase: 20% deposit within seven days, balance spread monthly or quarterly, with the final 30% due on or before completion
  • Alternative 30% and 50% deposit plans are also available

We’ll prepare a payment schedule tailored to your three-bedroom home on request.

Buying from Abroad

Diaspora buyers are well looked after. A valid passport or Alien ID is all that’s required, Block registers your KRA PIN on your behalf, and the entire process — including the 4% stamp duty — is handled remotely, with no need to travel.

Financing

Financing is available through our partner banks — Absa, Stanbic, NCBA, KCB, HFC, Standard Chartered and Prime Bank — subject to approval.

Estimated Service Charge

3 Bedroom: KES 8,000 per month (indicative, confirmed on allocation).

Frequently Asked Questions

How big is the three-bedroom home? 158 sqm (1,701 sqft), including a DSQ, priced from KES 16.1M.

Does it include a DSQ? Yes — a self-contained domestic staff quarter, useful for live-in help, guests or a home office.

Are penthouses available? Yes, four on the top floor. Sizes and pricing are to be confirmed; register your interest and we’ll share the details when released.

When is completion? October 2028.

Can I purchase from outside Kenya? Yes. A passport or Alien ID is sufficient, Block handles your KRA PIN, and the purchase — including the 4% stamp duty — is completed remotely.
