Set along Kindaruma Road in the heart of Kilimani, Cambridge Garden is a modern off-plan development offering a genuinely wide choice of homes — from compact studios through to spacious three-bedroom apartments with a DSQ. It’s a rare thing in this part of Nairobi: an established, well-connected address with an entry price that opens the door to first-time buyers, growing families and considered investors alike.

Prices start from KES 3.7M, with flexible payment plans running through to completion in October 2028. Whether you’re buying your first home, a place to settle a young family, or a well-located unit to hold in one of Nairobi’s most enduring neighbourhoods, Cambridge Garden is worth a closer look.

Project Snapshot

  • Location: Kindaruma Road, Kilimani, Nairobi
  • Development type: Off-plan residential apartments
  • Structure: One residential block, 20 floors
  • Total homes: 184 apartments
  • Penthouses: 4 (top floor)
  • Layout: Approximately 10 units per typical floor
  • Lifts: 3 high-speed lifts
  • Parking: Ground floor, mezzanine and two basement levels
  • Homes available: Studio, 1, 2 & 3-bedroom (larger units with DSQ)
  • Price from: KES 3.7M
  • Completion: October 2028
  • Developer: Delivered by an experienced team with a track record across Nairobi, including King Garden, Forever Home, Mango Court, Sandal Wood, Royal Garden, Golden Mango Heights, Serenity Residency and Serene Manor

A Development Designed for Everyday Urban Living

Kilimani has long been one of Nairobi’s most liveable neighbourhoods — close enough to the city’s main employment hubs to keep commutes short, yet cushioned by mature streets, cafés, malls and green pockets that make it feel like a place to come home to rather than simply pass through.

Cambridge Garden is designed to sit comfortably within that rhythm. The apartments favour functional, well-proportioned layouts and quality finishes, with private balconies to bring in light and air, and modern fitted kitchens ready for daily life. A rooftop pool and garden give residents somewhere to unwind above the street, while the practical essentials — reliable water, backup power, secure parking and round-the-clock security — are all accounted for.

It’s an address that works whether you’re heading to Upper Hill for the office, meeting friends at Yaya Centre, or simply settling in for a quiet evening at home.

Unit Types

Cambridge Garden offers one of the broadest unit mixes in the submarket, so there’s genuine flexibility to match your budget and the life you’re planning.

Prices depend on the payment plan selected and current unit availability.

Amenities

Cambridge Garden is planned as a complete, self-contained residence, with shared spaces and essential services designed for comfortable city living:

  • Rooftop swimming pool
  • Rooftop garden
  • Fully equipped gym
  • Children’s indoor play area
  • Three high-speed lifts
  • Ground, mezzanine and two-level basement parking
  • Borehole and city council water supply
  • Full backup generator
  • CCTV surveillance
  • 24-hour security
  • Modern fitted kitchens
  • Private balconies
  • Dedicated hanging line area

Additional lifestyle facilities may form part of the final scheme. For a complete, confirmed amenities schedule, please request the current brochure.

Location Advantage

Cambridge Garden enjoys a central Kilimani address on Kindaruma Road, positioned between Car City and Deja Vu Auto Limited, with easy reach of the routes and destinations that matter most:

  • Ngong Road and Argwings Kodhek Road — quick onward connections across the city
  • Yaya Centre and Prestige Plaza — everyday shopping, dining and services close to home
  • Upper Hill and Nairobi CBD — short, practical commutes to two of the city’s main business districts
  • Westlands — within convenient reach for work and leisure
  • Established schools, hospitals and business centres nearby

Kilimani’s blend of connectivity and amenity has made it a consistent choice for professionals, expatriates and families, which in turn supports steady demand for both long-term and furnished rentals in the area.

Payment Plan

Cambridge Garden offers flexible terms structured to suit both local and diaspora buyers, with payments spread through to completion in October 2028.

Cash Purchase

  • 20% deposit within seven days of booking
  • Balance payable within 30 days

Instalment Purchase

  • 20% deposit within seven days of booking
  • Balance paid through scheduled instalments (payable monthly or quarterly)
  • Final 30% payable on or before completion

Alternative 30% and 50% deposit options are also available. For a payment schedule tailored to your chosen unit and preferred plan, please request the current price list and payment breakdown.

Why It Works for Homeowners

For owner-occupiers, Cambridge Garden offers something increasingly hard to find — a brand-new home in an established, central neighbourhood at an accessible entry point. The range of layouts means you can right-size to your stage of life: a studio or one-bedroom to start out, a two-bedroom for a couple settling in, or a three-bedroom with DSQ for a growing family that wants room to breathe.

Day to day, the location does much of the heavy lifting. Short commutes to Upper Hill and the CBD, familiar amenities at Yaya and Prestige Plaza, and reliable water, power and security all add up to a home that’s genuinely easy to live in. The flexible payment terms to 2028 also make it possible to plan the purchase around your own timeline rather than rushing it.

Why It Works for Investors

Cambridge Garden’s appeal to investors rests on the fundamentals rather than any promise of headline figures — and Kilimani gives those fundamentals real weight.

This is one of Nairobi’s most enduring, centrally located residential neighbourhoods, anchored by its proximity to major employment nodes at Upper Hill, the CBD and Westlands, and served by an established tenant catchment of professionals and expatriates. That combination of location and connectivity is not easily replicated, which is precisely what tends to protect the desirability of well-placed stock over time.

There’s a scarcity dimension too. New, well-specified apartments at this entry point, in an address this established, are relatively uncommon — and within a single 184-unit block, only a finite number of each layout exists. Securing off-plan, on flexible terms and ahead of completion, is the practical way to take a position while pricing and availability remain at their most favourable. For a considered buyer, the case is location strength, connectivity and limited supply — not speculation.

Finishes and Specifications

The homes at Cambridge Garden are designed around functional layouts, quality finishes, modern fitted kitchens and private balconies, with a DSQ included on the larger two- and three-bedroom units and four penthouses crowning the top floor.

Detailed finish specifications — flooring, joinery, sanitaryware, kitchen fittings and the full schedule of materials — are best reviewed against the developer’s current documentation. For exact specifications, unit dimensions and layout drawings, please request the latest floor plans, specification sheet and brochure. Any details not confirmed here are to be confirmed at point of enquiry.

Alternative 30% and 50% deposit plans are also available. Request the current payment schedule for full details.

Chestnut City is an 8-acre mixed-use development in Nanyuki with studio to 3-bedroom apartments, Mount Kenya views and full amenities. Enquire with Block.Chestnut City, Nanyuki — Live, Work and Play Beneath Mount KenyaThere is a particular kind of calm that comes with living within sight of Mount Kenya. The air is cooler and cleaner, the pace is gentler, and the views never quite stop earning their keep. Chestnut City brings that setting together with everything a modern day needs close at hand — homes, offices, shops and a hotel — across eight thoughtfully planned acres in the heart of Nanyuki.

This is a development built around a simple idea: that you shouldn’t have to choose between a beautiful place to live and a practical one. Whether you’re buying your first studio, settling a young family into a two-bedroom, or looking for a calm second home a few hours from the city, Chestnut City is designed to make daily life easier and more pleasant in equal measure.

Below you’ll find everything we currently know about the development. Where a detail is still to be confirmed, we’ve said so plainly — and our team is always happy to share the latest brochure, floor plans, price list and payment schedule on request.

Project Snapshot

A Development Designed for Balanced, Everyday Living

Chestnut City is planned as a genuine “live, work and play” community rather than a single apartment block. Four residential towers sit alongside ground-level retail, office space and a hotel, all woven together with green walkways and shared amenities. The result is a walkable, self-contained neighbourhood where the school run, the morning coffee, the gym session and the day’s work can all happen within a few minutes of your front door.

For homeowners, that means convenience without the commute. For the wider community, it means a steady rhythm of life on-site — people coming and going, shops trading, the hotel welcoming guests — which keeps the development feeling lived-in and looked-after rather than quiet and empty.

It’s a setting that suits a range of lives at once: professionals who want to be close to work, families who value space and safety, and Nairobi-based buyers looking for a calmer base near Mount Kenya.

Chestnut City is positioned as a full-amenity address, with shared facilities designed for relaxation, recreation and everyday convenience:

Location Advantage

Nanyuki sits at the foot of Mount Kenya, on the edge of the Laikipia plains — a part of the country known for its cool climate, open landscapes and easy access to some of Kenya’s most celebrated conservancies.

The range of unit sizes also allows buyers to select a home according to their household requirements and budget.

Square-foot figures are conversions from the published square-metre sizes and are rounded to the nearest square foot. Prices are starting prices and should be confirmed against the latest price list.

The two-bedroom category provides several size options, making it possible to choose between a more compact residence and a considerably larger apartment. The larger three-bedroom apartment and penthouses provide substantially more internal space for households looking for a more expansive home.

Choice of space: The development provides multiple two-bedroom sizes, a large three-bedroom apartment and substantially larger penthouses.

Everyday amenities: A gym, swimming pool, sauna, children’s play area, restaurant and coffee bar provide options for recreation without leaving the development.

Pricing note: Jabali Towers is priced in US dollars. The KES figures are Block’s conversions and move with the exchange rate. Prices exclude legal fees, stamp duty and service charge, which the developer sets out in the booking form, offer letter and sale agreement. Block confirms the live price and availability of each unit before you book.

The Development

Jabali Towers is the residential anchor of Tatu Central, the business and lifestyle district of Tatu City — Kenya’s first operational Special Economic Zone. Around the two towers the developer is building a 150-room hotel, 35 shops and restaurants and Grade A office space, so daily needs sit within walking distance of home.

Every apartment has 3-metre ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows and smart-home basics as standard — keyless entry, an intercom and high-speed internet — with an optional Luxury upgrade that adds more advanced smart-home features. The 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments have private balconies.

Residents share a concierge desk, residence garden, infinity pool, gym, steam room and sauna, bar area, multi-function room, games room, kids’ play area and BBQ area.

Location: The Heart of Tatu Central

Tatu City is a 5,000-acre master-planned city in Ruiru, Kiambu County. By July 2026 the developer reported more than 7,000 residents, 35,000+ people working, studying and visiting each day, 110+ businesses and schools with over 6,000 students. The city runs on about 95% renewable energy.

Connectivity (per the developer):

  • Nairobi CBD — about 35 minutes · Westlands — about 30 minutes
  • United Nations (Gigiri) — about 30 minutes · JKIA — about 40 minutes

Developer cash prices as listed on jabalitowers.com on 23 September 2026:

Penthouses are priced on request. See the 1-bedroom listing for layouts and parking. Studios are sold out with the developer; Block keeps a resale waitlist.

Payment Plan & Financing

Per the developer’s FAQ, a booking fee of KES 200,000 (USD 1,550) reserves a unit, a 10% deposit is due within 14 days of the letter of offer, and the remaining 90% is paid in quarterly instalments (monthly on request) over an agreed period ending December 2028. The instalment period ends in December 2028 whatever month you buy, so the later you book, the shorter it is. Block confirms the live schedule with the developer for each unit. Home loans are subject to bank approval — Block can connect you with lenders that finance Tatu City homes.

A KES 200,000 booking fee, a 10% deposit within 14 days of the offer letter, then quarterly (or monthly) instalments with interest on a reducing balance, ending December 2028. A 50% deposit earns a 7% discount and a 30% deposit earns 3.5%.

listings.content_html:
For families and buyers who need genuine room to live — space for children, guests, a home office, or simply more separation and privacy — the three-bedroom apartment at KEZA Riruta is the most generous of the development’s main home types. Developed by Mi Vida Homes, KEZA is a green, planned community in Riruta, near the Kikuyu/Naivasha Road junction, designed around family life: green spaces, courtyards, safe walkways, and a full package of shared amenities.

The three-bedroom Type A apartment is priced from KES 8.5M and laid out for everyday functionality — a lounge, dining area, kitchen, yard, three bedrooms including a master, and a balcony off the living room that brings in light and a sense of openness. It’s a home that can grow with a household, and one that appeals equally to owner-occupiers and to investors targeting long-stay family tenants.

Everything currently confirmed about this home follows, together with the details worth requesting directly before you decide. Where a figure or feature has not yet been formally confirmed by the developer, we’ve said so plainly.

Project Snapshot

A Development Designed for Family Living

KEZA is built around the needs of households — and the three-bedroom apartment is where that focus is most useful.

With three bedrooms, a lounge, a dining area, a kitchen, a yard, and a balcony, the layout is designed for buyers who need more separation, more privacy, and more day-to-day functionality than a one or two-bedroom home can offer. The balcony off the living room adds natural light and a greater sense of openness, while the additional bedrooms flex to suit children, guests, visiting relatives, or a home office.

For a homeowner, that means a home that can grow with the household rather than one you’ll outgrow. For an investor, it means a unit that appeals to families and long-stay tenants who want space, community amenities, and a connected Riruta location.

Unit Types

This page focuses on the 3 Bedroom Type A apartment, the most generous of KEZA’s main typologies.

The size is quoted as a range across layout references in the brochure; the exact size for a specific unit is confirmed on the floor plan. KEZA also includes one and two-bedroom typologies — details available on request.

Floor plans for the Type A apartment are available on request, and we’re happy to talk you through the layout and orientation before you decide.

Amenities

Residents of the three-bedroom apartments enjoy access to KEZA’s full amenity package, including:

  • Mugumo Plaza
  • Courtyards and green spaces
  • Pedestrian promenade and safe walkways
  • Swimming pool
  • Gym
  • Clubhouse
  • Sky garden
  • Kids’ play area
  • Basketball court
  • Retail centre
  • Controlled access

For a family home, the family-friendly amenities matter most: the green spaces, playgrounds, courtyards, and safe walkways make the development genuinely well suited to households with children. The precise specification and any usage terms for these facilities are set out in the brochure, available on request.

Location Advantage

KEZA’s Riruta location, near the Kikuyu/Naivasha Road junction, places residents within easy reach of everyday essentials — shopping, schools, healthcare, and transport links.

Nearby amenities highlighted in the brochure include:

  • Shopping: Junction Mall, Naivas Supermarket, and Quickmart Waithaka
  • Healthcare: Melchizedek Hospital and Kivuli Dispensary
  • Schools: Precious Blood, Harvard Academy, and others
  • Institutions: ILRI (the International Livestock Research Institute)

For families, that means everyday needs are close at hand. For investors, it supports demand from tenants seeking a practical Nairobi home within reach of major employment centres, including Westlands, Upper Hill, and the CBD. Specific distances and drive times can be confirmed at the point of enquiry.

Payment & Financing

KEZA’s three-bedroom apartment is offered on a construction-linked payment structure. The brochure outlines:

  • 20% deposit on the Letter of Offer
  • 10% deposit on the Sale Agreement
  • Balance payable over construction
  • A 24-month payment structure referenced in the brochure

Because payment terms can change, buyers should confirm the latest payment plan with Mi Vida before reserving, and — as with any construction-linked purchase — confirm the build programme and handover timeline. Block will obtain and share the current position as part of your enquiry.

Mortgage financing. For buyers who prefer to finance the purchase, mortgage options are available through several partner banks, including Absa, Stanbic Bank, NCBA, KCB, HFC, Standard Chartered, and Prime Bank. Financing is always subject to each bank’s approval, eligibility, and current terms; the developer may also have specific financing arrangements for KEZA, which we can confirm on request. We’d recommend starting a pre-assessment early, and Block will help you navigate the options and connect you with the right lender.

Full, current payment plan, construction milestones, and financing options: to be confirmed at point of enquiry.

Why It Works for Homeowners

For a family, the three-bedroom apartment offers genuine room to live in a setting designed around household life. The three bedrooms give separation and privacy, the balcony brings light and openness, and the yard and generous living areas add everyday practicality. Just as importantly, KEZA’s green spaces, playgrounds, courtyards, and safe walkways make it a place where children can grow up comfortably, within a controlled-access community. It’s a home that adapts to your household over time — and buying during construction lets you secure your preferred unit ahead of completion.

Why It Works for Investors

For buyers considering the three-bedroom as an investment, the reasoning rests on fundamentals rather than projections. The three-bedroom category appeals to family tenants and long-stay occupants who want space, community amenities, and a connected Riruta location within reach of Nairobi’s employment centres. It can also suit buyers who want a personal home first, with rental flexibility later.

An important, honest note: the developer’s brochure includes projected rent, yield, and capital-appreciation assumptions for this category. These are projections, not guaranteed returns, and we don’t publish or endorse them as assured outcomes. Before purchasing for investment, we’d strongly encourage confirming rental comparables for Riruta, the service charge, property-management terms, and current market demand. Block is glad to share comparable data and give you a straight, considered read so you can reach your own judgement with confidence.

Finishes and Specifications

The three-bedroom Type A apartment is laid out with a lounge, dining area, kitchen, yard, three bedrooms including a master, WCs, and a balcony off the living room.

The full interior finishes and specifications — including kitchen and bathroom fittings, flooring, joinery, and any appliances — are set out in the developer’s specification schedule. As these details can vary, we’d recommend requesting the current specification document and the Type A floor plan, and — where possible — viewing a show unit before you commit.

Detailed finishes and specifications: to be confirmed at point of enquiry.

Who This Development Suits Best

The three-bedroom apartment at KEZA Riruta is ideal for:

  • Families looking for a Nairobi home with genuine space
  • Buyers needing more room than a one or two-bedroom apartment can provide
  • Diaspora buyers planning a Nairobi base
  • Investors targeting long-stay family tenants
  • Owner-occupiers who value amenities and green space
  • Buyers seeking a balcony unit in a planned, controlled-access community

It’s less suited to buyers seeking a compact, low-cost city unit, or a standalone home with a large private garden.

A Note on Shared Amenities and Service Charge

As a planned community with an extensive shared-amenity package — pool, gym, clubhouse, green spaces, retail, and controlled access among them — KEZA will carry a service charge to run and maintain these facilities. The current service charge and exactly what it covers are worth confirming in writing before you commit, and Block will help you obtain those details as part of your enquiry.

Buying From the Diaspora

Buying from abroad is straightforward, and we handle the complexity on your behalf. A passport or Alien ID is sufficient to purchase — Block handles your KRA PIN registration and guides you through the 4% stamp duty and the rest of the process. Remote purchase is fully supported, so you can complete without needing to travel, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage, including arranging a virtual walkthrough of the show unit and the neighbourhood.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where exactly is KEZA Riruta located? In Riruta, Nairobi, near the Kikuyu/Naivasha Road junction — close to Junction Mall, Naivas and Quickmart, reputable schools including Precious Blood, and healthcare at Melchizedek Hospital, with access to employment centres including Westlands, Upper Hill, and the CBD.

How big is the three-bedroom apartment, and what does it cost? It’s approximately 75.3–85 sqm (811–915 sqft) depending on the layout reference, priced from KES 8.5M. The exact size and price for a specific unit are confirmed on the floor plan and current price list.

What’s included in the layout? A lounge, dining area, kitchen, yard, three bedrooms including a master, WCs, and a balcony off the living room.

What amenities does KEZA offer? A full package including Mugumo Plaza, courtyards and green spaces, a pedestrian promenade, a swimming pool, a gym, a clubhouse, a sky garden, a kids’ play area, a basketball court, a retail centre, and controlled access.

What is the payment plan? The brochure outlines a 20% deposit on the Letter of Offer, a 10% deposit on the Sale Agreement, and the balance over construction, within a referenced 24-month structure. We recommend confirming the latest plan with Mi Vida before reserving.

Is mortgage financing available? Yes — mortgage options are available through several partner banks, including Absa, Stanbic, NCBA, KCB, HFC, Standard Chartered, and Prime Bank, subject to approval and current terms. The developer may also have specific financing arrangements for KEZA, which we can confirm.

When will it be completed? The completion and handover timeline is to be confirmed. As the payment plan is construction-linked, please request the current programme directly and we’ll share it.

What about the investment projections in the brochure? The developer’s brochure includes projected rent, yield, and capital-appreciation assumptions. These are projections, not guaranteed returns. We’d recommend confirming rental comparables, the service charge, property-management terms, and current market demand before purchasing for investment.

Can I buy while living abroad? Yes. A passport or Alien ID is enough to purchase, Block handles your KRA PIN registration, and we support the full process — including the 4% stamp duty — remotely.

Ready to Take a Closer Look?

If the three-bedroom home at KEZA Riruta feels like the right fit — whether as your family’s next home or a considered investment — the best next step is to see the detail for yourself. We can share the latest brochure, floor plans, price list, and payment schedule, confirm the current construction and handover timeline, and arrange a site visit or a remote walkthrough at a time that suits you.

Explore KEZA Laika by Mi Vida, an urban green living development near the Kikuyu/Naivasha Road Junction. Discover premium studios, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments with landscaped courtyards, Mugumo Plaza, gym, pool, clubhouse, sky garden and strong investment appeal.

KEZA Laika by Mi Vida is a thoughtfully planned urban green living development designed for buyers who want affordability, convenience, community and long-term value within Nairobi.

Set in Riruta, near the Kikuyu/Naivasha Road Junction, KEZA brings together premium studios, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom and 3 bedroom apartments within a residential environment shaped around green spaces, courtyards, walkways and lifestyle amenities. It is designed as an urban oasis, giving residents access to modern apartments while preserving a calmer, more natural living experience.

For homeowners, KEZA offers a practical way to own a well-designed home in a connected Nairobi location. For investors, it presents a rental-focused opportunity within an area that serves residents commuting to Westlands, Upper Hill, the CBD and nearby employment corridors.

Project Snapshot

Development: KEZA Laika
Developer: Mi Vida Homes
Location: Riruta, near the Kikuyu/Naivasha Road Junction, Nairobi
Property Types: Premium Studios, 1 Bedroom, 2 Bedroom and 3 Bedroom Apartments
Development Concept: Urban green living
Land Size: Approximately 7.5 acres according to the brochure
Masterplan Vision: Around 1,400 residential units according to the brochure
Current Status: Phase 1 handed over, Phase 2 selling, based on current official Mi Vida updates
Target Buyer: First-time homeowners, investors, young professionals, small families, diaspora buyers and rental-income buyers

A Development Designed Around Urban Green Living

KEZA is built around the idea of creating a calmer residential experience inside the city. Instead of treating green space as an afterthought, the development places landscape, walkability and community at the centre of the masterplan.

The project brings together apartment blocks, courtyards, plazas, walkways and recreational spaces to create a more connected living environment. The result is a development that supports both private home life and shared community life.

This makes KEZA especially attractive for buyers who want a practical Nairobi home without losing access to open spaces, social areas and lifestyle amenities.

The Mugumo Plaza

At the heart of KEZA is the Mugumo Plaza, built around a mature fig tree that gives the development a strong sense of identity. The plaza is designed as a central gathering space where residents can relax, connect and enjoy outdoor community life.

This is one of the most distinctive features of KEZA. It gives the development a memorable character and supports the broader urban green living theme.

The Mugumo Plaza, courtyards and landscaped areas help create a residential environment that feels more grounded and people-focused than a standard apartment estate.

Amenities at KEZA Laika

These amenities help KEZA feel like a complete residential environment. They also strengthen tenant appeal for investors, especially in a market where renters increasingly value lifestyle, walkability and access to shared spaces.

Location Advantage

KEZA is located in Riruta, close to the Kikuyu/Naivasha Road Junction and within reach of key Nairobi employment and lifestyle corridors.

The brochure highlights nearby destinations and services including Junction Mall, Naivas Supermarket, Quickmart Waithaka, Melchizedek Hospital, Precious Blood, Harvard Academy, ILRI and Kivuli Dispensary.

This location gives residents access to shopping, schools, healthcare, public transport connections and major routes into areas such as Westlands, Upper Hill and the CBD.

For homeowners, this means daily convenience. For investors, it supports a broader tenant base made up of working professionals, small families, students, healthcare workers, commuters and first-time renters looking for affordable, well-managed housing.

Why KEZA Works for Homebuyers

KEZA is well suited for buyers who want to own in Nairobi without stretching into the city’s higher-priced apartment markets. The development offers compact and practical apartment layouts, a strong amenity package and a planned community environment.

It is especially relevant for first-time homeowners, young professionals, small families and buyers looking for an accessible home with more lifestyle value than a standard apartment block.

The presence of green spaces, walkways, courtyards, play areas and community amenities makes the development feel more livable for long-term occupation.

Why KEZA Works for Investors

For investors, KEZA offers a combination of accessible pricing, rental demand, property management support and a strong lifestyle proposition.

The brochure positions KEZA as an investment opportunity with developer-projected rental yields exceeding 8% and medium-term return potential. These figures should be treated as projections, not guaranteed returns. Actual performance will depend on purchase price, unit type, rental strategy, service charge, furnishing costs, management costs, occupancy and prevailing market conditions.

The project’s compact unit mix also supports rental flexibility. Studios and 1 bedroom units can appeal to single professionals and students, while 2 and 3 bedroom units can appeal to small families and long-stay tenants.

Mi Vida’s property management arm is also presented as a support option for investors who want their units managed within the estate.

Buyers should request the latest payment plan, reservation terms, sales agreement and updated price sheet before committing.

Amenities include Mugumo Plaza, courtyards, green spaces, pedestrian promenade, gym, swimming pool, clubhouse, sky garden, kids’ play area, retail centre, basketball court and controlled access.

KEZA is positioned as an investment-friendly development due to its accessible entry prices, rental demand, green amenities and Mi Vida property management support. Buyers should verify rental projections, service charges and operating costs before purchase.

Yes. KEZA is suitable for first-time homeowners looking for an accessible Nairobi apartment with amenities, green space and community living.

For buyers who want the feel of a house within a contemporary building, the two-bedroom duplex at Seasons Riverside is the answer. Spread across two levels and measuring 126–128 sqm (≈1,356–1,378 sqft), it offers greater privacy and a clearer separation of living and sleeping spaces than a standard flat — a more characterful home in one of Nairobi’s most established addresses.

The split-level layout suits couples, small families, and professionals who entertain and value the distinction between their living and private floors. For investors, the duplex offers something a little rarer in the rental market: a premium, house-like apartment on Riverside Drive.

Unit Snapshot

Prices reflect the current price list. The figure rises with floor level, so the exact price depends on the floor you choose and is confirmed at reservation.

The Home

The duplex layout is what sets this home apart. Living, dining, and kitchen spaces typically sit on one level, with bedrooms on another, giving a genuine sense of separation between the social and private parts of the home — the kind of arrangement that makes daily life feel calmer and entertaining more comfortable. Floor-to-ceiling windows bring natural light across both floors, and the additional space over a standard flat gives the home a more generous, considered feel.

Exact internal arrangement, which spaces sit on each level, balcony provision, bathroom configuration, and available floor levels are to be confirmed from the latest floor plan. We recommend requesting it so you can see precisely how your preferred duplex is laid out.

Lifestyle at Seasons

A duplex offers the privacy of a house, paired with a private-club amenity collection just beyond the door:

  • Heated swimming pool and children’s splash pool
  • Fully equipped gym and yoga studio
  • Rooftop jacuzzi and rooftop relaxation spaces
  • Residents’ lounge with panoramic city views and a co-working lounge
  • Sky garden and landscaped courtyard
  • Grand lobby, laundry suite, and four high-speed elevators
  • Full backup generator, CCTV, controlled access, and a secured perimeter wall

The combination of a private, two-level home and resort-style shared spaces is much of the duplex’s appeal — room to retreat, and room to gather.

Location

On Riverside Drive, the duplex sits in one of Nairobi’s calmer, greener corridors, with the city comfortably close. Diplomatic missions and Riverside Square are a couple of minutes away, GTC Westlands around three, and the CBD about seven — easy access without sacrificing the privacy and tranquillity that make Riverside what it is.

For the full neighbourhood picture and drive times, see the main Seasons Riverside development page. Travel times are indicative and vary with traffic.

Payment Plan

  • Initial deposit: 20%
  • Balance: 80%, payable by monthly or quarterly instalments to completion
  • Completion: 31 December 2028

Request the latest payment schedule, reservation terms, legal cost breakdown, and service charge estimate to plan with full clarity. We are happy to discuss options, including arrangements for diaspora buyers.

Why It Works for Homeowners

The duplex is for homeowners who want more than a flat. The two-level layout gives a sense of space and privacy closer to a house, while the central Riverside location and the building’s amenities keep daily life easy and well-connected. It suits couples and small families who entertain, and anyone who values the clear separation between living and private spaces that a duplex provides.

Why It Works for Investors

The two-bedroom duplex offers a more distinctive proposition than a standard apartment — a premium, house-like home on a recognised Riverside address — which can appeal to professionals, expatriate households, and executive tenants seeking space and privacy. The location and amenity collection support its everyday appeal.

As with any property decision, the numbers should be your own. Rental income, occupancy, and resale performance are not guaranteed. We encourage investors to review rental assumptions, the service charge, furnishing costs, unit positioning, and building management — and to request the floor plan and payment schedule — before committing.

Finishes and Specifications

The duplex is presented with a contemporary, light-led design: floor-to-ceiling windows across both levels, abundant natural light, and generously proportioned living spaces, within a secure building served by four high-speed elevators, a full backup generator, CCTV, and a secured perimeter wall.

Exact finishes — kitchen specifications, wardrobes, bathroom fittings, flooring, appliances, balcony provision, internal stair detail, and parking allocation — should be confirmed from the latest brochure and specification sheet.

Buying from the Diaspora

We make remote purchases simple. If you are buying from abroad, a valid passport or Alien ID is all you need to provide to get started — our team handles your KRA PIN registration and the rest of the paperwork on your behalf. The main statutory cost to budget for is the 4% stamp duty. From virtual viewings to signing, we can guide you through the entire process remotely.

Can I buy from abroad? Yes. A passport or Alien ID is all you need to provide; we handle your KRA PIN and the paperwork and support the full purchase remotely. Budget for 4% stamp duty.

Located along Riverside Drive in Nairobi County, Seasons Riverside sits within one of Nairobi’s most desirable residential and diplomatic corridors. The location offers access to Westlands, Nairobi CBD, GTC, diplomatic missions, United Nations offices, Nairobi Expressway access, leading schools, hospitals, restaurants and shopping destinations.

This 4-bedroom duplex is the most spacious residence within the development. It is designed for families, expatriates, diplomatic residents, senior professionals and long-term homeowners who need more than a standard apartment can provide.

With ensuite bedrooms, a dedicated DSQ and a thoughtful separation between social and private areas, the home is planned around comfort, privacy and everyday practicality.

Prices for the large family-sized duplex residences start from KES 26.6M, with completion scheduled for 31st December 2028.

Project Snapshot

A Development Designed for Spacious Family Living in Riverside

The 4-bedroom duplex + DSQ at Seasons Riverside is created for buyers who need a larger, more private and more functional home in a central Nairobi location.

Riverside is already known for its calm residential character, diplomatic presence and proximity to Westlands. Seasons Riverside builds on that strength by offering a family-sized duplex home with access to wellness, leisure, work and family amenities.

The duplex format gives the residence a more house-like feel. Instead of placing all rooms on one level, the home offers vertical separation, allowing social areas and private areas to feel more distinct. This is especially valuable for family life, entertaining guests, working from home and managing daily routines.

The inclusion of a DSQ adds practical flexibility. It can support live-in help, household management, storage or service needs, depending on how the family chooses to use the space and subject to the final floor plan.

This is a home for buyers who want Riverside convenience, but do not want to compromise on space.

Unit Type

Some addresses simply carry a sense of calm. Riverside Drive is one of them — a leafy, established corner of Nairobi where diplomatic residences, quiet streets, and easy access to the city sit side by side. Seasons Riverside makes the most of that setting, bringing together contemporary apartments and spacious duplex homes in a development designed around wellness, convenience, and considered living.

From an accessible one-bedroom to a generous four-bedroom duplex with its own self-contained staff quarters, Seasons offers a home for many different chapters of life. Floor-to-ceiling windows draw in natural light, timeless interiors keep the design feeling current rather than fashionable, and a full collection of resort-style amenities turns the building into somewhere you genuinely want to spend time. Whether you are buying a city base, a family home, or a considered Riverside investment, this is an address built to hold its appeal.

Project Snapshot

Prices below reflect the current price list. Each unit type starts from the figure shown and rises with floor level, so the exact price for a given unit depends on the floor you choose and is confirmed at reservation.

A Development Designed for Refined Urban Living

Seasons Riverside is built around a simple belief: that a city home should feel restorative, not just convenient. The architecture is contemporary and the interiors are kept elegant and understated, with floor-to-ceiling windows giving each home generous natural light and a sense of openness.

The mix of homes is deliberate. The standard apartments suit single professionals, couples, and first-time buyers, while the duplex layouts offer enhanced privacy and a clear separation of living and sleeping spaces — right up to expansive four-bedroom residences with self-contained domestic staff quarters (DSQ). Around the homes, a wellness-led amenity collection — pool, gym, yoga, rooftop relaxation, and a co-working lounge — supports a more balanced way of living, where work, rest, and movement all have a place close to home.

Unit Types

Seasons Riverside offers four core typologies, from an accessible one-bedroom to a four-bedroom duplex. The prices below reflect the current price list: each unit type starts from the figure shown and rises with floor level by the increment noted, so the final price depends on the floor you choose.

One-Bedroom (Standard). The most accessible way into Seasons, set within Block B (the standard apartment residences). At 64 sqm, it is a practical, light-filled home for a single professional, couple, or first-time buyer, and a compact, well-positioned unit for investors targeting executive tenants.

Two-Bedroom (Standard). More room to settle in, suited to couples, small households, and sharers who want space alongside the development’s amenities and location.

Two-Bedroom Duplex. A split-level layout offering greater privacy and a more distinct separation between living and sleeping areas — a step up in both space and character.

Four-Bedroom Duplex + DSQ. The flagship family residence: a spacious duplex with self-contained domestic staff quarters in select units, designed for households that want room to live and host.

Bathroom configurations, balcony provision, parking allocation, orientation, and available floor levels are to be confirmed from the latest floor plans. We recommend requesting the current floor plans for the exact unit you are considering.

Amenities

  • Grand lobby with a composed arrival experience
  • Heated swimming pool
  • Children’s splash pool and children’s play area
  • Fully equipped gym and yoga studio
  • Rooftop jacuzzi
  • Residents’ lounge with panoramic city views
  • Co-working lounge for remote work and meetings
  • Sky garden and rooftop relaxation spaces
  • Landscaped courtyard
  • Laundry suite
  • Four high-speed express elevators
  • Full backup generator for the residences
  • Multi-level parking with dedicated utility spaces
  • CCTV surveillance, controlled access, and a secured perimeter wall

Location Advantage

Riverside is one of Nairobi’s most established residential and diplomatic corridors, and Seasons sits right in the heart of it. The setting offers a calmer, greener feel than the busier commercial stretches of Westlands, while keeping residents within easy reach of the city’s most important business, diplomatic, and lifestyle destinations.

The development also offers convenient access towards leading schools, hospitals, shopping, and fine dining, as well as onward connections via the Nairobi Expressway towards JKIA. Travel times are indicative and vary with traffic, route, and time of day.

  • Initial deposit: 20%
  • Balance: 80%, payable by monthly or quarterly instalments
  • Payment period: up to completion
  • Completion: 31 December 2028

Before reserving, request the latest payment schedule, reservation terms, legal cost breakdown, and service charge estimate so you can plan with full clarity. We are happy to walk you through the options, including arrangements suited to diaspora buyers.

Seasons works beautifully for homeowners who want a calm, secure, and well-connected Nairobi base. The Riverside location supports an easier daily routine — close to Westlands, GTC, CBD access, and the diplomatic zone — while the wellness-led amenities create a more complete lifestyle than the apartment alone.

There is a home here for different needs: a manageable one-bedroom for a first purchase or a professional’s city base, a two-bedroom for couples and small households, and the duplexes for those who want more space and privacy, up to a four-bedroom family residence with its own DSQ. For frequent travellers, the security, concierge-style arrival, and lock-up-and-leave convenience make it easy to come and go.

Why It Works for Investors

Riverside is one of Nairobi’s most recognised residential addresses, and that established standing is the foundation of the investment case. The area draws a steady pool of the kinds of tenants who value location, security, and amenities — young professionals, corporate tenants, expatriates, consultants, executive renters, and diaspora occupants seeking a Nairobi base. The co-working lounge and proximity to diplomatic missions and Westlands add to the appeal, and the range of typologies means there is an entry point to suit different budgets and strategies, from the one-bedroom upwards.

As with any property decision, the numbers should be your own. Rental income, occupancy, and resale performance are not guaranteed. Our team is glad to provide the documentation you need to assess it properly.

  • CCTV surveillance, controlled access, and a secured perimeter wall

  • Families — the four-bedroom duplex with DSQ offers room to live and host.

listings.content_html:
Aether Residences is an off-plan, mixed-use apartment development on Lantana Road in Westlands, Nairobi, offering studio, one- and two-bedroom apartments for sale from KES 5,500,000. Sizes run from 43 sqm studios to 120 sqm two-bedrooms, and every studio and two-bedroom layout has a balcony. Completion is scheduled for June 2028, and the rooftop carries an infinity pool with Nairobi skyline views and a padel court.

Listing updated: 12 October 2026 · Verified against the developer’s brochure

Development at a Glance

Some addresses simply put you in the middle of things. Aether Residences, on Lantana Road in the heart of Westlands, is one of them — a contemporary, mixed-use apartment development a short distance from the offices, malls, restaurants and embassies that make Westlands Nairobi’s busiest commercial and lifestyle district.

It is a building designed around how people actually want to live in the city: compact, well-planned studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, paired with a genuinely unusual set of rooftop amenities — an infinity pool with skyline views, a padel court, and on-site dining. For someone who wants to live close to work without giving up comfort, or an investor who knows the Westlands rental market, it is an address worth a serious look.

One thing to be clear about from the outset: Aether Residences is an off-plan development, with completion scheduled for June 2028. You are buying ahead of construction, which has its advantages — first pick of units and the ability to spread payments across the build — but it also means the home is a future delivery rather than something you can move into today. We will always walk you through the agreement, the payment terms and what to look for before you commit.

Project Snapshot

  • Development: Aether Residences
  • Location: Lantana Road, Westlands, Nairobi
  • Type: Mixed-use residential — studio, 1 and 2 bedroom apartments
  • Status: Off-plan — completion scheduled for June 2028
  • Unit sizes: From 43 sqm (463 sqft) studios up to 120 sqm (1,291 sqft) two-bedrooms (gross)
  • Pricing: From KES 5.5M
  • Payment: 20% deposit to reserve, balance in instalments through to completion
  • Title and tenure: Leasehold, with sectional titles for the apartments

A Development Designed for Connected City Living

Aether Residences is built for life in the centre of Westlands. The appeal is partly the apartments themselves — efficient, modern layouts that make sense for professionals, couples and small households — and partly everything that sits on top of them.

The rooftop is the heart of the building: an infinity swimming pool looking out over the Nairobi skyline, a padel court (a rare feature in a Nairobi residential development), and a restaurant and café. Elsewhere in the building, a hotel-style reception lobby, a fully equipped gym and an on-site mini-mart round out a building designed to make day-to-day living easy. It is the kind of mixed-use, amenity-led address that suits people who want their home, their downtime and their conveniences in one place — with Sarit Centre about 15 minutes away on foot.

Unit Types and Prices

Aether Residences offers a range of layouts, from entry-level studios to larger two-bedroom homes with two or three bathrooms.

Studios (43–50 sqm) are the entry point — compact, efficient homes that suit young professionals who want to live centrally in Westlands, or buyers looking for the most accessible way into the building. Both studio layouts have a balcony.

One-bedroom apartments (57–60 sqm) offer a comfortable balance of space and value, well suited to single professionals, couples, or anyone who wants a proper separate bedroom in a central location. The developer’s brochure also shows a larger one-bedroom with a separate study room (93 sqm); ask us for its price.

Two-bedroom apartments (95–120 sqm) are the most generous layouts, in three types, each with a balcony and two or three bathrooms — a sensible fit for small families, sharers, or anyone who wants a guest room or home office.

Prices shown are starting prices and vary by type, size, floor and orientation. Sizes are the developer’s gross figures. The exact size and price for each layout are best confirmed against the current floor plans and price list — ask us and we will share the latest. USD equivalents can be provided at the prevailing exchange rate on request.

AETHER-Residences-Westlands-E-Brochure-May-26

Amenities

Aether Residences is positioned at the upper end of Westlands apartment developments, with a notably strong amenity offering:

  • Rooftop infinity swimming pool with Nairobi skyline views
  • Rooftop padel court — a rare feature in a Nairobi residential building
  • On-site restaurant
  • Café and social lounge
  • Fully equipped gym
  • Hotel-style reception lobby
  • On-site mini-mart
  • High-speed lifts
  • Full backup generator and borehole water
  • 24/7 CCTV and security
  • Ample parking

Location Advantage

Westlands is, by most measures, Nairobi’s prime commercial and diplomatic district — home to a dense concentration of corporate headquarters, international organisations, hotels, malls and restaurants, and known for its security and infrastructure standards. That is the foundation of the area’s enduring residential appeal: a great many people want to live close to where they work and socialise, and Westlands is where a large share of that activity happens.

Lantana Road sits on the quieter, residential side of Westlands, between Rhapta Road and Riverside Drive. From there:

  • Sarit Centre — about 15 minutes on foot
  • Global Trade Centre (GTC) and Westgate Mall — 6 to 10 minutes by car
  • MP Shah Hospital — about 10 minutes; Aga Khan University Hospital — about 12 minutes
  • Nairobi CBD — about 15 minutes via Waiyaki Way
  • UN offices and embassies in Gigiri — about 20 minutes
  • JKIA — about 30 minutes via the Nairobi Expressway

(Travel times are approximate and depend on traffic.)

Payment Plan

Aether Residences offers a structured off-plan payment plan: a 20% deposit reserves your unit, with the balance payable in instalments through construction and a final payment on completion in June 2028. Spreading payments across the construction period makes ownership more manageable than paying in full upfront, and it suits both local and diaspora buyers.

Payment terms can be tailored and may be updated by the developer, so we will confirm the current schedule for you before you commit. Ask us for the latest payment plan, price list and reservation terms.

Why It Works for Homeowners

For anyone whose working life centres on Westlands, the case is mostly about time and quality of life. Living on Lantana Road means a short hop to the office, the gym downstairs, a swim on the roof at the end of the day, and dinner within the building or a walk away — with security and backup power handled for you. For single professionals and couples especially, it is an easy, lock-up-and-go way to live in the middle of the city.

The honest caveat is the timeline: this is an off-plan home with a June 2028 completion, so it suits a buyer planning ahead rather than one who needs to move in now. If your timing aligns, it is a chance to secure a well-located home — and your preferred unit — at today’s pricing.

Why It Works for Investors

Westlands has long been one of Nairobi’s most established rental neighbourhoods, with consistent demand from corporate professionals, expatriates and staff of the international organisations based in and around the area. Aether’s range of unit sizes lets you target different tenant profiles, from a compact studio to a family-sized two-bedroom, and the building’s amenities and central position are the kind of features tenants in this market look for.

A few things we would put plainly rather than dress up: as an off-plan purchase, any rental income only begins after completion in 2028, and actual returns will depend on the finished product, your furnishing standard and market conditions at the time. We do not publish yield or appreciation figures, because no one can responsibly promise them — but we are very happy to prepare a current, grounded rental appraisal for the unit type you are considering, and to talk through the realistic numbers before you decide.

Buying from Abroad

The off-plan structure and instalment payments make Aether Residences well suited to diaspora buyers, and the whole process can be handled remotely. If you are a Kenyan living abroad or a foreign buyer, a valid passport or Alien ID is enough to get started — you do not need to be in the country to begin. Block handles the KRA PIN registration and walks you through the paperwork from start to finish. Budget for stamp duty of 4% of the purchase price on transfer, legal fees (typically 1% plus VAT) and the developer’s completion charges, such as utility meter connections, sectional title registration and service charge paid in advance. We will set out the full cost picture before you commit.

Finishes and Specifications

Aether Residences is designed with a hotel-style sensibility and modern finishes throughout, in keeping with its position at the upper tier of Westlands developments. As this is an off-plan development, the detailed finishes and specification schedule — kitchen fittings, flooring, fixtures and the precise inclusions for each unit type — is best reviewed directly. Ask us for the latest brochure, specification sheet and floor plans, and we will share them so you know exactly what is being delivered.

  • Single buyers and couples after a modern, low-maintenance, amenity-rich home
  • Buyers planning ahead who are comfortable with an off-plan, 2028 completion

listings.content_html:
Auris Residence is a hotel-inspired residential development on Westlands Avenue, Nairobi, bringing together contemporary apartments, extensive lifestyle amenities and the convenience of a well-connected Westlands address.

Rising 21 storeys, the development offers studio, one and two-bedroom apartments designed around modern urban living. The concept combines the privacy of a residential home with hospitality-inspired shared spaces, creating an option for both homeowners and buyers considering a property in one of Nairobi’s established residential and commercial districts.

Prices currently start from KSh 5.5 million, with anticipated occupation in Q4 2028.

Project Snapshot

A Development Designed for Contemporary Urban Living

Auris Residence is designed around a Hotel + Residences concept, giving residents access to a broad collection of shared spaces beyond the apartment itself.

The residences feature open-plan living and dining areas, contemporary fitted kitchens, large windows, built-in wardrobes and modern bathrooms. Selected apartments also include private balconies.

For residents who spend much of their time in Westlands, the appeal is as much about the shared lifestyle environment as it is about the individual apartment.

Unit Types

Studio Apartments

Size: 36 sqm
Price: From KSh 5.5 Million

The studio apartments offer a compact residential format suited to buyers looking for an efficient urban home.

Key features include:

  • Open-plan living space
  • Contemporary fitted kitchen
  • Modern interior finishes
  • Large windows for natural light
  • Built-in storage
  • Modern bathroom fittings
  • High-speed internet connectivity
  • Natural ventilation

1 Bedroom Apartments

Size: 72–75 sqm
Price: From KSh 9.3 Million – KSh 9.8 Million

The one-bedroom residences provide more separation between living and sleeping areas while retaining an efficient urban layout.

Available sizes and stated prices are:

  • 72 sqm: From KSh 9.3 Million
  • 75 sqm: From KSh 9.8 Million

Selected units have private balconies.

2 Bedroom Apartments

Size: 105–110 sqm
Price: From KSh 13.5 Million – KSh 14 Million

The two-bedroom apartments offer additional space for homeowners, couples or small families.

Available options include:

  • 105 sqm: From KSh 13.5 Million
  • 110 sqm: From KSh 14 Million

The apartments feature spacious bedrooms, built-in wardrobes, contemporary bathrooms and open-plan living and dining areas.

Amenities

Auris Residence places significant emphasis on shared lifestyle facilities.

Residents have access to:

  • Infinity-edge swimming pool
  • Rooftop gym
  • Yoga and wellness deck
  • Spa and sauna
  • Private 8-seat cinema and theatre room
  • Residents’ coffee lounge
  • Rooftop barbecue and entertainment area
  • Leisure lounge
  • Reading lounge
  • Residents’ social gathering spaces
  • Business lounge
  • Conference and meeting rooms
  • 20-metre indoor mini-golf practice area
  • Children’s play and recreation zone
  • Two landscaped art gardens
  • High-speed elevators
  • Full backup generator
  • Parking across two basement levels and a half-ground parking floor
  • 24-hour security and CCTV surveillance

The range is particularly relevant to buyers who value having recreational, wellness and work-oriented facilities within the same residential development.

Location Advantage

Auris Residence is located along Westlands Avenue, placing residents within one of Nairobi’s established mixed-use districts.

Westlands brings together residential neighbourhoods, offices, retail destinations, restaurants, entertainment venues and professional services. This makes the location relevant to both owner-occupiers and buyers looking for a property within an active urban environment.

Exact distances to individual schools, hospitals, malls and offices should be confirmed at the point of enquiry.

Payment Plan

The published payment structure is:

30% deposit to secure the apartment, followed by the remaining 70% payable over three years at 0% interest. The project is anticipated to be ready for occupation in Q4 2028.

Buyers should request the latest price list, unit availability, sale agreement and payment schedule before making a commitment, as commercial terms may change.

Why It Works for Homeowners

Auris Residence is suited to buyers who want an urban apartment without giving up access to a broader range of shared facilities.

The choice of studios through two-bedroom apartments also allows buyers to select a home according to their space requirements and budget.

For a homeowner, the main considerations include:

  • Established Westlands location
  • Choice of apartment sizes
  • Contemporary layouts
  • Extensive recreational facilities
  • Dedicated wellness spaces
  • Children’s facilities
  • Business and meeting areas
  • Backup power
  • Controlled security environment

The hotel-inspired concept may particularly appeal to residents who value convenience and access to amenities without having to travel far from home.

Why It Works for Investors

For investors, Auris Residence offers exposure to the Westlands residential market through several apartment formats.

The development’s location and range of amenities may broaden its appeal to different residential segments, but actual rental performance will depend on prevailing market rents, competition, operating costs, occupancy and the condition of the property at completion.

The development is therefore best assessed using the specific unit’s purchase price, expected rental market, service charge, financing costs and comparable properties rather than relying on generic yield projections.

The availability of a three-year 0% interest balance payment structure, as currently published, may also be relevant when evaluating the acquisition’s cash-flow requirements.

Finishes & Specifications

The apartments are described as having contemporary interiors and premium finishes.

Key specifications include:

  • Spacious open-plan living and dining areas
  • Contemporary fitted kitchens
  • Premium cabinetry
  • Large windows
  • Built-in bedroom wardrobes
  • Modern sanitary ware
  • Natural ventilation
  • High-speed internet connectivity
  • Private balconies in selected units

Furnished apartment options are also stated to be available. Buyers should confirm which unit types and apartments are currently offered furnished.

Who This Development Suits Best

Auris Residence may suit:

  • Professionals working in Westlands and surrounding business districts
  • Buyers looking for a contemporary Nairobi apartment
  • Couples seeking one or two-bedroom accommodation
  • Individuals looking for an efficient studio residence
  • Families considering a two-bedroom apartment
  • Investors evaluating residential property in Westlands
  • Buyers interested in a hotel-inspired residential environment
  • Buyers who value extensive shared amenities

Frequently Asked Questions

How much do apartments at Auris Residence cost?

Prices currently start from KSh 5.5 million for a 36 sqm studio. One-bedroom apartments start from KSh 9.3 million, while two-bedroom apartments start from KSh 13.5 million.

What apartment sizes are available?

The development offers:

  • Studios: 36 sqm
  • 1 bedroom: 72–75 sqm
  • 2 bedroom: 105–110 sqm

Where is Auris Residence located?

The development is located along Westlands Avenue in Nairobi.

When is Auris Residence expected to be completed?

The published anticipated occupation is Q4 2028.

What is the payment plan?

The published plan requires a 30% deposit, with the remaining 70% payable over three years at 0% interest. Buyers should confirm the latest terms before purchase.

Does Auris Residence have a swimming pool?

Yes. The development includes an infinity-edge swimming pool with panoramic skyline views.

Are there fitness and wellness facilities?

Yes. Facilities include a rooftop gym, yoga and wellness deck, spa and sauna.

Is there parking?

Yes. Parking is provided across two basement levels and a half-ground parking floor.

Are there furnished apartments?

The development information states that furnished options are available. Specific furnished units and their pricing should be confirmed at the point of enquiry.

Find Your Apartment at Auris Residence

Auris Residence brings together compact and spacious apartment options with an unusually broad range of shared amenities, all within a Westlands address.

Whether your priority is a well-connected urban home, a two-bedroom residence with more space, or a property purchase for investment consideration, the right decision starts with comparing the specific unit, price, payment structure and ongoing ownership costs.

Prices from KSh 5.5 million.

Contact Block Real Estate for the latest availability, floor plans, current price list, payment schedule and viewing arrangements.

Development at a Glance

About Butterfly Palace

Every so often a development sets out to be genuinely different, and does. Butterfly Palace, on Donyo Sabuk Avenue off General Mathenge Drive, is a distinctive off-plan residence in one of Westlands’ leafiest, most prestigious pockets — a butterfly-shaped building of sweeping glass façades, set among mature trees with forest views, and deliberately kept to just 75 homes with two units per floor. What sets Butterfly Palace apart is the detail — floor-to-ceiling windows and spacious balconies that blend indoor and outdoor living, all-en-suite bedrooms, and a shared offering that reaches beyond the usual: a café, a residents’ restaurant and lounge, a library, an art gallery and a large pool, among others. It’s luxury expressed calmly, in a setting that balances the city’s convenience with the quiet of a green, established neighbourhood.

A Development Designed for Private, Nature-Inspired Living

Butterfly Palace is built around privacy and a connection to its green surroundings. With two residential blocks separated by twenty metres of open space, and only two homes on each floor, the development delivers a genuine sense of space, light and quiet — a rarity this close to a commercial hub. The butterfly-shaped design and floor-to-ceiling glass are more than a signature: they maximise natural light, ventilation and the forest views that define the setting.

The homes themselves are designed for comfortable, elevated living — open-plan kitchens, all-en-suite bedrooms, and spacious balconies that draw the outdoors in. Beyond the front door, the ground-floor amenities create a considered lifestyle: a café, a residents’ restaurant and lounge, a library, an art gallery, a prayer room and a large outdoor pool, alongside a gym and a clubhouse. It’s a development planned, at every level, around light, calm and a sense of retreat.

Development at a Glance

About Executive Suites

Executive Suites is a residential apartment development by Wonder Properties, built off Riverside Lane in Westlands, Nairobi. To be clear about the address, because the name invites confusion: this is Riverside Lane, in Westlands. It is not the Riverside Drive corridor that runs south of Westlands towards Chiromo, where developments such as Balkis, Pavo and Cheval sit. If you are coming to site, ask us for the map pin rather than navigating to Riverside Drive.

The development is sold off-plan across three unit types, with the smallest one-bedroom forming the entry point and the largest two-bedroom layouts running to 117 sqm.

Price List by Unit Type

Prices are from KES 7,200,000 — confirm the current price list with us, as off-plan pricing is revised through the build period and the three-bedroom figures have not been published.

Payment Plan and Off-Plan Risk

Buyers pay a deposit from 20% and settle the balance in instalments across the build period, on a three-year plan running to the stated December 2028 completion.

It is worth stating the risk plainly rather than glossing it. December 2028 is more than two years away from this listing date. You would be paying, in stages, for a building that does not yet exist, against a date the developer has stated as a target rather than guaranteed. Off-plan completion dates in Nairobi do move. Before committing, ask for the contractual completion date, the grace period the agreement allows, and what compensation or exit route applies if that date passes. Ask to see the title for the land and the approved development plans, instruct your own advocate rather than relying on the developer, pay only into the account named in the sale agreement, and keep every receipt. We will help you assemble those documents.

The Investment Case

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that Executive Suites is an off-plan development off Riverside Lane in Westlands, Nairobi, offering 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from 60 sqm to 117 sqm, priced from KES 7,200,000, on a 20% deposit with the balance over a three-year plan, with completion stated for December 2028. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building’s management rules and on applicable regulations — worth confirming before you buy.

Verified Amenities

The shared amenities we can state with confidence are:

  • A rooftop paddle court, which is an unusual amenity in a Nairobi apartment building.
  • A swimming pool.
  • A gymnasium.

The developer material also indicates a rooftop garden and recreation area, a landscaped courtyard with a play area for children, a cafe and restaurant, a library and reading lounge, an on-site convenience store, a concierge lobby, smart access control, lifts and a backup generator. Those are not yet built, so treat them as the specification rather than as delivered facts, and ask us to confirm the final amenity schedule in writing before you reserve.

Location and Connectivity

The development sits off Riverside Lane, within Westlands, Nairobi. The surrounding area includes the Westlands commercial district, Sarit Centre and the embassy and corporate offices established around Westlands.

We have not given drive times to these landmarks. No verified distances or journey times have been published for this development, and Nairobi traffic makes any single figure misleading in any case. If travel time to a specific school, office or hospital matters to your decision, tell us where and we will measure it with you on a site visit.

Executive Suites is off Riverside Lane in Westlands, Nairobi. That is a different address from the Riverside Drive corridor, which runs south of Westlands towards Chiromo. The name invites confusion, so ask us for the map pin before you travel to site.

Buyers pay a deposit from 20 percent and spread the balance in instalments over a three-year plan that runs to the stated December 2028 completion. Ask for the instalment schedule in writing before you commit.

Construction runs from December 2025 to a stated completion of December 2028. That is more than two years away, so every unit here is bought off-plan and paid for in stages before the building exists.

Ask for the contractual completion date, the grace period the agreement allows, and what compensation or exit applies if that date passes, and have your advocate confirm all three before you sign.

Ask to see the title for the land, the approved development plans, and the provisions in the sale agreement covering staged payments, default and refund. Pay only into the account named in that agreement, instruct your own advocate rather than relying on the developer, and keep every receipt. We will help you assemble these documents.

The developer material also indicates a rooftop garden, a landscaped courtyard with a play area for children, a cafe and restaurant, a library, an on-site convenience store, a concierge lobby and smart access control. listings.content_html:
The 2 bedroom apartments at KEZA Laika are designed for buyers who want more space, more flexibility and a stronger long-term living option in Ruaka. With a unit area of 79 sqm, this typology offers a practical layout for small families, couples, shared living, investors and diaspora buyers.

The layout includes 2 bedrooms, a master ensuite, open-plan kitchen, living and dining area, 1 shared bathroom and 2 balconies. This makes it a well-balanced apartment for buyers who want a home that feels functional, bright and adaptable.

For homeowners, the 2 bedroom apartment offers enough space for daily comfort and future flexibility. For investors, it appeals to a wider tenant pool than a 1 bedroom unit, including small families, professionals sharing accommodation and long-stay tenants.

Unit Snapshot

Development: KEZA Laika
Developer: Mi Vida Homes
Location: Ruaka
Unit Type: 2 Bedroom Apartment
Size: 79 sqm
Starting Price: KES 8,200,000
Projected Monthly Rent: KES 60,000
Developer-Projected Rental Yield: 9%
Developer-Projected Capital Appreciation: 23% over the construction period
Payment Plan: 10% deposit, 20% at Sale Agreement, 60% over construction, 10% on completion
Best Suited For: Small families, couples, professionals, investors, shared living and diaspora buyers

A Flexible 2 Bedroom Layout

The 2 bedroom apartment at KEZA Laika offers a strong balance between space and affordability. The master ensuite bedroom gives the home added privacy, while the second bedroom can serve as a children’s room, guest room, shared bedroom or work-from-home space.

The open-plan kitchen connects naturally to the living and dining area, supporting easy daily movement and a more social home environment. The 2 balconies give the apartment better light, ventilation and outdoor connection, which improves both livability and rental appeal.

This is the kind of apartment that can adapt as needs change. A couple can use the second bedroom as an office. A small family can use it as a child’s bedroom. An investor can position it for long-stay tenants who want a more complete home in Ruaka.

Lifestyle Amenities at KEZA Laika

Residents have access to the development’s full amenity package, including the fruit tree forest, co-working space with free Wi-Fi, residents’ social lounge, indoor gym, children’s play park, CCTV cameras, back-up borehole and back-up generator for common areas and selected apartment outlets.

The green spaces and orchard help create a calmer residential environment. The co-working space supports remote work. The gym and play park add daily convenience for both adults and children. Together, these amenities make the 2 bedroom apartment attractive for both homeowners and tenants.

Why This 2 Bedroom Works for Homeowners

For homeowners, the 2 bedroom apartment offers practical space in a growing residential location. It works well for small families, couples, professionals and buyers who want a more flexible home than a 1 bedroom unit.

The master ensuite, shared bathroom and 2 balconies make the apartment more comfortable for daily living. The wider development also supports lifestyle needs through green spaces, fitness amenities, work areas and family-friendly outdoor spaces.

Why This 2 Bedroom Works for Investors

For investors, the 2 bedroom category is a strong rental typology because it serves a broad tenant market. It can appeal to small families, professional sharers, couples, remote workers and long-stay tenants.

The brochure projects monthly rent of KES 60,000, rental yield of 9% and capital appreciation of 23% over the construction period. These are developer projections and should be verified against current Ruaka rental comparables, service charge estimates, furnishing budgets, management fees and occupancy assumptions.

Payment Plan

The 2 bedroom payment structure is outlined as follows:

  • Starting price: KES 8,200,000
  • 10% deposit: KES 820,000
  • 20% at Sale Agreement: KES 1,640,000
  • 60% over construction: KES 4,920,000
  • 10% on completion: KES 820,000

Buyers should confirm the latest price list, availability and reservation terms before committing.

Who This 2 Bedroom Suits Best

This apartment is ideal for:

  • Small families
  • Couples
  • Shared professional tenants
  • Investors targeting rental income
  • Diaspora buyers
  • First-time buyers upgrading from a 1 bedroom
  • Buyers who want a master ensuite apartment in Ruaka
  • Tenants who value balconies, amenities and green spaces

What is the size of the 2 bedroom apartment at KEZA Laika?
The 2 bedroom apartment is approximately 79 sqm.

What is the starting price?
The starting price is KES 8,200,000.

Does the 2 bedroom apartment have balconies?
Yes, the layout includes 2 balconies.

Is the master bedroom ensuite?
Yes, the 2 bedroom layout includes a master ensuite bedroom.

Yes, the brochure projects monthly rent of KES 60,000 and a rental yield of 9%, subject to verification and market conditions.

This amenity mix helps the 1 bedroom apartment stand out from basic apartment options in the market.
