KEZA Laika by Mi Vida brings a fresh, thoughtful approach to apartment living in Ruaka. Designed as Ruaka’s urban oasis, the development combines modern apartment layouts, landscaped green spaces, lifestyle amenities and accessible pricing within one of Nairobi’s fast-growing residential corridors.

Set within 3.7 acres of landscaped gardens, KEZA Laika offers premium 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments created for buyers who want a home that feels practical, calm and connected. The development introduces a unique fruit tree orchard with mango, avocado and loquat trees, giving residents a greener, softer living environment that stands apart from standard apartment blocks.

For homeowners, KEZA Laika offers the comfort of modern living within a serene setting. For investors, it presents an opportunity to enter the Ruaka market through a development positioned around affordability, lifestyle value, rental demand and long-term growth potential.

Project Snapshot

Development: KEZA Laika
Developer: Mi Vida Homes
Location: Ruaka, Nairobi Metropolitan Area
Property Types: 1 Bedroom, 2 Bedroom and 3 Bedroom Apartments
Development Concept: Affordable luxury in a serene green setting
Land Size: 3.7 acres of landscaped gardens
Key Green Feature: Fruit tree orchard with mango, avocado and loquat trees
Starting Price: From KES 5.9M
Size Range: 49.5 sqm to 102.3 sqm
Payment Plan: 10% deposit, 20% at Sale Agreement, 60% over construction, 10% on completion
Project Status: Off-plan, with 60% of the price paid over the construction period
Best Suited For: First-time homeowners, investors, young professionals, families, diaspora buyers and rental-income buyers

Available Typologies at KEZA Laika

Projected rents, yields and capital appreciation figures are based on the developer’s assumptions and should be verified against current market comparables, service charges, furnishing costs, management fees and occupancy expectations before purchase.

A Development Designed Around Affordable Luxury

KEZA Laika is positioned around the idea of affordable luxury in a serene setting. The development is created for buyers who want more than a basic apartment. It brings together thoughtful layouts, green outdoor spaces, work-friendly amenities and everyday conveniences in a way that supports both ownership and investment.

Each apartment is designed to balance style, comfort and affordability. This makes KEZA Laika attractive to buyers who want modern apartment living without moving into Nairobi’s higher-priced residential markets.

The development also responds to the way people live today. Residents want access to outdoor space, secure surroundings, flexible work areas, fitness options and reliable utilities. KEZA Laika brings these needs together within a planned residential environment.

Green Spaces and Fruit Tree Orchard

One of the strongest features at KEZA Laika is its approach to green space. The development is set within 3.7 acres of landscaped gardens and includes a fruit tree orchard with mango, avocado and loquat trees.

This is more than an aesthetic feature. The orchard and landscaped gardens are designed to create multifunctional spaces where residents can relax, connect, enjoy picnics, use barbeque areas and experience a calmer environment within Ruaka.

For homeowners, this improves day-to-day quality of life. For investors, it strengthens the property’s rental appeal because tenants increasingly value developments that offer more than just internal apartment space.

Amenities at KEZA Laika

KEZA Laika includes a focused amenity package designed to support wellness, work, family life, security and community living.

Green and Outdoor Amenities

  • Fruit tree forest
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Picnic spaces
  • Barbeque areas
  • Outdoor relaxation spaces

Work and Social Amenities

  • Co-working space with free Wi-Fi
  • Residents’ social lounge
  • Serene workspaces ideal for remote work

Wellness and Family Amenities

  • Indoor gym
  • Fitness zones for yoga and jogging
  • Children’s play park
  • Safe children’s areas

Security and Utilities

  • CCTV cameras
  • Back-up borehole
  • Back-up generator for common areas and selected apartment outlets

These amenities give KEZA Laika a more complete residential character. They support everyday comfort for homeowners and help create a stronger tenant proposition for investors.

Location Advantage: Ruaka

KEZA Laika is located in Ruaka, a fast-growing residential area known for its access to shopping, lifestyle destinations, schools, transport connections and Nairobi’s northern corridor.

According to the brochure, the development is positioned within reach of major destinations including Two Rivers Mall, Rosslyn Riviera Mall, Village Market, Nairobi CBD and Karura Forest.

Key Nearby Destinations

  • Two Rivers Mall and Rosslyn Riviera Mall, approximately 5 minutes
  • Village Market, approximately 15 minutes
  • Nairobi Central Business District, approximately 18 minutes
  • Karura Forest, approximately 35 minutes

Ruaka continues to attract buyers and tenants because it offers access to areas such as Runda, Gigiri, Rosslyn, Limuru Road, Northern Bypass and Kiambu Road. This makes it practical for professionals, families and tenants who want convenience without living directly inside Nairobi’s busier core.

Why KEZA Laika Works for Homebuyers

For homeowners, KEZA Laika offers a balanced residential experience. It combines modern apartment layouts with green outdoor spaces, lifestyle amenities and a more peaceful setting.

The 1 bedroom units work well for first-time homeowners and young professionals. The 2 bedroom units offer more room for couples, small families and shared living. The 3 bedroom units provide stronger family functionality for buyers who need more space.

The development is especially attractive for buyers who value:

  • A Ruaka address
  • Modern apartment layouts
  • Green and landscaped spaces
  • Access to shopping and lifestyle hubs
  • Co-working and remote-work-friendly amenities
  • Fitness and family spaces
  • A more affordable entry into quality apartment living

Why KEZA Laika Works for Investors

For investors, KEZA Laika offers a combination of accessible entry pricing, rental demand, lifestyle amenities and developer-projected returns.

The brochure presents projected monthly rents of KES 45,000 for 1 bedroom units, KES 60,000 for 2 bedroom units and KES 70,000 for 3 bedroom units. It also presents developer-projected rental yields of 9% for 1 and 2 bedroom units, and 8% for 3 bedroom units.

These figures should be treated as projections, not guaranteed returns. Actual performance will depend on purchase price, unit position, furnishing quality, service charge, management costs, tenancy strategy, market rents and occupancy levels at the time of letting.

The project may appeal to tenants such as:

  • Young professionals
  • Small families
  • Remote workers
  • Students and early-career renters
  • Long-stay tenants
  • Professionals working around Ruaka, Gigiri, Runda and Westlands
  • Tenants seeking affordability with amenities

Payment Plan

KEZA Laika offers a structured payment plan over the construction period.

Standard Payment Plan

  • 10% deposit
  • 20% at Sale Agreement
  • 60% over construction
  • 10% on completion

Payment Breakdown by Typology

KEZA Laika is located in Ruaka, within reach of Two Rivers Mall, Rosslyn Riviera Mall, Village Market, Nairobi CBD and Karura Forest.

KEZA Laika is by Mi Vida Homes.

The development offers 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom and 3 bedroom apartments.

Prices start from KES 5,900,000 for the 1 bedroom apartment, based on the brochure.

What is the size of the 2 bedroom apartment?
The 2 bedroom apartment is approximately 79 sqm.

What is the size of the 3 bedroom apartment?
The 3 bedroom apartment is approximately 102.3 sqm.

What amenities are available at KEZA Laika?
Amenities include a fruit tree forest, co-working space with free Wi-Fi, residents’ social lounge, indoor gym, children’s play park, CCTV cameras, back-up borehole and back-up generator for common areas and selected apartment outlets.

Is KEZA Laika good for investment?
KEZA Laika is positioned as an investment-friendly development with developer-projected rental yields of 8% to 9%, depending on unit type. Buyers should verify rental projections, service charges and operating costs before purchase.

What is the payment plan?
The brochure outlines a payment plan of 10% deposit, 20% at Sale Agreement, 60% over construction and 10% on completion.

The 2 bedroom units at Mara Grove Apartments, located in Block B, offer a step up in space for buyers who want more room to grow — whether that’s a young family, a couple planning ahead, or an investor targeting a slightly larger tenant pool. Set within a 2.7-acre development bordering Nairobi National Park, Block B sits just 600 metres off Mombasa Road, with quick access to the Nairobi Expressway and JKIA.

Construction is currently underway at basement level, with early interest already strong across the development.

Residents share the same landscaped grounds, pool, gym, and clubhouse as the rest of the development, and Block B offers partial views of Nairobi National Park, giving the unit a genuine connection to its natural surroundings.

Full specifications and material schedules are available on request.

  • Couples planning ahead for more space

What is the size of the 2 bedroom apartment at Mara Grove? The 2 bedroom units in Block B measure 95 sqm.

Mara Grove 3 bedroom + DSQ off-plan apartments in Syokimau bordering Nairobi National Park. From KES 10.5M, with select units offering full park views. Completion December 2028. For families who need genuine space — and the added flexibility of a Domestic Staff Quarter — the 3 bedroom units at Mara Grove Apartments are the development’s most spacious offering. Spread across Blocks C, D, E and F, these apartments include some of the development’s best-positioned units, with Block C offering full, unobstructed views of Nairobi National Park from the 7th floor upwards. All sit within the same 2.7-acre development, 600 metres off Mombasa Road and close to JKIA and the Nairobi Expressway.

Construction is currently underway at basement level, with a meaningful share of the development already reserved.

Project Snapshot

Pricing and availability are subject to change. Buyers should request the current price list and floor plans to confirm details before booking.

A Home Designed for Family Living

The 3 bedroom + DSQ units are built for households that need room to spread out — space for children, guests, and live-in help, all within a development that still offers resort-style amenities and, for select blocks, direct views over the Nairobi National Park. This is the configuration most likely to suit long-term family occupancy, whether that’s an owner-occupier household or a long-term rental tenant.

listings.content_html:
Mara Grove Apartments is an off-plan development of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom homes on a 2.7-acre site on Muthama Access Road, Syokimau, bordering Nairobi National Park and about 600 metres off Mombasa Road. One-bedrooms of 56 sqm start at KES 4.8M, and three-bedroom homes with a DSQ run to 166 sqm and KES 12.8M, with completion scheduled for December 2028.

A 20% to 30% deposit secures a home, and the balance is spread over 32 months during construction. Six blocks share a resort-style pool, a gym, a clubhouse and landscaped gardens, and the upper floors of Block C look straight across the national park.

Mara Grove at a Glance

Mara Grove Prices by Unit Type

Published starting prices for each unit type. Prices vary with block, floor and outlook, so ask Block Real Estate for the current price list before you book.

The Homes: 1, 2 and 3 Bedrooms

Mara Grove is being built in one phase across six blocks, A to F, rather than in staged releases, with each block given over to one type of home.

1 Bedroom, Block A

56 sqm, from KES 4.8M: the entry home at Mara Grove and the price the development is quoted from. Block A is not covered by the published park-views schedule, so confirm the outlook of a specific unit before you commit. See the 1 bedroom apartments.

2 Bedroom, Block B

95 sqm, from KES 7.5M, with partial Nairobi National Park views from Block B. See the 2 bedroom apartments.

3 Bedroom + DSQ, Blocks C to F

136 to 166 sqm, from KES 10.5M, in Standard, Large and Premium configurations. Every three-bedroom home includes a domestic staff quarter. See the 3 bedroom + DSQ apartments.

Park Views by Block

  • Block C: full, unbroken Nairobi National Park views from the 7th floor upwards
  • Blocks B and D: partial park views
  • Blocks E and F: courtyard and neighbourhood outlook
  • Block A: not covered by the published views schedule, so confirm with us before booking

Amenities at Mara Grove

The six blocks share a resort-style pool, a gym and a residents’ clubhouse set in landscaped gardens, with shops and a play area on site, so everyday needs are met without leaving the gate.

Wellness and recreation

  • Resort-style swimming pool
  • Fully equipped gym
  • Landscaped leisure gardens

Community and convenience

  • Resident clubhouse
  • Kids’ play area
  • On-site commercial shops

Security and infrastructure

  • High-speed elevators in all blocks
  • 24/7 manned security, CCTV surveillance and a secured boundary wall
  • Borehole and Mavoko Water supply
  • Backup generator for common areas
  • Fibre internet ready
  • Fitted kitchens
  • Wheelchair accessible common areas

Location: Muthama Access Road, Syokimau

Mara Grove is on Muthama Access Road in Syokimau, Machakos County, about 600 metres off Mombasa Road, with Nairobi National Park on its western side. The Nairobi Expressway starts at Mlolongo, about 2.4 km away, and JKIA is about 7 km away by straight line.

  • Mombasa Road: about 600 m
  • Nairobi National Park: borders the site
  • Nairobi Expressway, Mlolongo toll station: about 2.4 km
  • Gateway Mall: about 2.6 km
  • SGR Nairobi Terminus: about 4.4 km
  • Signature Mall: about 4.9 km
  • JKIA: about 7.4 km
  • Upper Hill: about 15.3 km
  • Nairobi CBD: about 15.5 km
  • Westlands: about 18 km

Straight-line distances from the site; road distances are longer, and travel times on Mombasa Road vary sharply with traffic. The Expressway bypasses most of it for trips into the city.

Payment Plan

Mara Grove is sold off plan: pay a deposit on booking, then spread the balance over the construction period.

  • Deposit: 20% to 30% on booking
  • Instalments: balance spread over 32 months during construction
  • Mortgage: available to qualifying buyers with a 30% down payment
  • Completion: scheduled for December 2028

Because this is an off-plan purchase, ask for the formal payment schedule in writing, with milestone dates, before you pay a deposit, and have an independent advocate review the sale agreement.

Why Mara Grove?

  • Borders Nairobi National Park, with full park views from Block C’s 7th floor upwards
  • About 600 metres off Mombasa Road and about 7 km from JKIA
  • 1, 2 and 3 bedroom homes from KES 4.8M, and every 3 bedroom has a DSQ
  • A resort-style pool, gym, clubhouse, kids’ play area and on-site shops
  • A 20% to 30% deposit, with the balance spread over 32 months
  • Six blocks on 2.7 acres, built in a single phase

Mara Grove for Investors

Mara Grove’s case rests on its setting and its access: a protected national park on its western boundary, and a site about 7 km from JKIA, 600 metres off Mombasa Road and close to the Expressway. Park-facing homes in Block C, and to a lesser degree Blocks B and D, have the most defensible views, while the one-bedrooms offer the lowest entry price at KES 4.8M. As an off-plan purchase completing in December 2028, weigh the developer’s record and the construction programme, and treat rents and resale values as unguaranteed.

We do not publish rental yields or appreciation forecasts for Mara Grove. If you plan to let furnished or as a short stay, confirm the building’s management rules first, and ask us for current rents on comparable homes in Syokimau.

Who Mara Grove Suits Best

  • Frequent flyers and airport-based professionals who want to live about 7 km from JKIA
  • Families who want three bedrooms with a DSQ, a pool and a play area on site
  • Buyers who want a home with a view across Nairobi National Park
  • Investors looking for an entry point in the Syokimau corridor from KES 4.8M

It suits less well buyers who need to move in before 2029, anyone commuting daily to Westlands or Gigiri, and buyers who want a standalone house with a garden of their own.

More Homes at Mara Grove and Nearby

Mara Grove homes

  • Mara Grove 1 bedroom apartments: 56 sqm in Block A from KES 4.8M
  • Mara Grove 2 bedroom apartments: 95 sqm in Block B from KES 7.5M
  • Mara Grove 3 bedroom + DSQ apartments: 136 to 166 sqm from KES 10.5M

More properties in Syokimau

  • Mango Tree Apartments, Kivulini Road: studio to 3 bedroom apartments from KES 3.8M
  • Urban Park Residence, Syokimau: studio to 3 bedroom apartments from KES 3.85M
  • Artesano Apartments, Syokimau: apartments on the Mombasa Road corridor from KES 4.7M
  • Sunpark Residence, Syokimau: 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from KES 9M
  • Browse all properties for sale in Syokimau

Frequently Asked Questions

Where are Mara Grove Apartments located?

On Muthama Access Road in Syokimau, Machakos County, about 600 metres off Mombasa Road. The 2.7-acre site borders Nairobi National Park, the Nairobi Expressway’s Mlolongo toll station is about 2.4 km away, and JKIA is about 7 km away by straight line.

What is the starting price at Mara Grove Apartments?

Prices start from KES 4.8 million for a 56 sqm one bedroom apartment in Block A. The published range runs to KES 12.8 million for the 166 sqm three bedroom plus DSQ homes. Ask us for the current price list before booking, as pricing can be revised as construction advances.

When will Mara Grove Apartments be completed?

The expected completion date is December 2028. The development is off plan and under construction, so confirm milestone dates in writing in your payment schedule and inspect progress on site.

What is the payment plan at Mara Grove?

A deposit of 20 to 30 per cent is payable on booking, and the balance is spread over 32 months during construction. Mortgage financing is available for qualifying buyers with a 30 per cent down payment.

Which units have Nairobi National Park views?

Block C has full, unbroken park views from the 7th floor upwards. Blocks B and D have partial park views, and Blocks E and F look onto the courtyard and the surrounding neighbourhood. Block A, which holds the one bedroom units, is not covered by the published views schedule, so confirm its outlook with us before you commit.

Do the three bedroom units include a DSQ?

Yes. All three bedroom homes, across Blocks C, D, E and F, include a domestic staff quarter. Sizes run from 136 sqm to 166 sqm depending on block and configuration.

What amenities does Mara Grove have?

A resort-style swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, landscaped gardens, a residents’ clubhouse, a kids’ play area and on-site shops, with high-speed elevators in every block, 24/7 manned security with CCTV, borehole and Mavoko water, and a backup generator for common areas.

What protections do I have when buying off plan here?

We cannot guarantee outcomes on a developer’s behalf, so we tell buyers to do the ordinary things properly. Ask for the sale agreement and the formal payment schedule in writing before you pay anything, have an independent advocate review both, request the title and the approvals for the site, and visit in person to see the construction for yourself.

Can I buy at Mara Grove from abroad?

Yes. We send the price list, floor plans and payment schedule digitally and arrange a video walkthrough of the site. Appoint an independent Kenyan advocate to act for you, and confirm the payment schedule and the developer’s bank details in writing before transferring any funds.

Can I buy at Mara Grove with a mortgage?

Yes. Mortgage financing is available for qualifying buyers with a 30 per cent down payment. Compare offers from Kenyan banks and get a pre-approval before you book, so the deposit and the loan line up with the payment schedule.

Ask for the current price list, floor plans and payment schedule, and Block Real Estate will arrange a site visit so you can see the park edge and the construction for yourself. Call or WhatsApp 0725 937 686 or email loyd@block.ke.

The 3 bedroom apartment at Riverside Azure is designed for buyers who want a central Nairobi home with more space and stronger long-term usability.

The layout offers room for family living, guests, home working and privacy. For families, the three-bedroom format provides practical daily comfort. For executive residents, it offers a polished base near Westlands and surrounding business districts. For investors, it can appeal to tenants who need more space and are willing to pay for location, security and convenience.

Located along Riverside Drive, the development places residents close to Westlands, Lavington, Kilimani, Kileleshwa and the Nairobi CBD. This makes the 2 bedroom typology ideal for couples, small families, professionals working from home and investors seeking a unit with broader rental appeal.

With apartment sizes ranging from approximately 98.00 sqm to 104.63 sqm, the 2 bedroom homes provide more room for daily living while remaining manageable in size and cost compared to larger family apartments.

Project Snapshot

A 2 Bedroom Apartment Designed for Flexible Urban Living

The 2 bedroom apartment is one of the most practical unit types at Riverside Azure because it gives buyers flexibility.

The second bedroom can serve as a child’s room, guest room, home office or additional sleeping space. This makes the apartment suitable for different lifestyles and rental strategies.

For homeowners, it offers enough room for comfortable daily living. For investors, it can appeal to a wider tenant pool than a 1 bedroom apartment, including professional couples, small families, corporate tenants and expatriates.

The 2 bedroom typology is especially attractive for buyers who want a central Nairobi apartment that can adapt as personal or market needs change.

Unit Types and Pricing

2 Bedroom Apartment Typologies

Price Range

The 2 bedroom apartments are indicated from KES 14,860,000 to KES 19,300,000.

Final pricing will depend on the specific unit, size, floor level, payment option, availability and any applicable offer terms.

Amenities

The 2 bedroom apartments give residents access to Riverside Azure’s shared amenities.

Lifestyle Amenities

  • Swimming pool
  • Fitness centre
  • Garden
  • Balcony provision
  • Wi-Fi connectivity

Practical Amenities

  • Parking
  • Security
  • Laundry room
  • Modern apartment layouts
  • Premium finishes, subject to confirmation
  • Close proximity to malls, schools and business hubs

Buyer Note

Buyers should confirm the final amenities, delivery timeline, service charge and management structure before committing.

Location Advantage

Riverside Drive remains one of Nairobi’s strongest addresses for buyers who want proximity to business, lifestyle and residential convenience.

From Riverside Azure, residents can access:

  • Westlands
  • Riverside business corridor
  • Lavington
  • Kilimani
  • Kileleshwa
  • Nairobi CBD
  • Restaurants and cafés
  • Shopping centres
  • Schools
  • Healthcare facilities
  • Hotels and corporate offices

The 2 bedroom apartment benefits strongly from this location because it can serve both lifestyle and investment needs.

A homeowner gets central convenience. An investor gets access to a tenant pool that may include families, professionals, expatriates and corporate tenants.

Payment Plan

The supplied information indicates flexible payment options.

Full Cash Payment

A 20% discount is indicated for full cash payment, subject to confirmation.

Installment Option

An installment plan is indicated with a 30% deposit and a 10% discount, subject to confirmation.

Buyer Advisory

Before reserving a 2 bedroom apartment, confirm:

  • Latest price list
  • Current availability
  • Floor level
  • Payment schedule
  • Reservation terms
  • Parking allocation
  • Service charge estimate
  • Legal fees
  • Handover costs
  • Completion timeline

Why It Works for Homeowners

The 2 bedroom apartment works well for buyers who want more space without moving into a large family home.

It suits homeowners who need:

  • A central Nairobi residence
  • A second bedroom for family, guests or work
  • Access to Westlands and surrounding neighbourhoods
  • A modern apartment with amenities
  • A manageable home in a prime address
  • Secure apartment living
  • A home that can serve changing lifestyle needs

For small families and professional couples, the 2 bedroom apartment offers a comfortable and practical Riverside living experience.

Why It Works for Investors

The 2 bedroom typology has strong investment flexibility because it appeals to multiple tenant profiles.

Potential tenant profiles include:

  • Professional couples
  • Small families
  • Corporate tenants
  • Expatriates
  • Consultants
  • Shared renters
  • Furnished rental clients
  • Long-term tenants working in Westlands, Riverside and CBD

Compared to a 1 bedroom apartment, the 2 bedroom unit may offer broader tenant appeal. Compared to a 3 bedroom apartment, it may be easier to manage in terms of entry cost and tenant affordability.

The supplied marketing information mentions high rental yield potential, Airbnb and long-term rental use. Buyers should treat these as possible strategies, not guaranteed returns.

Investors should confirm:

  • Comparable rents
  • Service charge
  • Furnishing budget
  • Building rental policy
  • Short-stay rules
  • Expected net return
  • Vacancy assumptions
  • Management costs

Finishes and Specifications

Riverside Azure is described as having modern architecture, premium finishes and spacious layouts.

Expected features include:

  • Spacious 2 bedroom layouts
  • Modern finishes
  • Balcony provision
  • En suite layout indicated in related listing details
  • Wi-Fi
  • Parking
  • Security
  • Laundry room access
  • Access to swimming pool and fitness centre

Buyers should verify exact finishing specifications from the latest technical schedule.

Key items to confirm include:

  • Flooring
  • Kitchen fittings
  • Wardrobe provision
  • Bathroom fittings
  • Water heating
  • Internet infrastructure
  • Backup power provisions
  • Parking allocation
  • Balcony size
  • Service charge structure

Who This Unit Suits Best

The 2 bedroom apartment is best suited for:

  • Professional couples
  • Small families
  • Diaspora buyers
  • Executive tenants
  • Investors seeking broader rental demand
  • Furnished rental investors
  • Corporate accommodation buyers
  • Buyers needing a home office
  • Buyers comparing Riverside, Kilimani, Kileleshwa and Westlands

It may not suit buyers who need a large family home, DSQ, private garden or standalone house.

What is the size of the 2 bedroom apartment at Riverside Azure?

The 2 bedroom apartments range from approximately 98.00 sqm to 104.63 sqm.

What is the price range?

The 2 bedroom apartments are indicated from KES 14,860,000 to KES 19,300,000.

The supplied details indicate Unit 03, Unit 04, Unit 07 and Unit 10 as 2 bedroom layouts.

Yes. It may suit small families, couples or buyers who need an extra room for guests, children or work-from-home use.

It may be suitable for investment because of its flexible tenant appeal and Riverside Drive location. Rental income should be independently assessed.

Parking is indicated as available. Exact allocation should be confirmed before reservation.

Amenities include a swimming pool, fitness centre, garden, laundry room, parking, security, Wi-Fi and balconies.

Is there a payment plan?

Yes. The supplied information indicates installment options, including a 30% deposit plan, subject to confirmation.

Call to Action

The 2 bedroom apartments at Riverside Azure offer a flexible option for homeowners and investors seeking space, location strength and modern apartment living along Riverside Drive.

listings.content_html:
Riverside Azure is an apartment development on Riverside Drive in Riverside, Westlands, about 250 metres from The Cube, with a swimming pool, gym and garden. One-bedrooms of 65.62 to 69.58 sqm are listed from KES 10.55M, with one special-offer one-bedroom at KES 8M cash, two-bedrooms of 98 to 104.63 sqm from KES 14.86M and three-bedrooms of 141.95 sqm from KES 22.43M.

Buyers can pay cash, with a 20% discount indicated, or in instalments with a 30% deposit and a 10% discount indicated; both are subject to confirmation. Sarit Centre is about 1.1 km away and the CBD about 3.5 km.

Riverside Azure at a Glance

Riverside Azure Prices by Unit Type

Starting prices from the information supplied for the development. Prices and discounts are subject to confirmation, so ask Block Real Estate for the current list and the units still available before you book.

Prices run to KES 13,190,000 for a one-bedroom, KES 19,300,000 for a two-bedroom and KES 26,230,000 for a three-bedroom. The special-offer one-bedroom is KES 8,500,000 on instalments.

The Homes at Riverside Azure

The layouts are listed unit by unit, so you can see exactly which sizes are on offer before you ask for floor plans.

1 Bedroom, 65.62 to 69.58 sqm

Units 01 and 02 are 69.58 sqm, Units 05 and 06 are 69.12 sqm and Unit 11 is 68.14 sqm, from KES 10,550,000 to KES 13,190,000. Unit 12, at 65.62 sqm, is the special offer at KES 8,000,000 cash. See the 1 bedroom apartments.

2 Bedroom, 98 to 104.63 sqm

Unit 03 is 98 sqm, Unit 04 is 104.41 sqm and Units 07 and 10 are 104.63 sqm, from KES 14,860,000 to KES 19,300,000. See the 2 bedroom apartments.

3 Bedroom, 141.95 sqm

Units 08 and 09 are 141.95 sqm, from KES 22,430,000 to KES 26,230,000. See the 3 bedroom apartments.

Amenities at Riverside Azure

Shared facilities cover fitness, outdoor space and the everyday practicalities. Confirm the final amenity schedule against the latest brochure.

Lifestyle

  • Swimming pool
  • Fitness centre
  • Garden

Practical

  • Laundry room
  • Parking
  • Security
  • Wi-Fi
  • Balconies

Location: Riverside Drive, Westlands

Riverside Azure is on Riverside Drive in Riverside, a quieter residential corridor close to Westlands, about 250 metres from The Cube.

  • The Cube: about 250 m
  • Riverside Square: about 1 km
  • Sarit Centre: about 1.1 km
  • Westgate Mall: about 1.5 km
  • Westlands centre: about 1.5 km
  • MP Shah Hospital: about 1.7 km
  • Kenton College: about 1.7 km
  • Nairobi Arboretum: about 1.8 km
  • Aga Khan University Hospital: about 3 km
  • Nairobi CBD: about 3.5 km
  • UN offices, Gigiri: about 4.2 km
  • International School of Kenya: about 5.6 km
  • JKIA: about 15.5 km

Straight-line distances from the site; road distances are longer and travel times vary with Westlands traffic.

Payment Plan

Riverside Azure offers two ways to pay, with discounts indicated on both, subject to confirmation by the developer.

  • Cash: full payment, with a 20% discount indicated
  • Instalments: a 30% deposit, with a 10% discount indicated
  • Special offer: Unit 12 (65.62 sqm) at KES 8,000,000 cash or KES 8,500,000 on instalments
  • Completion: scheduled for September 2028

Ask for the instalment period, reservation amount, legal fees and handover costs in writing before you reserve.

Why Riverside Azure?

  • A Riverside Drive address about 250 metres from The Cube
  • One-bedrooms from KES 10.55M, with a special-offer unit at KES 8M cash
  • Two-bedrooms of about 100 sqm and three-bedrooms of 141.95 sqm
  • A swimming pool, fitness centre and garden
  • Cash and instalment options, with discounts indicated on both
  • Sarit Centre about 1.1 km away and the CBD about 3.5 km

Riverside Azure for Investors

Riverside Drive draws professionals, expatriates and corporate tenants who want to be close to Westlands without living on its busiest streets. The mix of one-, two- and three-bedrooms covers most of that demand, and the indicated cash and instalment discounts lower the effective entry price if confirmed. We do not publish projected yields, so ask us for current Riverside comparables and check whether short-stay letting is allowed before you buy on that basis.

Who Riverside Azure Suits Best

  • Young professionals and couples who want a Riverside one-bedroom
  • Small families who want a two- or three-bedroom close to Westlands
  • Cash buyers who can use the indicated 20% discount
  • Diaspora buyers and investors targeting corporate and expatriate tenants

It suits less well buyers who want a standalone house, a garden of their own or a DSQ, or who need to move in before late 2028.

Due Diligence

Confirm the prices, discounts, payment schedule, completion date and service charge in writing, and have your own advocate review the sale agreement and title before you sign. Block Real Estate can introduce you to qualified property lawyers.

More Homes at Riverside Azure and Nearby

Riverside Azure homes

  • 1 Bedroom Apartments at Riverside Azure: 65.62 to 69.58 sqm from KES 10.55M
  • 2 Bedroom Apartments at Riverside Azure: 98 to 104.63 sqm from KES 14.86M
  • 3 Bedroom Apartments at Riverside Azure: 141.95 sqm from KES 22.43M

More properties in Riverside and Westlands

  • Cheval Riverside, Riverside Drive: 1 bed, 1 bed + study and 2 bed apartments from KES 8.5M
  • Executive Suites, Riverside Lane: 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from KES 7.2M
  • Diplomat Residencies, Peponi Road: 1 and 2 bedroom apartments from KES 5M
  • Brookside Oak Residency, Muguga Green: 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from KES 8.2M
  • Browse all properties for sale in Westlands

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does an apartment at Riverside Azure cost?

One-bedrooms are listed from KES 10,550,000 to KES 13,190,000, two-bedrooms from KES 14,860,000 to KES 19,300,000 and three-bedrooms from KES 22,430,000 to KES 26,230,000. One special-offer one-bedroom is KES 8,000,000 cash. All prices are subject to confirmation.

Is there really a one-bedroom for KES 8M?

One special-offer unit, Unit 12 at 65.62 sqm, is listed at KES 8,000,000 for cash or KES 8,500,000 on instalments. It is a single unit, so ask Block Real Estate whether it is still available.

What sizes are the apartments at Riverside Azure?

One-bedrooms are 65.62 to 69.58 sqm, two-bedrooms 98 to 104.63 sqm and the three-bedrooms 141.95 sqm.

Is there a payment plan at Riverside Azure?

Yes. An instalment option with a 30% deposit and a 10% discount is indicated, and cash buyers have a 20% discount indicated. Both are subject to confirmation, so ask for the current payment schedule before you reserve.

When will Riverside Azure be completed?

Completion is scheduled for September 2028. Ask Block Real Estate for the developer’s current construction programme in writing and check the completion clauses in the sale agreement before you commit.

What amenities does Riverside Azure have?

A swimming pool, fitness centre, garden and laundry room, with parking, security, Wi-Fi and balconies. Confirm the final schedule against the latest brochure.

Where is Riverside Azure?

On Riverside Drive in Riverside, Westlands, about 250 metres from The Cube, with Sarit Centre about 1.1 km and the CBD about 3.5 km away in a straight line.

Can I let my apartment as a short stay?

Riverside attracts furnished-rental demand, but check the building rules and sale agreement for any short-let restrictions before you buy on that basis. Rental income is not guaranteed.

Can I buy at Riverside Azure from abroad?

Yes. Block Real Estate arranges virtual viewings, emails the floor plans and price list, and works with your advocate in Kenya so the reservation, sale agreement and payments are handled remotely.

How do I get the Riverside Azure price list?

Call or WhatsApp Block Real Estate on 0725 937 686, or email loyd@block.ke, for the current price list, floor plans and payment schedule, or to arrange a viewing.

listings.content_html:
The two-bedroom home at Space Residence is the most generous layout in the tower — a corner residence designed for couples and small families who want space, light and a settled address in Kileleshwa. At 90.38 sqm (973 sqft), Type A pairs two comfortable bedrooms with an open living, dining and kitchen area, framed by floor-to-ceiling windows that draw in natural light and open the home out towards Nairobi’s skyline.

Unit Snapshot

The Home

Type A makes the most of its corner position, with an open-plan living space that flows naturally between lounge, dining and kitchen. Two bedrooms give households the room to spread out — space for a family, a guest room, or a comfortable home for those who simply value more room to breathe. Large windows keep the interiors bright and airy throughout the day, and the modern, minimalist finish creates a calm, contemporary backdrop for everyday life.

For the exact room configuration, request the detailed Type A floor plan from Block.

Pricing and Availability

Two-bedroom homes start from KES 9.653M, rising to approximately KES 10.809M on the higher floors. Prices step up with floor level; the full floor-by-floor price list and current availability are confirmed on enquiry.

Building Amenities

As a resident, you share the full suite of Space Residence facilities:

  • Rooftop swimming pool and rooftop gym
  • Sauna and terrace deck
  • Café / restaurant and residence lounge
  • Co-work space, gaming zone and kids’ play area
  • Reception, high-speed lifts and ample parking
  • Borehole water, backup generator and 24/7 security

Location

Space Residence sits in Kileleshwa, adjacent to Oloitoktok Road at the Gichugu Road junction — a green, established and central suburb bordered by Lavington, Kilimani and Westlands. Everyday needs are close at hand, with Lavington Mall, Junction Mall, Sarit Centre, Westgate, ABC Place and GTC all nearby, alongside the Nairobi Arboretum, Kenya High School and the University of Nairobi. Expressway links keep the wider city and the CBD within comfortable reach.

Buying and Payment

The payment schedule is confirmed at the point of enquiry — contact Block for the current deposit and instalment terms along with the latest price list.

Mortgage financing is available through our partner banks, including Absa, Stanbic, NCBA, KCB, HFC, Standard Chartered and Prime Bank.

Buying from the diaspora: A valid passport or Alien ID is sufficient to purchase. Block handles your KRA PIN registration, stamp duty is 4%, and the process can be completed remotely — we support the full journey from reservation to registration.

Who Type A Suits

The two-bedroom is the natural choice for couples and small families, buyers who want a dedicated guest or work room, and owners seeking the most spacious layout in the building in an established, central suburb.

FAQ

How big is the Type A apartment? Type A measures 90.38 sqm (973 sqft), making it the largest home at Space Residence.

How much does a 2 bedroom at Space Residence cost? Guide prices start from KES 9.653M and reach around KES 10.809M on the upper floors, depending on the exact floor. Request the current price list for a specific unit.

Which floors are the two-bedroom homes on? Type A homes are positioned as corner residences, two per floor, across the 3rd to 20th floors.

Can I buy from abroad? Yes — a passport or Alien ID is sufficient, Block handles your KRA PIN, stamp duty is 4%, and the purchase can be completed remotely.

To receive the latest floor plan, price list and payment schedule, or to arrange a viewing, get in touch.

listings.content_html:
Set in the leafy calm of Kileleshwa, Space Residence brings a considered, contemporary apartment address to one of Nairobi’s most established residential suburbs. Rising along Oloitoktok Road, this standalone tower holds 216 thoughtfully designed homes — from compact studios to generous two-bedroom apartments — each framed by large windows and open, light-filled layouts that make the most of the city skyline beyond.

It is a building designed around everyday ease: a rooftop pool and gym for unwinding, communal lounges and a co-work space for the rhythm of modern professional life, and the practical reassurance of borehole water, backup power and round-the-clock security. Whether you are buying your first home, a city base close to work, or a long-term asset in a well-connected part of Nairobi, Space Residence offers a calm, convenient and quietly premium place to live.

Project Snapshot

A Development Designed for Elevated Urban Living

Space Residence is a single, self-contained tower rather than a sprawling estate, which gives it a boutique feel and a straightforward, well-defined footprint. Each floor from the 3rd to the 20th offers the same considered mix of homes — three studios, five one-bedroom apartments, two one-bedroom-plus apartments with a study, and two two-bedroom apartments — so there is a layout to suit almost every stage of life.

The interiors lean modern and minimalist: clean lines, quality fittings and floor-to-ceiling windows that draw in natural light and open the rooms out towards Nairobi’s cityscape. It is a practical, comfortable style of living designed for people who value both function and a sense of calm at home.

Unit Types

Every home is designed around light, flow and usable space. Sizes and starting guide prices are set out below. Prices rise with floor level and vary by unit position within the building; the full floor-by-floor price list is available on request.

Two-bedroom homes at the upper levels reach approximately KES 10.8M. For the exact price of a specific floor and unit, request the current price list and floor plans at enquiry.

Amenities

Space Residence is a full-service building, with shared facilities designed to support comfortable, connected everyday living.

Recreation and wellness

  • Rooftop swimming pool
  • Rooftop gym
  • Sauna room
  • Terrace deck

Community, work and family

  • Café / restaurant
  • Residence lounge
  • Co-work space
  • Gaming zone
  • Kids’ play area
  • Reception area

Essentials and security

  • Borehole water
  • Backup generator
  • High-speed lifts
  • Ample parking
  • 24/7 security

Location Advantage

Space Residence sits in Kileleshwa, adjacent to Oloitoktok Road at the Gichugu Road junction — a mature, low-density suburb known for its greenery, quiet streets and central position within Nairobi.

The address places you within easy reach of several of the city’s key nodes. Lavington, Kilimani and Westlands are all close neighbours, and the surrounding area is well served by retail and lifestyle destinations including Lavington Mall, Junction Mall, Sarit Centre, Westgate Shopping Mall, ABC Place and GTC. The Nairobi Arboretum, Kenya High School and the University of Nairobi are all nearby, and expressway connections make the wider city — and the CBD — comfortably accessible.

It is a location that balances calm residential character with genuine everyday convenience: established, green and central, with the infrastructure of a suburb that has long been part of Nairobi’s premium residential map.

Payment Plan

The full payment schedule for Space Residence is confirmed at the point of enquiry. To plan your purchase, request the latest payment terms, deposit structure and instalment schedule directly from Block, along with the current price list.

Mortgage financing is available through our partner banks, including Absa, Stanbic, NCBA, KCB, HFC, Standard Chartered and Prime Bank. We are happy to help you compare options and connect you with the right lender for your situation.

Buying from the diaspora: Purchasing from abroad is straightforward. A valid passport or Alien ID is sufficient to buy, and Block handles your KRA PIN registration on your behalf. Stamp duty on the purchase is 4%, and the process can be completed remotely — we support the full remote purchase journey from reservation through to registration.

Why It Works for Homeowners

For those buying a home to live in, Space Residence offers a rare combination of location, lifestyle and low-maintenance living.

The range of layouts means you can match the home to your life — a lock-up-and-go studio, a comfortable one-bedroom close to work, a one-bedroom-plus with a dedicated study for those who work from home, or a two-bedroom for couples and small families. The building’s shared amenities take care of the extras, from staying active to hosting friends, while borehole water, backup power and 24/7 security handle the practicalities so you don’t have to. It is city living made genuinely easy, in one of Nairobi’s most settled and green suburbs.

Why It Works for Investors

Space Residence rests on strong location fundamentals. Kileleshwa is one of Nairobi’s established prime suburbs — mature, low-density and centrally positioned between Westlands, Lavington and Kilimani, with the surrounding infrastructure of a neighbourhood that has held its residential appeal for decades. New, purpose-built premium apartment stock in this part of the city remains relatively limited, which is worth weighing when considering the scarcity of comparable addresses.

The breadth of unit sizes, from studios through to two-bedroom homes, gives flexibility for different holding strategies, and the development sits on a registered plot (LR No 209/13291). As with any property decision, we recommend independent due diligence: Block does not guarantee rental income, occupancy or capital appreciation, and any projections should be assessed on your own analysis and professional advice.

Finishes and Specifications

Each residence is finished in a modern, minimalist style with quality fittings throughout. Floor-to-ceiling windows and open-plan layouts create bright, airy interiors that frame the city views and make everyday spaces feel generous and calm.

A detailed specification schedule — covering finishes, fittings, kitchens and bathrooms — is available on request and should be confirmed at the point of enquiry. Ask Block for the latest brochure and specification sheet to review the full detail.

Who This Development Suits Best

  • First-time buyers and young professionals drawn to a well-connected studio or one-bedroom in an established suburb.
  • Singles and couples who want a comfortable, low-maintenance home with full building amenities.
  • Work-from-home buyers who would value the one-bedroom-plus layout with a dedicated study.
  • Small families looking at the two-bedroom homes in a green, central location.
  • Diaspora buyers seeking a considered Nairobi base with a supported, remote purchase process.
  • Long-term owners who prioritise a settled, centrally positioned address with strong location fundamentals.

FAQ

Where is Space Residence located? Space Residence is in Kileleshwa, Nairobi, adjacent to Oloitoktok Road at the Gichugu Road junction — a central, green and established residential suburb close to Lavington, Kilimani and Westlands.

What unit types are available? The development offers studios, one-bedroom apartments, a one-bedroom-plus layout with a separate study, and two-bedroom apartments, ranging from 44.73 sqm (481 sqft) to 90.38 sqm (973 sqft).

How much do the apartments cost? Guide prices start from around KES 5.0M for studios, with two-bedroom homes reaching approximately KES 10.8M at the upper floors. Prices vary by floor and unit position — request the current price list for exact figures.

How many apartments are in the development? There are 216 residences in total, across the 3rd to 20th floors, with a consistent mix of studios, one-bedroom, one-bedroom-plus and two-bedroom homes on each level.

What amenities does Space Residence offer? Shared facilities include a rooftop pool and gym, sauna, terrace deck, café/restaurant, residence lounge, co-work space, gaming zone, kids’ play area, reception, high-speed lifts, ample parking, borehole water, backup generator and 24/7 security.

Is Space Residence suitable for diaspora buyers? Yes. A valid passport or Alien ID is sufficient to purchase, Block handles your KRA PIN registration, stamp duty is 4%, and the entire process can be completed remotely with our support from reservation to registration.

Can I buy with a mortgage? Yes. Financing is available through our partner banks, including Absa, Stanbic, NCBA, KCB, HFC, Standard Chartered and Prime Bank. Block can help you compare options.

What is the payment plan? The payment schedule is confirmed at the point of enquiry. Contact Block for the latest deposit and instalment terms alongside the current price list.

Is the development complete, and when is handover? Space Residence is an off-plan development. The construction status and handover timeline are to be confirmed at the point of enquiry — please request the latest project update.

How do I get the full price list or arrange a viewing? Get in touch with Loyd from Block using the details below, and we will send the latest brochure, floor plans, price list and payment schedule, and arrange a viewing appointment.

Ready to Find Your Space?

Space Residence offers a calm, well-connected and quietly premium way to live in one of Nairobi’s most established suburbs — whether you are buying a home or building a long-term portfolio. listings.content_html:
6040 Vista is a contemporary residential development in Ridgeways, Nairobi, positioned along the Northern Bypass corridor near Windsor Golf Hotel & Country Club.

Designed around space, greenery and practical family living, the development offers 2 and 3 bedroom apartments within a modern residential setting that provides convenient access to Ridgeways, Kiambu Road, Runda, Gigiri and the wider northern Nairobi corridor.

Current marketing information for the development lists 2 bedroom apartments of approximately 101 sqm from KSh 10.4 million, alongside larger 3 bedroom apartments from approximately KSh 15.4 million.

For homeowners, 6040 Vista offers an alternative to Nairobi’s denser apartment neighbourhoods, with larger layouts, landscaped spaces and family-focused amenities.

For investors, its location places the development within reach of several established residential, commercial and diplomatic neighbourhoods while retaining the quieter character associated with Ridgeways and the broader Kiambu Road corridor.

Project Snapshot

Important buyer note: the supplied property listing states a 2028 completion date and a 149 sqm 3 bedroom configuration. The project’s own website currently publishes phase-specific information that differs, including a 135 sqm 3 bedroom layout and an earlier Phase 1 completion target. Buyers should therefore request the latest approved floor plan, current price list and contractual handover schedule before reservation.

A Development Designed for Calm, Connected Family Living

6040 Vista has been conceived around a simple but increasingly valuable proposition: remaining connected to Nairobi while having more room to live.

Its location around Ridgeways and the Northern Bypass places residents close to established neighbourhoods, shopping destinations, international institutions and recreational facilities without positioning the project in the middle of a heavily commercialised high-rise district.

That distinction matters.

For families, a good apartment is not simply about the number of bedrooms. It is about whether the spaces work from Monday morning to Sunday afternoon.

Living areas need room for people to gather. Bedrooms need practical storage. Children need outdoor spaces. Parking, water, backup power and security need to function consistently.

6040 Vista brings these considerations together through relatively generous apartment layouts, landscaped communal areas, children’s facilities, a swimming pool and fitness amenities.

The result is a development that can appeal both to buyers looking for a primary residence and purchasers considering a longer-term residential investment.

Unit Types at 6040 Vista

2 Bedroom Apartments

From Approximately KSh 10.4 Million

The 2 bedroom apartments at 6040 Vista measure approximately 100.8 to 101.55 sqm, depending on the specific layout.

The supplied listing indicates pricing from approximately KSh 10,400,000.

At around 101 sqm, this is a relatively generous 2 bedroom configuration compared with many compact urban apartment layouts.

2 Bedroom Features

  • Approximately 100.8–101.55 sqm
  • Two bedrooms
  • Master bedroom ensuite
  • Additional family bathroom
  • Open-plan kitchen
  • Living and dining area
  • Private balcony
  • Practical storage
  • Bright contemporary interiors
  • Natural lighting

The project’s own current unit information shows two alternative 2 bedroom layouts, both at approximately 101 sqm, allowing buyers to compare configurations while retaining a similar overall floor area.

Who the 2 Bedroom Works For

  • Young families
  • Professional couples
  • First-time homeowners moving into the prime Nairobi market
  • Downsizers seeking easier property management
  • Diaspora buyers looking for a Nairobi base
  • Investors targeting professional and small-family tenants

Guide Price: From approximately KSh 10.4 million

Exact unit price and availability: To be confirmed at point of enquiry.

3 Bedroom Apartments

Spacious Family Configuration

The supplied Commercial Property Kenya listing presents the larger apartment as an approximately 149 sqm, 3 bedroom all-ensuite residence with a separate DSQ, marketed from approximately KSh 15.4 million.

Advertised 3 Bedroom Features

  • All bedrooms ensuite

  • Good storage
  • Natural lighting

The additional space makes this typology particularly relevant to buyers planning to occupy their home for several years.

The DSQ also improves flexibility for households requiring staff accommodation, additional storage or a separately functioning service area.

Because this differs from the 149 sqm configuration contained in the supplied sales listing, the exact layouts currently available should be confirmed against the latest developer inventory and approved floor plans.

Amenities at 6040 Vista

6040 Vista incorporates a mix of lifestyle facilities and practical residential infrastructure intended to support everyday living.

Swimming Pool

A residents’ swimming pool and surrounding lounging area create a central leisure space within the development.

For families in particular, having recreational facilities inside the compound can make the development more practical for weekend and after-school use.

Fitness Centre

A residents’ fitness facility is included among the advertised amenities, providing convenient access to exercise without requiring a separate external gym membership.

Landscaped Gardens

Landscaped external spaces contribute to the development’s quieter residential character and provide a softer transition between apartment buildings and communal areas.

Children’s Play Area

Walking Paths

Pedestrian and walking areas make the landscaped sections of the development more usable rather than purely decorative.

High-Speed Lifts

Backup Power

6040 Vista is positioned around Gitere near the Northern Bypass, approximately 100 metres from the bypass according to the project’s official location information.

Investors should still compare it carefully against competing developments along Ridgeways, Kiambu Road, Thindigua and Ruaka before purchasing.

The numbers should be tested independently.

Type B provides approximately 44 additional square feet compared with Type A, and starts lower at KES 18,200,000 to KES 19,000,000 — making it the most accessible two-bedroom in the development. Comparing the Two-Bedroom Options

Kilimani has quietly become one of Nairobi’s most liveable urban neighbourhoods — central, green in parts, and full of the everyday conveniences that make city life easy. Bahari Central sits right in the middle of it, at the junction of Kilimani Road and Menelik Road, offering a considered collection of 1 and 2 bedroom apartments for people who want to live close to everything.

This is an off-plan opportunity with an accessible entry point, a flexible payment structure and a completion date in March 2028. Whether you are buying your first home, a city base, or a well-located rental unit, Bahari Central is worth a close look.

At Block Real Estate, our role is to help you decide with clarity. Below is everything currently confirmed about the development, along with guidance on what to request before you commit.

Project Snapshot

Prices, sizes and availability are indicative and subject to change. Please request the latest brochure, floor plans and price list at the point of enquiry.

A Development Designed for Modern Urban Living

Bahari Central is built for the way people want to live in Kilimani today — close to work, close to the city’s best amenities, and inside a secure, well-serviced building. The apartments favour efficient, liveable layouts, with fitted kitchens and access to a genuinely useful set of shared facilities, from a swimming pool and gym to reliable backup power and water.

It is a practical, well-located choice: compact enough to be accessible, central enough to keep everything within easy reach, and specified with the essentials that make day-to-day living in Nairobi straightforward.

Unit Types

Bahari Central offers a focused range of 1 and 2 bedroom homes to suit different budgets and needs.

The 1 bedroom units offer an accessible entry into central Kilimani, well suited to first-time buyers, single professionals and investors seeking a compact, lettable unit. The 2 bedroom homes give couples and small families more room, with a choice of sizes to match your budget and space needs.

Pricing reflects the current price list and is confirmed at reservation. Bathroom configuration and parking allocation are to be confirmed from the latest floor plan — please request it from Block Real Estate.

Amenities

Bahari Central pairs private comfort with a practical set of shared facilities:

  • Swimming pool
  • Fully equipped gym
  • Backup generator for reliable power continuity
  • Borehole water supply for water security
  • Intercom system
  • 24/7 security
  • High-speed lifts
  • Fitted kitchens

Amenity provision may vary by unit and phase. Parking, balcony provision and any additional facilities should be confirmed in the current brochure at the point of enquiry.

Location Advantage

Kilimani is one of Nairobi’s most central and convenient neighbourhoods — a mixed-use hub of apartments, offices, restaurants, malls, schools, hospitals and embassies. Bahari Central’s position at the junction of Kilimani Road and Menelik Road places you within easy reach of the things that matter day to day.

  • Central Kilimani address — close to the neighbourhood’s shopping, dining, banking and medical amenities, including nearby malls such as Yaya Centre and Prestige Plaza
  • Business districts nearby — quick access to the Kilimani and Upper Hill commercial hubs, home to corporates, NGOs and professional-services firms
  • Well connected — easy links to Ngong Road, Argwings Kodhek Road and other key routes, with the CBD comfortably close
  • Everyday convenience — schools, healthcare, places of worship and green space all within the wider neighbourhood
  • Strong, established demand — Kilimani’s depth of amenities and central position make it a consistently sought-after residential address

Specific drive times vary with traffic and route, and can be confirmed at the point of enquiry.

Payment Plan

Bahari Central is offered on a structured, off-plan basis designed to make ownership manageable through construction:

  • Deposit: 20% on booking
  • Balance: 80%, payable in quarterly instalments through to April 2028
  • Cash buyers: Attractive discounts available
  • Completion: March 2028

This is a summary only. The full payment schedule — including instalment timing, reservation terms, legal costs and any service charge estimate — is confirmed at the point of enquiry. We recommend requesting the current written payment plan and reviewing it before committing.

Why It Works for Homeowners

For an owner-occupier, Bahari Central offers an accessible way into one of Nairobi’s most central neighbourhoods. You are close to work, shopping, healthcare and the city, inside a secure building with reliable water and backup power — the practical foundations that make daily life in Nairobi easy.

The homes are designed to be comfortable and low-maintenance, with fitted kitchens and access to shared facilities including a pool and gym. For first-time buyers in particular, the 1 bedroom units offer a realistic entry point into an established, well-serviced address.

Why It Works for Investors

Kilimani is a consistently in-demand rental market, supported by its central location, deep amenities and proximity to major employment hubs. That underlying demand is why the neighbourhood remains a long-standing favourite for both long-term letting and furnished or short-stay models.

The developer indicates projected monthly rents of around KES 70,000 for a 1 bedroom and KES 100,000 for a 2 bedroom unit. For context, these figures sit within the range currently seen for comparable Kilimani apartments, and independent 2026 market guides commonly cite gross rental yields in the region of 6–9% for well-managed stock in the area. The off-plan entry pricing at Bahari Central is also competitive relative to typical Kilimani values.

These are indicative figures for the broader market, not a guaranteed return on any specific unit. Actual rent, occupancy and resale performance depend on unit, finish, furnishing, management and market conditions at the time. We encourage investors to review their own rental assumptions, the service charge, furnishing costs and unit positioning — and to request the floor plan and payment schedule — before committing. We are glad to prepare an indicative, unit-specific projection on request.

Finishes and Specifications

Bahari Central is presented with a practical, contemporary specification designed to appeal to both owners and tenants:

  • Fitted kitchens
  • Secure building served by high-speed lifts
  • Backup generator and borehole water supply
  • 24/7 security and intercom system

Exact finishes — kitchen specification, wardrobes, bathroom fittings, flooring, balcony provision and parking allocation — should be confirmed from the latest brochure and specification sheet, as details may vary by unit and phase.

Who This Development Suits Best

Bahari Central is a strong fit for:

  • First-time buyers seeking an accessible, well-located entry into the Kilimani market
  • Single professionals and couples who want a short commute and a central, convenient lifestyle
  • Small families who value proximity to schools, healthcare, shopping and business districts
  • Investors targeting compact, lettable units in one of Nairobi’s most established rental neighbourhoods
  • Diaspora buyers looking for a manageable off-plan opportunity in a central Nairobi address, supported by a hands-on local agent

Westlands has long been one of Nairobi’s most sought-after addresses — close enough to town for an easy commute, established enough to have real infrastructure, and lively enough to offer restaurants, offices, schools and entertainment within a short drive or walk. Three layouts are available: the Premium at KES 26,500,000, the Grand at KES 28,500,000, and the 230 sqm Grand flagship at KES 34,500,000, which adds four bathrooms and a 270-degree wrap-around balcony that no other unit in the building offers.

The parking structure and show house are complete, so you can see the finished specification in person before you decide.

Project Snapshot

Information reflects Block Real Estate’s listing as verified on 10 August 2026. Availability and pricing are subject to change.

A Development Designed for Generous, Private Family Living

Four bedrooms call for a home that can hold different rhythms at once: children, guests, remote work, quiet evenings. Amani Residence gives that room to breathe. The open, sunlit layouts are framed by floor-to-ceiling windows, while the private areas of the home are designed to feel secluded and calm.

Outdoor living scales with the apartment. The Premium and Grand each have a double balcony, one space for socialising and one for quieter moments. The flagship goes further, with a 270-degree balcony that wraps three sides of the home and follows the sun from morning to evening.

At the base of the tower, central botanical gardens with curated native planting and quiet pathways provide a green, private counterpoint to the height of the building and the pace of Westlands beyond the compound. Soft, organic curves and layered textures give the interiors a warm, considered character.

*Calculated from the listed price and size, rounded. Not a valuation.

4-Bedroom Premium: 202 sqm, KES 26,500,000

The four-bedroom entry point at Amani Residence. Across 202 sqm, the double balcony gives you both a social outdoor space and a more private one. A good fit for larger households who want space for family, guests or a home office, in a Westlands address.

4-Bedroom Grand: 206 sqm, KES 28,500,000

Slightly larger than the Premium, with a double balcony and the Grand specification tier. The developer describes this tier as offering superior finishes and a more refined material selection. For buyers who care about detail, it is worth comparing the two in the show house.

4-Bedroom Grand (Flagship): 230 sqm, KES 34,500,000

The largest apartment in the building. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms, and a 270-degree balcony that wraps around three sides of the home, creating a terrace that follows the sun through the day. It offers the most expansive outdoor living space at Amani Residence, and is the only layout with this balcony.

Both have a double balcony. The Grand is slightly larger at 206 sqm and sits in the Grand specification tier, which the developer describes as offering superior finishes and a more refined material selection.

It’s a building designed for businesses that want a credible, well-connected base among blue-chip neighbours — and for investors looking for a quality commercial asset in one of the city’s most established office markets. Whether you’re buying to occupy or buying to hold, the proposition is the same: a prime address, modern specifications, and the kind of location that tends to hold its relevance over time.

The notes below cover what’s confirmed today. For the latest brochure, floor plates, price list and payment schedule, we’re happy to share the current pack on enquiry.

Project Snapshot

A Development Designed for Modern Business

Good commercial space is about more than square footage. It’s about how a space supports the working day — light, efficient floor plates, quick vertical transport, dependable power and security, and an environment that reflects well on the business that occupies it.

Fortis One is planned around exactly that. Office floors are laid out for efficiency and flexibility, suiting everything from a compact consultancy to a full corporate floor. The upper levels enjoy panoramic views across the Nairobi skyline toward the Ngong Hills, while shared rooftop lounge and business-club facilities give teams and clients a considered space to meet beyond the desk. At ground level, three retail floors bring footfall, convenience and a flagship restaurant with outdoor seating into the building itself.

The result is a calm, capable working environment in a genuinely prestigious setting.

Unit Types

Retail Spaces — Ground to Level 2 Three floors of premium retail designed for high-footfall occupiers — branded stores, financial institutions, showrooms, and a flagship restaurant with elegant outdoor seating well suited to business meetings and open-air dining. Pricing on application.

Office Suites — Levels 3 to 18 Meticulously planned office units from approximately 1,200 sq ft, with high-end finishes and efficient layouts. Well suited to corporate headquarters, law and consultancy firms, technology companies and startups. From approximately KES 15,000 per sq ft + VAT — roughly KES 18,000,000 for a 1,200 sq ft suite. Larger contiguous floor plates to be confirmed on enquiry.

Availability: the lower office floors — Levels 3 to 10 — are currently available. Level 11 and above is sold out; we’re glad to register your interest for resale opportunities on the higher floors should they arise.

Why It Works for Investors

listings.content_html:
If you’re a business looking for a quality, well-located address — or an investor seeking a foothold in Nairobi’s commercial heart — Fortis One is worth a serious look.

A new, purpose-built commercial development in Upper Hill, opposite the Radisson Blu, Fortis One brings together premium retail, efficient office suites and a signature penthouse office in one of the city’s most established and prestigious business districts. It’s designed for corporates, professionals, SMEs and investors who want presence, convenience and operational efficiency in a prime address. Here are the key details upfront, with the full picture below.

At a Glance

The Spaces: Three Ways to Take a Position

Fortis One is arranged across three distinct space types, from street-level retail to a landmark penthouse. Exact unit sizes, floor plates and current pricing are available on request.

Commercial Retail — Ground to Level 2

Three floors of premium retail space at the building’s most visible levels — well suited to branded stores, banks and showrooms. The retail offering also includes space for a flagship restaurant with elegant outdoor seating and an open-air dining experience, ideal for business meetings and adding life to the address.

Office Suites — Levels 3 to 18

Meticulously planned office suites starting from 1,200 sq.ft., with high-end finishes and efficient layouts designed for productivity. The flexibility suits a range of businesses — from a growing consultancy or startup to a corporate headquarters — all maintaining a strong presence in a prime commercial address.

Signature Penthouse Office — Levels 19 & 20

A rare, large-format penthouse office of 10,800 sq.ft. across two levels, complete with a private rooftop terrace and panoramic views of the Nairobi skyline and Ngong Hills. Premium spaces of this scale and prominence are in limited supply, making this a standout option for a flagship corporate floor.

Floor plates, available units and current pricing for each space type are confirmed at the point of enquiry.

A Development Designed for Business

Fortis One is built to help businesses operate effectively while maintaining a strong corporate presence in a prime address.

Its modern architecture pairs a striking high-rise form with practical, efficient interiors — thoughtful layouts that work hard for the businesses inside, supported by professional shared spaces and high-quality finishes. Set opposite the Radisson Blu and surrounded by blue-chip companies, banks and embassies, it offers genuine prestige and connectivity, while the mix of retail, offices and a signature penthouse means the building suits everyone from a street-level retailer to a corporate headquarters.

Amenities

Fortis One is built to modern commercial standards, with the practical infrastructure businesses rely on.

  • Access-controlled high-speed lifts
  • 24-hour security, CCTV and controlled access
  • Power backup generator
  • Ample, secure parking facilities
  • Professional reception and common areas
  • High-quality finishes in shared spaces
  • Recreational areas for tenants
  • WiFi provision
  • Energy-efficient building systems
  • Panoramic views of the Nairobi skyline and Ngong Hills

Location: Why Upper Hill

Upper Hill is Nairobi’s leading commercial and financial district — home to major corporates, multinational headquarters, financial institutions, embassies, hospitals, the Milimani and Kadhi Courts of Law, and government offices. It’s one of the most sought-after business locations in the city, and Fortis One sits right in the middle of it, opposite the Radisson Blu.

  • Central and connected — seamless access to the Nairobi CBD, Westlands, Kilimani and Karen, with easy links to major road networks and the Nairobi Expressway.
  • Close to JKIA — convenient for clients, partners and stakeholders travelling in and out of the city.
  • Surrounded by leading institutions — blue-chip companies, banks and embassies on the doorstep.
  • A growing financial hub — Upper Hill continues to develop as a high-density commercial centre, with established infrastructure and sustained tenant demand.

We’re happy to confirm the exact location and directions at the point of enquiry, and to arrange a viewing.

Pricing & Terms

Pricing for Fortis One is available on request (price on inquiry), and varies by space type, floor and size.

Purchase terms and any available payment structures are confirmed at the point of enquiry, so we’d recommend requesting the current price list and floor plates for the space you’re considering. Our team will set out the options clearly and answer any questions before you commit.

Request the latest price list, floor plates and terms at the point of enquiry.

Why It Works for Owner-Occupiers

For a business, owning your premises at Fortis One means securing a strategic, prestigious foothold in Nairobi’s commercial heart — and control over your own space. The range is genuinely flexible: a compact office suite from 1,200 sq.ft. for a growing firm, multiple floors for a larger corporate, or the signature penthouse as a flagship leadership floor. Add modern building standards — high-speed lifts, secure parking, power backup, professional common areas and energy-efficient systems — plus an address surrounded by blue-chip companies and excellent connectivity, and it’s a base that supports both day-to-day operations and your corporate image.

Why It Works for Investors

Upper Hill is an established, in-demand commercial district with sustained demand for quality office space and long-term commercial relevance. Fortis One’s mixed-use offering — retail, offices and a rare penthouse — broadens its appeal across different tenant types, and the building’s modern standards and prime position add to its attractiveness. Spaces of this quality also appeal to owner-occupier buyers, which is worth weighing alongside any leasing strategy.

A note on returns: we don’t quote guaranteed rental yields, occupancy or capital appreciation figures. Commercial demand, rents and values vary with the market and broader conditions and are never assured. We’d encourage any investor to carry out their own due diligence — and we’re glad to share current pricing and market context for the area on request.

Specifications

Fortis One is built and finished to modern commercial standards. Highlights include high-end finishes and efficient layouts in the office suites, high-quality finishes in the shared spaces, energy-efficient building systems, access-controlled high-speed lifts, secure parking, power backup, professional reception and common areas, and panoramic views of the skyline and Ngong Hills from the upper levels.

A full specification, along with floor plates and available-unit details, is available on request and is the most reliable source, as specifications can be updated through construction.

Detailed specifications, floor plates and availability to be confirmed via the brochure and our team.

Who This Development Suits Best

  • Corporates and multinationals wanting a headquarters or leadership floor in a prime address — including the signature penthouse.
  • Professional firms — law, consultancy, finance — seeking a credible, well-connected base.
  • Tech companies and startups wanting efficient, modern office suites from 1,200 sq.ft.
  • Retailers, financial institutions and F&B operators for the ground-to-Level-2 retail floors.
  • Owner-occupiers wanting to own rather than lease their premises.
  • Investors seeking exposure to Upper Hill’s commercial market.

Good to Know

A few details are confirmed at the point of enquiry, so you have accurate, current information before deciding:

  • Prices — on request; ask for the latest price list
  • Exact unit sizes and floor plates — available on request
  • Completion / handover date — to be confirmed at point of enquiry
  • Title / tenure — to be confirmed at point of enquiry
  • Service charge — to be confirmed at point of enquiry
  • Parking allocation / ratio — to be confirmed at point of enquiry
  • Developer — to be confirmed at point of enquiry

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Fortis One located? In Upper Hill, Nairobi, opposite the Radisson Blu — in the heart of the city’s leading commercial and financial district. We’re happy to confirm directions and arrange a viewing.

What spaces are available? Premium retail (Ground to Level 2), office suites (Levels 3–18, from 1,200 sq.ft.), and a signature penthouse office (Levels 19–20, 10,800 sq.ft., with a private rooftop terrace).

How big are the office suites? Office suites start from 1,200 sq.ft. Exact floor plates and available unit sizes are confirmed on request.

Tell me about the penthouse. The signature penthouse is a 10,800 sq.ft. office across Levels 19 and 20, with a private rooftop terrace and panoramic views of the Nairobi skyline and Ngong Hills — suited to a C-suite floor or an exclusive corporate suite.

How much does space cost? Pricing is on inquiry and varies by space type, floor and size. Reach out and we’ll send the latest price list and floor plates.

Is there parking? Yes — ample, secure parking. The exact allocation per unit is confirmed at enquiry.

Is it suitable for owner-occupation or investment? Both. Fortis One is well suited to businesses buying for their own use, and to investors leasing to high-quality tenants.

Can I buy from abroad or as a foreign investor? Yes. We can guide the purchase remotely, including help with KRA PIN registration and documentation. Applicable taxes, such as stamp duty, apply on transfer, and we’ll confirm the specifics for a commercial purchase and your situation.

How do I get the brochure and arrange a viewing? Reach out and we’ll send the latest brochure, floor plates and price list, and arrange a viewing at a time that suits you.
