Development at a Glance

About Oak Breeze Residences

Oak Breeze Residences is a collection of 1 and 2 bedroom apartments on Wood Avenue in Kilimani, one of the closest residential streets to the Yaya Centre end of the neighbourhood. The building pairs a contemporary elevation with the shared facilities buyers now expect in this part of Nairobi, and the unit mix is deliberately broad, running from a compact 45 sqm mini 1 bedroom up to a 96 sqm all ensuite 2 bedroom.

The development is by The Oak Group, managed by DMIS Company Limited. The group’s earlier Nairobi projects include Oak Classic, Diamond Oak, Silver Oak and White Oak. Oak Breeze Residences is sold off plan, with completion scheduled for June 2028.

Price List and Unit Types

Prices below are the published from-prices for each layout. Final pricing for a specific floor, aspect and finish level is confirmed in writing at the point of enquiry.

1 Bedroom Apartments

Three 1 bedroom layouts are offered. The mini 1 bedroom at 45 sqm is the entry point to the development and the lowest published price in the building at KES 5,650,000. The standard 1 bedroom adds five square metres at 50 sqm, and the spacious 1 bedroom at 59 sqm gives the most generous living area of the three.

2 Bedroom Apartments

The 2 bedroom range starts with Type A at 91 sqm and Type B at 95 sqm. The 96 sqm all ensuite plan gives each bedroom its own bathroom, which suits households sharing the apartment as well as families who want a fully private guest room.

Amenities at Oak Breeze Residences

The published amenity schedule is grouped into wellness, social and convenience facilities.

  • Wellness and recreation: rooftop swimming pool and garden, a fully equipped gym and fitness area, and a spa.
  • Social and business: a residents’ coffee lounge, a conference room for meetings, and an indoor kids play area.
  • Convenience and security: a ground floor reception with three high speed lifts per block, a mini-mart for everyday essentials, a full backup generator, borehole water supply, and 24 hour security with CCTV surveillance.

Location and Connectivity

Wood Avenue sits in the middle of Kilimani, within walking distance of the offices, schools and shopping that define the area. The published drive and walk times from the development are:

  • TDB Tower: 1 minute walk.
  • CJ’s, Kilimani branch: 2 minutes.
  • Yaya Centre: 3 minutes.
  • Kilimani Primary School: 4 minutes.
  • Nairobi Hospital: 10 minutes.
  • Nairobi CBD: 15 minutes.

Payment Plan and the Investment Case

Ownership is structured around a 20 per cent deposit on booking, with the balance paid in monthly instalments across the construction period of approximately 33 months, to completion in June 2028. Existing developer material quotes an indicative instalment of about USD 2,058 a month for a 2 bedroom unit; the schedule that applies to your chosen unit, and the currency it is quoted in, is confirmed at the point of enquiry.

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that prices at Oak Breeze Residences start from KES 5,650,000 for a 45 sqm mini 1 bedroom, and that the published payment plan is a 20 per cent deposit with the balance spread over approximately 33 months to completion in June 2028. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building’s management rules and on applicable regulations — worth confirming before you buy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Oak Breeze Residences located?

Oak Breeze Residences is on Wood Avenue in Kilimani, Nairobi. The development is a one minute walk from TDB Tower, about two minutes from CJ’s Kilimani, three minutes from Yaya Centre, four minutes from Kilimani Primary School, roughly ten minutes from Nairobi Hospital and about fifteen minutes from the CBD.

Who is the developer of Oak Breeze Residences?

The development is by The Oak Group, managed by DMIS Company Limited. The Oak Group’s earlier Nairobi projects include Oak Classic, Diamond Oak, Silver Oak and White Oak.

How much do apartments at Oak Breeze Residences cost?

Prices start from KES 5.65 million for a mini 1 bedroom of 45 square metres and run to KES 12 million for a 2 bedroom all ensuite unit of 96 square metres. The full price list is set out above and is confirmed in writing at the point of enquiry.

What unit sizes and layouts are available?

There are three 1 bedroom layouts at 45, 50 and 59 square metres, and three 2 bedroom layouts at 91, 95 and 96 square metres. The 96 square metre plan is the all ensuite option, which gives each bedroom its own bathroom.

When will Oak Breeze Residences be completed?

Completion is scheduled for June 2028. The development is sold off plan, so the handover date is the developer’s programme and is confirmed in your sale agreement.

What is the payment plan at Oak Breeze Residences?

The published plan is a 20 per cent deposit on booking, with the balance spread in monthly instalments across the construction period of roughly 33 months. The exact instalment schedule for your chosen unit is confirmed at the point of enquiry.

What amenities does the development include?

The published amenity list covers a rooftop swimming pool and garden, a fully equipped gym, a spa, a residents’ coffee lounge, a conference room, an indoor kids play area, a ground floor reception with three high speed lifts per block, a mini-mart, a full backup generator, borehole water supply and 24 hour security with CCTV.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. A passport or Alien ID is enough to begin. Block registers your KRA PIN and handles the paperwork, and we can arrange a virtual walkthrough of the development and the show unit. Stamp duty of 4 per cent applies on transfer. Call or WhatsApp 0725 937 686 or email loyd@block.ke.

Book a Viewing at Oak Breeze Residences

We can walk you through the floor plans, the full price list and the payment schedule, and arrange a site visit on Wood Avenue or a virtual walkthrough if you are outside Nairobi. Quote Property ID 27915 when you get in touch.

Development at a Glance

About A-One Acacia

A-One Acacia Serviced Apartments is an off-plan residential development in Kilimani, Nairobi, set off Nyangumi Road immediately next to the Nigerian High Commission. Every apartment is sold fully furnished, and the building is run as a serviced address rather than a standard apartment block, with reception and concierge cover and shared facilities on site.

Two layouts are offered: a 1 bedroom standard and a 2 bedroom. Both are open-plan. Because the building is serviced and furnished, buyers should treat the monthly service charge as part of the true cost of ownership; the developer has not published that figure, so we ask for it in writing on every enquiry.

What Furnished and Serviced Actually Include

These are two separate things, and both are real product facts worth checking line by line before you sign.

Fully furnished means each apartment is handed over with furniture, modern appliances and fitted décor, so it is habitable on completion without a separate fit-out. The developer has not published a room-by-room inventory or a schedule of the appliance makes and models, so ask for the furniture pack specification in writing and check whether it is contractual or indicative.

Serviced refers to what the building provides on top of your apartment. On the developer’s published list that is 24/7 reception and concierge, an on-site restaurant and mini-bar, borehole water with a purification system, full backup power and 24/7 CCTV plus manned security. What has not been published is what the monthly service charge covers, how it is billed, or how much it is. Treat that as an open question and get it answered before exchange.

  • Fully furnished interiors

  • Rooftop swimming pool
  • Gym and yoga room
  • Business meeting rooms and co-working space

If you want distances checked for a specific school, office or hospital, tell us which one and we will measure it.

The Investment Question

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that A-One Acacia is an off-plan development off Nyangumi Road in Kilimani, next to the Nigerian High Commission; that every apartment is sold fully furnished in a serviced building; that prices start at KES 9,460,000 for a 59.16 sqm one bedroom and run to KES 17,720,000 for the largest two bedroom; that the payment plan is a 20% deposit with 8% quarterly instalments and the balance spread across 36 months; that projected completion is June 2028; and that the monthly service charge has not been published. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building’s management rules and on applicable regulations — worth confirming before you buy.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much do apartments at A-One Acacia cost?

Prices start from KES 9,460,000 for the 1 bedroom standard at 59.16 sqm. The 1 bedroom range runs to KES 11,640,000 and the 2 bedroom range from KES 15,030,000 to KES 17,720,000. Prices move with availability, so confirm the current price list with Block Real Estate.

What unit types and sizes are available?

Two layouts are offered. The 1 bedroom standard measures 59.16 to 66.13 sqm, which is 637 to 712 sq ft. The 2 bedroom measures 95.74 to 99.05 sqm, which is 1,031 to 1,066 sq ft. Bathroom counts have not been published by the developer.

What does fully furnished and serviced include, and what does it cost?

Fully furnished means the apartment is handed over with furniture, appliances and fitted decor. Serviced refers to the building: 24/7 reception and concierge, an on-site restaurant and mini-bar, borehole water with purification, full backup power, and 24/7 CCTV with manned security. The monthly service charge that funds this has not been published, so ask Block Real Estate for the figure and the schedule of what it covers in writing before you commit.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. Non-resident buyers can purchase apartments in Kenya, and diaspora purchases are routine on off-plan developments like this one. You will need identification, KRA PIN registration and a Kenyan bank account for payments, and you can appoint an advocate to act for you under power of attorney without travelling. Block Real Estate can arrange remote viewings and walk you through the steps.

What is the payment plan?

A 20% deposit secures a unit, followed by instalments of 8% paid quarterly, with the balance spread across 36 months. Terms are set by the developer and can change, so confirm the current plan before you budget around it.

When will A-One Acacia be completed?

Projected completion is June 2028. This is the developer’s projected date on an off-plan build, not a guaranteed handover date. Ask for the completion terms and any delay provisions in the sale agreement.

Can I short-let or Airbnb an apartment at A-One Acacia?

That depends on two things we cannot promise on your behalf. The first is the building’s own management rules, which govern whether short-stay letting is permitted and on what terms in a serviced block. The second is applicable regulation, including county and national licensing and tax requirements, which can change. We do not publish nightly rates, occupancy assumptions or income projections. Confirm both points in writing before you buy if this matters to your plan.

Where exactly is A-One Acacia located?

The development is off Nyangumi Road in Kilimani, Nairobi, immediately next to the Nigerian High Commission. Landmarks published for the area include Yaya Centre and Prestige Plaza, with road access towards Ngong Road, the Nairobi CBD, Westlands and Upper Hill. No measured drive times have been published, so we do not quote any.

Payment starts from a 20% deposit.

Listing updated: 23 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

About Capital Vista

Capital Vista is a contemporary residential development on Chania Avenue in Kilimani, Nairobi. It brings together compact one bedroom layouts, a one bedroom plus study option built around working from home, and two bedroom apartments for households that want more room, all inside a single serviced building.

The apartments are specified with energy-efficient appliances and fixtures, and units open onto balconies. The building is served by high-speed lifts, a full backup generator, borehole and underground water storage, CCTV surveillance and 24/7 security, with 175 dedicated parking spaces on site.

The project is being sold off-plan, with completion scheduled for March 2028.

Prices and Unit Configurations

Prices below are the published from-prices for each layout. Payment terms, availability and the current price list are confirmed at the point of enquiry.

One Bedroom Apartments

Two standard one bedroom layouts are offered, at 61 sqm from KES 6.4M and 63 sqm from KES 6.7M. A larger 83 sqm variant adds a dedicated study room, which suits buyers who need a separate work space without stepping up to a second bedroom. It is priced from KES 8.7M.

Two Bedroom Apartments

The two bedroom apartments run from 102 sqm to 110 sqm. The 102 sqm, 105 sqm and 107 sqm layouts have a master ensuite, priced from KES 10.7M, KES 11.0M and KES 11.2M respectively. The largest layout, at 110 sqm from KES 11.5M, is all ensuite, so each bedroom has its own bathroom.

Amenities and Lifestyle Features

Capital Vista is designed as a self-contained building, with shared facilities grouped around wellness, work and day-to-day reliability.

Wellness and Recreation

  • Heated swimming pool
  • Fully equipped gym
  • Steam room and sauna
  • Yoga studio
  • Jogging track circling the property

Social and Work

  • Conference room for business meetings
  • Residents’ cafeteria
  • Gaming room
  • Children’s play area

Essential Infrastructure

  • Full backup generator
  • Borehole and underground water storage
  • CCTV surveillance and 24/7 security
  • High-speed lifts
  • 175 dedicated parking spaces

Location and Connectivity

Capital Vista sits on Chania Avenue in Kilimani, with access to Ngong Road, Argwings Kodhek Road and the Nairobi CBD. Yaya Centre, The Junction Mall and Adlife Plaza are all within a short drive, and Kilimani itself is a mixed residential and commercial area with cafes, restaurants, shops and schools close by.

Payment Plan

  • Deposit: 20% down payment
  • Installments: monthly or quarterly payments spread over the construction period
  • Project delivery: March 2028

The Investment Case

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that prices start at KES 6.4M for a 61 sqm one bedroom apartment, and that units are sold off-plan on a 20% deposit with the balance payable in installments until completion in March 2028. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Capital Vista located?

Capital Vista is on Chania Avenue in Kilimani, Nairobi. It has access to Ngong Road, Argwings Kodhek Road and the Nairobi CBD, with Yaya Centre, The Junction Mall and Adlife Plaza a short drive away.

What unit types are available at Capital Vista?

There are one bedroom apartments at 61 sqm and 63 sqm, a one bedroom plus study layout at 83 sqm, two bedroom master ensuite apartments at 102 sqm, 105 sqm and 107 sqm, and a two bedroom all ensuite apartment at 110 sqm.

How much do apartments at Capital Vista cost?

Prices start at KES 6.4M for the 61 sqm one bedroom apartment and run to KES 11.5M for the 110 sqm all ensuite two bedroom apartment. The current price list is confirmed at the point of enquiry.

When will Capital Vista be completed?

Completion is scheduled for March 2028. The project is being sold off-plan until then.

Is there a payment plan at Capital Vista?

Yes. Buyers pay a 20% deposit and spread the balance in monthly or quarterly installments over the construction period, until completion in March 2028.

What amenities does Capital Vista offer?

Shared facilities include a heated swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, a steam room and sauna, a yoga studio, a jogging track, a conference room, a residents cafeteria, a gaming room and a children’s play area. The building has a full backup generator, borehole and underground water storage, CCTV surveillance, 24/7 security, high-speed lifts and 175 dedicated parking spaces.

What rental yield can I expect at Capital Vista?

We do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. A passport or Alien ID is enough to begin. Block registers your KRA PIN and handles the paperwork, and we can arrange a virtual walkthrough of the development. Stamp duty is 4% on transfer. Call or WhatsApp 0725 937 686 or email loyd@block.ke to get started.

  • Royal Legend Residence, Ndemi Road, Kilimani, from KES 14M
  • Golden Apple, Kilimani, 3 bedroom apartments near Junction Mall

listings.content_html:
Cheval Riverside is a 20-storey glass-prism tower on Riverside Drive, Westlands, next to The Cube, with a heated infinity pool on a two-level rooftop. It offers Luxury 1 Bedroom apartments of 62 to 72 sqm from KES 8.5M, Platinum 1 Bedroom + Study apartments of 77 to 82 sqm from KES 10.14M and Luxury 2 Bedroom apartments of 110 to 129 sqm from KES 14.85M, with completion targeted for mid-2028.

Six lifts, two of them panoramic glass lifts, serve the tower above four levels of secure parking. Buyers pay a USD 5,000 booking fee (about KES 645,000), a 20 to 30% deposit on signing and spread the balance over the build. Sarit Centre is about 1.4 km away and the CBD under 4 km.

Cheval Riverside at a Glance

Cheval Riverside Prices by Unit Type

Entry prices from the current price schedule. Prices rise with the floor, so ask Block Real Estate for the latest schedule and the units still available before you book.

On the top floors, the Luxury 1 Bedroom runs to KES 10,452,000, the Platinum 1 Bedroom + Study to KES 12,231,000 and the Luxury 2 Bedroom to KES 19,430,400.

The Homes at Cheval Riverside

Three layouts are on the current schedule, each offered across Blocks A, B and C, with different views depending on the block and floor.

Luxury 1 Bedroom, 62 to 72 sqm

The way into the tower, from KES 8,505,000 on the lowest floors to KES 10,452,000 at the top, with full use of the rooftop pool, gym and spa.

Platinum 1 Bedroom + Study, 77 to 82 sqm

A one-bedroom with a separate study that works as a home office or a guest room, from KES 10,140,000 to KES 12,231,000. It gives much of the flexibility of a two-bedroom for about KES 4.7M less than the entry two-bedroom.

Luxury 2 Bedroom, 110 to 129 sqm

The largest layout on the current schedule, from KES 14,850,000 to KES 19,430,400. At 110 sqm and up it is larger than most Westlands two-bedrooms, with room for a family or for two sharers.

Platinum 2 Bedroom: ask about availability

The developer’s April 2026 launch schedule also listed a Platinum 2 Bedroom of 124 to 138 sqm from KES 18.6M. It is not on the current price schedule, so ask Block Real Estate whether it is still offered.

Architecture: A Glass-Prism Tower in Three Blocks

The design is built around a curvilinear façade and a central glass prism that brings daylight down through the core of the building. Blocks A and B face Kirichwa Grove Road on the quieter side, Blocks B and C face Riverside Drive, and the rear of Block A looks out towards Lavington.

Amenities at Cheval Riverside

The rooftop is the centrepiece: two full levels, 21 and 22, given over to wellness and social space, above a building run as a hotel-style residence.

Rooftop, Levels 21 and 22

  • Heated infinity swimming pool
  • Fully equipped gym
  • Yoga and wellness studio
  • Spa with massage suites
  • Residents’ clubhouse and lounge

Building and services

  • Six high-speed lifts, including two panoramic glass lifts
  • Four levels of secure parking
  • 24/7 security with CCTV
  • Borehole water supply
  • Full backup generator

Location: Riverside Drive, Westlands

Cheval Riverside is on Riverside Drive in the Riverside area of Westlands, among embassies, international organisations and corporate offices, about 100 metres from The Cube. The Westlands malls and the CBD are a short drive away.

  • The Cube: about 100 m
  • Sarit Centre: about 1.4 km
  • Kenton College: about 1.4 km
  • Westgate Mall: about 1.7 km
  • Westlands centre: about 1.9 km
  • MP Shah Hospital: about 2 km
  • Nairobi Arboretum: about 2 km
  • Aga Khan University Hospital: about 3.3 km
  • Nairobi CBD: about 3.7 km
  • UN offices, Gigiri: about 4.4 km
  • International School of Kenya: about 5.5 km
  • JKIA: about 16 km

Straight-line distances from the site; road distances are longer and travel times vary with Westlands traffic.

Payment Plan

Cheval Riverside is sold off plan, with a fixed booking fee, a deposit on signing and the balance spread over the construction period.

  • Booking fee: USD 5,000 (about KES 645,000 at an indicative exchange rate) to reserve your unit
  • Deposit: 20 to 30% on signing the sale agreement
  • Balance: instalments through construction to completion
  • Completion: mid-2028 (target)

The booking fee is set in US dollars, so the shilling amount depends on the exchange rate on the day you pay. The developer’s April 2026 launch schedule quoted a December 2028 handover, while the current schedule states mid-2028, so confirm the completion date in writing before you pay.

Why Cheval Riverside?

  • A 20-storey glass-prism tower on Riverside Drive, next to The Cube
  • A heated infinity pool, gym, yoga studio and spa across a two-level rooftop
  • One-bedrooms from KES 8.5M and two-bedrooms of 110 sqm and up from KES 14.85M
  • A one-bedroom + study layout that works as a home office or guest room
  • Six lifts, including two panoramic glass lifts, and four levels of parking
  • Riverside’s embassy and corporate tenant base, with Sarit Centre about 1.4 km away

Cheval Riverside for Investors

Cheval Riverside’s case is address and amenity: a distinctive tower on Riverside Drive with a hotel-grade rooftop, in an area where embassies, international organisations and corporate offices keep demand for quality rentals steady. In our view, a well-finished one-bedroom here should let for about KES 65,000 to 90,000 a month unfurnished, so at an illustrative KES 65,000 a one-bedroom bought at KES 8.5M would gross about 9% a year before costs. As an off-plan purchase targeting mid-2028, weigh the developer’s record and the construction programme, and treat rents and resale values as unguaranteed.

The developer markets the building as a hotel-style residence suited to short stays. Check the sale agreement and the building rules for any limits on short-term letting before you plan around it.

Who Cheval Riverside Suits Best

  • Investors who want a Riverside address with rooftop amenities that stand out in a rental listing
  • Professionals working in Westlands, Riverside or along the UN corridor who want a one-bedroom or a home office
  • Diaspora buyers building a Nairobi portfolio, with the purchase handled remotely
  • Families who want a two-bedroom of 110 sqm or more in a secure, central location

It suits less well buyers who need to move in before mid-2028, anyone who wants a garden or a standalone home, and buyers who need three bedrooms.

Due Diligence

Confirm the booking fee, deposit, completion date and unit availability in writing, and have your own advocate review the sale agreement and title before you sign. Block Real Estate can introduce you to qualified property lawyers.

More Homes in Riverside and Westlands

  • Executive Suites, Riverside Lane: 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from KES 7.2M
  • Diplomat Residencies, Peponi Road: 1 and 2 bedroom apartments from KES 5M
  • Brookside Oak Residency, Muguga Green: 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments from KES 8.2M
  • Hephe Palace, Westlands: studio to 3 bedroom + DSQ apartments from KES 6.2M
  • Marble West, Muthithi Road: furnished studios, 1 and 2 bedroom apartments from KES 8M
  • Browse all properties for sale in Westlands

Frequently Asked Questions

How much is an apartment at Cheval Riverside?

On the current price schedule, Luxury 1 Bedroom apartments of 62 to 72 sqm start at KES 8,505,000, Platinum 1 Bedroom + Study apartments of 77 to 82 sqm at KES 10,140,000 and Luxury 2 Bedroom apartments of 110 to 129 sqm at KES 14,850,000. Prices rise with the floor, to KES 19,430,400 for a top-floor two-bedroom.

What is the payment plan at Cheval Riverside?

A USD 5,000 booking fee, about KES 645,000 at an indicative exchange rate, reserves your unit, a deposit of 20 to 30% is due on signing the sale agreement, and the balance is paid in instalments through construction to completion. Confirm the current terms before you pay.

When will Cheval Riverside be completed?

The current schedule targets mid-2028, while the April 2026 launch schedule said December 2028. It is an off-plan development under construction, so ask for the current construction programme in writing and check the completion clauses in the sale agreement.

What is on the rooftop at Cheval Riverside?

Levels 21 and 22 form a two-level rooftop with a heated infinity pool, a fully equipped gym, a yoga and wellness studio, a spa with massage suites and a residents’ clubhouse and lounge.

What is the Platinum 1 Bedroom + Study?

A one-bedroom apartment of 77 to 82 sqm with a separate study that can serve as a home office or a guest room, from KES 10,140,000 to KES 12,231,000 depending on the floor.

Is there a Platinum 2 Bedroom at Cheval Riverside?

The April 2026 launch schedule listed a Platinum 2 Bedroom of 124 to 138 sqm from KES 18.6M, but it is not on the current price schedule. Ask Block Real Estate whether it is still offered.

Where exactly is Cheval Riverside?

On Riverside Drive in the Riverside area of Westlands, about 100 metres from The Cube, with a second frontage on Kirichwa Grove Road according to the developer. Sarit Centre is about 1.4 km away and the CBD about 3.7 km in a straight line.

What parking does Cheval Riverside provide?

Four levels of secure parking across Basements 1 to 3 and the ground floor. Confirm the bays allocated to your unit at enquiry.

Can I let my apartment as a short stay?

The developer markets Cheval Riverside as a hotel-style residence suited to short stays. Check the sale agreement and the building rules for any short-let restrictions before you buy on that basis.

Can I buy at Cheval Riverside from abroad?

Yes. Block Real Estate arranges virtual viewings, emails the floor plans and current price schedule, and works with your advocate in Kenya so the booking, sale agreement and instalments are handled remotely.

What tenure is offered at Cheval Riverside?

Full title is offered. The precise terms for each unit are confirmed at enquiry, so request the title documentation and have your own advocate review the sale agreement before signing.

How do I book a viewing at Cheval Riverside?

Call or WhatsApp Block Real Estate on 0725 937 686, or email loyd@block.ke, to arrange a site visit on Riverside Drive and receive the current price schedule, floor plans and list of available units.

Enquire About Cheval Riverside

Block Real Estate handles sales at Cheval Riverside. Ask for the brochure, floor plans, current price schedule and the payment plan for your preferred unit, or book a viewing. Call or WhatsApp 0725 937 686 or email loyd@block.ke.

listings.content_html:
Expressview Residency: 1, 2, 3 & 4-Bedroom Apartments for Sale in Lavington, Nairobi — From KES 6 Million

Expressview Residency is a modern residential development on Riara Gardens Road, off Riara Road, in the heart of Lavington, Nairobi. Offering 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom, and 4-bedroom apartments from KES 6 million, the development combines Lavington’s established residential appeal with apartment sizes that redefine what buyers expect at each price point — starting at 52 sqm for the 1-bedroom and reaching 202 sqm for the 4-bedroom.

The development is backed by a developer with five completed projects — Homeland Apartments, Dara Spring Apartments, Chiluma Apartments, Golden Century I & II, and Westpeak Apartments — and offers a 34-month off-plan payment plan with a 20% deposit. Expected completion is December 2028.

Why Expressview Residency — and Why Lavington

Lavington is one of Nairobi’s most established and sought-after residential neighbourhoods. It has been a preferred address for families, professionals, expatriates, and diplomats for decades — and the fundamentals that sustain that preference are structural, not cyclical.

Proximity to everything that matters. The Junction Mall and Nairobi’s leading retail destinations are minutes from Riara Gardens Road. Top international schools and universities — the institutions that families choose Lavington for — are in the immediate area. Hospitals and medical centres are accessible without crossing the city. Kilimani, Karen, Westlands, and the CBD are all directly connected via Riara Road and the Lavington road network.

Rental demand that does not fluctuate. Lavington’s tenant profile — expatriates, diplomats, senior professionals, corporate tenants on housing allowances — creates a rental market with high-quality tenants, low vacancy rates, and stable rents. The neighbourhood attracts tenants who pay reliably, maintain properties carefully, and stay for years rather than months.

Capital appreciation with a track record. Lavington property values have appreciated consistently over the past decade. Off-plan buyers who enter early in a development cycle benefit from the price appreciation that occurs between the construction phase and completion — the capital growth that rewards patience and early commitment.

Expressview Residency sits on Riara Gardens Road, off Riara Road — in the core of this market. Not on the periphery. Not in a satellite area marketed as Lavington. In Lavington itself.

Apartments for Sale at Expressview Residency — Sizes, Prices, and What Each Configuration Delivers

Expressview Residency offers four apartment configurations — each designed with significantly more space than the Nairobi market standard for its category. The sizes are not rounding errors. They are deliberate, and they change what each apartment type can deliver.

1-Bedroom Apartments for Sale in Lavington — 52 sqm, From KES 6M

The 1-bedroom at Expressview Residency is a proper apartment — a separate enclosed bedroom, a distinct living area, a functional kitchen, and a private bathroom. At 52 sqm, it delivers the layout that young professionals, couples, and single tenants search for in Lavington, at a price point that Lavington almost never offers.

KES 6 million for a 1-bedroom in Lavington with a pool, a gym, and a coffee bar is the entry point that most buyers assume does not exist. It exists here. The 1-bedroom captures the widest tenant pool in the development — young professionals, couples, expatriates, corporate tenants — and its KES 6M price makes it accessible to first-time investors and salaried professionals buying instead of renting.

Best for: First-time investors entering the Lavington market. Salaried professionals buying a first property. Portfolio investors buying volume at the lowest capital per unit. Diaspora buyers starting a Nairobi portfolio.

Read the full 1-Bedroom listing →

2-Bedroom Apartments for Sale in Lavington — 115 sqm, From KES 11M

The standard Nairobi 2-bedroom measures 70 to 85 sqm. The 2-bedroom at Expressview Residency measures 115 sqm — 35 to 65 percent larger than the market norm. This is the 2-bedroom that lives like a 3-bedroom: a master bedroom with full dimensions, a second bedroom that functions as a real room (not a converted store), a living and dining area that seats a family and hosts guests without rearranging furniture, and a kitchen built for cooking rather than reheating.

At KES 95,652 per square metre, the per-metre cost sits below the Lavington average for new 2-bedroom supply. The buyer gets more space at a lower rate per metre. In the rental market, the 115 sqm layout commands a premium over compact alternatives — and retains tenants longer because no competitor at the same rent offers the same square metres.

Best for: Families needing space beyond the standard 2-bedroom. Investors targeting the Lavington family-rental market. Expatriate and corporate buyers. Couples buying a first home with room to grow.

Read the full 2-Bedroom listing →

3-Bedroom Apartments for Sale in Lavington — 173 sqm, From KES 16.5M

At 173 sqm, the 3-bedroom at Expressview Residency delivers three proper bedrooms — each with the dimensions for a bed, a wardrobe, a desk, and floor space — plus a living and dining area built for a family of four or five, a kitchen that accommodates a full week’s cooking, and a bathroom configuration that eliminates the morning queue.

In Lavington, KES 16.5 million typically buys 100 to 120 sqm. At 173 sqm and KES 95,376 per square metre, this 3-bedroom provides 50 to 70 percent more space at a below-average per-metre cost. It is the family home where every room is a room — not a partition, not a converted corner, not a compromise. For the rental investor, the 3-bedroom is the highest-retention configuration in Lavington: families stay for years, vacancy is minimal, and the rent is stable.

Best for: Growing families buying a home in Lavington. Family-market investors targeting long-term tenants. Upgrading homeowners who have outgrown a compact 2-bedroom. Diaspora families building a home to return to.

Read the full 3-Bedroom listing →

4-Bedroom Apartments for Sale in Lavington — 202 sqm, From KES 19.8M

The 4-bedroom is the apartment that replaces the house. At 202 sqm — 2,174 sqft — it has the footprint of a townhouse on a single floor. Four bedrooms for a full family configuration: the master suite for the parents, a room for each child, and a fourth bedroom that serves as a guest room, a nanny’s room, or a home office. The living area has the proportions of a standalone home’s sitting room. The kitchen feeds a household.

At KES 19.8 million, the 4-bedroom costs a fraction of a comparable house in Karen or Kitisuru — and includes a swimming pool, a gym, a coffee bar, 24/7 security, and zero maintenance burden. The buyer who chooses this apartment over a house is not compromising. They are upgrading to a lifestyle where space and convenience coexist without the operational cost of a standalone property.

Best for: Large families needing four bedrooms. Premium-market investors targeting the highest-rent tenant tier — diplomats, corporate executives, senior professionals. Homeowners downsizing from a house without downsizing on space. Diaspora families building a Lavington home.

Read the full 4-Bedroom listing →

Full Price and Size Comparison — Expressview Residency

The per-square-metre cost reveals a pattern: the 2-bedroom and 3-bedroom configurations deliver the lowest cost per square metre in the development (KES 95,652 and KES 95,376 respectively), making them the strongest value propositions on a space-per-shilling basis. The 1-bedroom trades a higher per-metre cost for the lowest total capital outlay and the broadest tenant pool. The 4-bedroom commands a slight per-metre premium for the rarest configuration — 200+ sqm apartments in Lavington are genuinely scarce.

Payment Plan — 20% Deposit, Balance Over 34 Months

Expressview Residency offers a structured off-plan payment plan designed to make Lavington ownership accessible without a mortgage:

Step 1: Pay a 20% deposit on booking to secure your preferred unit.

Step 2: Pay the remaining 80% over 34 monthly instalments during the construction period.

There is no bank loan, no mortgage approval process, and no compounding interest. The buyer builds equity incrementally while the development progresses toward completion in December 2028.

For the 1-bedroom buyer, the monthly instalment is approximately KES 141,000 — comparable to what many Nairobi professionals currently pay in rent. The difference is that rent builds the landlord’s equity. This plan builds yours.

Lifestyle Amenities at Expressview Residency

The amenity package at Expressview Residency serves two purposes: for the owner-occupier, it creates the lifestyle that makes the apartment a home. For the investor, it creates the competitive advantage that keeps vacancy low and rent strong.

Swimming pool — the leisure amenity that elevates a development from housing to lifestyle, and that tenants in Lavington actively search for.

Fully equipped gym — fitness infrastructure within the compound, eliminating the cost and commute of an external membership.

Coffee bar — a social and co-working space within the development. Morning coffee. Afternoon work sessions. Evening catch-ups with neighbours. The amenity that most residential developments do not provide — and that tenants and residents use daily.

Children’s play area — dedicated, safe outdoor space for younger residents. The amenity that family tenants evaluate before they evaluate the apartment.

High-speed elevators — operational efficiency for daily life.

Borehole water supply — water security independent of county infrastructure, ensuring uninterrupted supply.

Intercom system — in-unit communication and access control.

24/7 manned security with CCTV surveillance — the comprehensive security infrastructure that Lavington residents and tenants require.

Developer Track Record

Expressview Residency is developed by a team with a proven delivery history across five completed residential projects in Nairobi:

Homeland Apartments — Completed and occupied. Dara Spring Apartments — Completed and occupied. Chiluma Apartments — Completed and occupied. Golden Century I & II — Completed and occupied. Westpeak Apartments — Completed and occupied.

Five developments built, finished, and handed over. For the off-plan buyer, the developer’s track record is the risk mitigation that separates a credible investment from a speculative one. Expressview Residency is not a first project by an untested developer. It is the next project by a builder who has delivered — repeatedly.

Location — Riara Gardens Road, Off Riara Road, Lavington, Nairobi

Expressview Residency is located on Riara Gardens Road, off Riara Road, in Lavington — one of Nairobi’s most established and connected residential neighbourhoods.

Nearby landmarks and destinations:

  • The Junction Mall — Nairobi’s leading retail and entertainment destination, minutes from the development
  • Top international schools and universities — the educational institutions that make Lavington a first-choice neighbourhood for families
  • Hospitals and medical centres — healthcare access without crossing the city
  • Kilimani — directly accessible via the Lavington–Kilimani road network
  • Karen — connected via Ngong Road and the southern Lavington corridor
  • Westlands — accessible via Waiyaki Way and the northern Lavington routes
  • Nairobi CBD — reachable via multiple arterial roads

Lavington’s location at the intersection of Nairobi’s key residential and commercial corridors is the reason the neighbourhood has sustained demand for decades. The tenant who rents in Lavington works in Westlands, Kilimani, or the CBD — and the commute is measured in minutes, not hours. The family that buys in Lavington has schools, hospitals, retail, and restaurants within a radius that makes daily life manageable without a complex logistics plan.

Who Should Buy at Expressview Residency

The Lavington investor — four apartment configurations from KES 6M to KES 19.8M, each offering more space per shilling than the Lavington market average, in a neighbourhood with proven rental demand and consistent capital appreciation.

The first-time buyer — the 1-bedroom at KES 6M with a 34-month payment plan is the most affordable entry into Lavington property ownership. A pool, a gym, a coffee bar, and a Lavington address at a monthly instalment of approximately KES 141,000.

Frequently Asked Questions — Expressview Residency, Lavington

Where exactly is Expressview Residency located?

listings.content_html:
Some homes are chosen for their address. Others are chosen for the space they give a family to live well. Five Star Hills, set beside Five Star Paradise off Kiambu Road in Runda, is built to offer both.

This is a closed collection of just 54 Signature Villas in a green, low-density enclave, deliberately removed from the pace of the city. Each villa is a four or five bedroom home of more than 4,500 sq.ft., with a statement fireplace, private patio and landscaped garden. Inside a fully secured perimeter, residents also share a clubhouse, a heated pool and estate-wide walking trails.

Construction begins in July 2026, with handover expected in March 2028. For buyers looking for a Runda villa for sale with generous proportions and a considered security setup, Five Star Hills deserves a close look.

Project Snapshot

  • Development: Five Star Hills
  • Location: Beside Five Star Paradise, off Kiambu Road, Runda, Nairobi
  • Total Homes: 54 Signature Villas
  • Villa Types: 4 Bedroom Canaan Signature Villa and 5 Bedroom Paradiso Signature Villa
  • Villa Sizes: From 4,575 sq.ft. (4 bedroom) to 5,285 sq.ft. (5 bedroom)
  • Prices: From KES 97,450,000
  • Construction Start: July 2026
  • Expected Handover: March 2028
  • Community: Gated, with 24-hour manned security

A Development Designed for Spacious Family Living

Five Star Hills is planned for households that want room: space to host, to spread out, and to grow into. The villas open from an expansive lounge and formal dining area onto a private patio and landscaped garden, so indoor and outdoor living flow together.

A statement fireplace anchors the main living space, and a dedicated family TV lounge keeps everyday life relaxed and separate from the formal rooms. Every bedroom is ensuite and configured as a private retreat.

The estate itself is low-density and green. Walking and jogging trails run across it, children have a dedicated play area, and a residents’ clubhouse gives the community a natural meeting point. It is a setting for a settled, permanent kind of living rather than a dense, high-turnover one.

Unit Types

5 Bedroom: Paradiso Signature Villa

  • Size: 5,285 sq.ft.
  • Five ensuite bedrooms
  • Expansive lounge and formal dining opening onto a private patio and landscaped garden
  • Statement fireplace and dedicated family TV lounge
  • Price: Please enquire for current pricing

4 Bedroom: Canaan Signature Villa

  • Size: 4,575 sq.ft.
  • Four ensuite bedrooms
  • Expansive lounge and formal dining opening onto a private patio and landscaped garden
  • Statement fireplace and dedicated family TV lounge
  • Price: From KES 97,450,000

Please request the latest brochure and floor plans for room-by-room layouts.

Amenities

Lifestyle

  • Exclusive residents’ clubhouse
  • Heated swimming pool for year-round use
  • Fully equipped modern gym
  • Landscaped children’s play area
  • Scenic jogging and walking trails across the estate

Security

  • 24-hour manned security
  • Estate-wide CCTV surveillance in all common areas
  • Perimeter boundary wall with electric fencing
  • Integrated estate security infrastructure
  • Provision for panic buttons and in-home alarm systems in each villa

In the Home

  • Ensuite bedrooms
  • Large windows
  • Laundry area

Location Advantage

Five Star Hills sits off Kiambu Road in Runda, one of Nairobi’s most established diplomatic and residential corridors. The Northern Bypass and Thika Superhighway link it to the wider city.

  • Shopping and leisure: Two Rivers Mall, Village Market and Ridgeways Mall are a short drive away.
  • Golf: Windsor Golf & Country Club and Muthaiga Golf Club are nearby.
  • Gigiri and the UN: The UN Complex and the diplomatic missions in Gigiri are easily accessible.
  • Schools: Brookhouse Runda, SABIS International School and Rosslyn Academy are in close proximity.
  • Healthcare: Aga Khan University Hospital and specialist clinics are within reach.
  • Westlands and Gigiri: Both are well connected via the Northern Bypass.
  • Nairobi CBD: Approximately 25 minutes.
  • JKIA: Approximately 55 minutes.

Travel times vary with traffic, so we recommend visiting at the hours you would normally travel.

Payment Plan

Five Star Hills is sold off-plan, and the development’s payment calculator is built around a deposit of 30%. Buyers can adjust the deposit and payment frequency to estimate their schedule.

For the Canaan 4 Bedroom Signature Villa, the purchase price is KES 97,450,000.

We recommend requesting the latest payment schedule and price list through Block Real Estate before making a decision, so you can confirm the figures against your own budget and financing plans.

Why It Works for Homeowners

  • Space that fits family life. Both villa types exceed 4,500 sq.ft., with a formal lounge and dining area, a separate family TV lounge, and ensuite bedrooms throughout.
  • A calm, green setting. Low density, landscaped surroundings and estate-wide trails give the community a spacious, unhurried feel.
  • Facilities on your doorstep. A clubhouse, heated pool, gym and children’s play area mean weekends can happen close to home.
  • Layered security. Electric fencing, CCTV in common areas, 24-hour manned security and in-home alarm provision give families practical peace of mind.
  • Established surroundings. Schools, hospitals, shopping and the Gigiri diplomatic area are all within easy reach.

Why It Works for Investors

Runda is an established address with limited developable land remaining within its estates, and Five Star Hills is capped at 54 villas. That limited supply, in a corridor with long-standing demand from diplomats, expatriates and returning diaspora buyers, is part of the case for the development.

The specification also supports a wider tenant pool. Fully ensuite bedrooms, built-in appliance kitchens, porcelain finishes and comprehensive security are features that family tenants and corporate occupiers tend to look for.

Buying off-plan, with construction beginning in July 2026 and handover expected in March 2028, means committing early in the delivery timeline. Returns, rental demand and capital appreciation cannot be guaranteed. We would encourage investors to review the payment schedule, test their own assumptions and speak with our advisors before committing.

Finishes and Specifications

  • Expansive lounge and formal dining opening onto a private patio and landscaped garden
  • Statement fireplace anchoring the main living space
  • Dedicated family TV lounge
  • All bedrooms ensuite
  • Elegantly designed kitchens with high-end built-in appliances
  • Porcelain tile finishes throughout
  • Premium flooring across living and bedroom areas
  • Large windows
  • Laundry area
  • Provision for panic buttons and in-home alarm systems

Who This Development Suits Best

  • Growing and multi-generational families who want generous space, private bedrooms and a garden
  • Diplomats, UN staff and international professionals who want proximity to Gigiri and an established, secure setting
  • Returning diaspora buyers looking for a large, move-in-ready family home in a well-known Nairobi address
  • Executives and entertainers who value formal dining, a patio, a fireplace and a clubhouse for hosting
  • Long-term investors who are comfortable with an off-plan timeline and a premium, low-supply market segment

FAQ

Where is Five Star Hills located?
Five Star Hills is in Runda, Nairobi, beside Five Star Paradise off Kiambu Road. It is linked to the wider city by the Northern Bypass and Thika Superhighway.

How many villas are in the development?
There are 54 Signature Villas in total, in two types: the 4 bedroom Canaan and the 5 bedroom Paradiso.

How big are the villas?
The 4 bedroom Canaan Signature Villa is 4,575 sq.ft. and the 5 bedroom Paradiso Signature Villa is 5,285 sq.ft.

What is the starting price?
Prices start from KES 97,450,000. Please contact Block Real Estate for the latest price list and availability.

When will construction start and when is handover?
Construction begins in July 2026, with handover expected in March 2028.

Are all bedrooms ensuite?
Yes. All bedrooms are ensuite and configured as private retreats.

What security features does the estate have?
The estate has 24-hour manned security, CCTV in all common areas, a perimeter boundary wall with electric fencing, and integrated security infrastructure. Each villa has provision for panic buttons and in-home alarm systems.

What amenities are available to residents?
Residents share a clubhouse, a heated swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, a children’s play area, and jogging and walking trails across the estate.

How far is Five Star Hills from Nairobi CBD and JKIA?
The CBD is approximately 25 minutes away and JKIA approximately 55 minutes, depending on traffic.

Is this a good fit for investors?
It can be for investors comfortable with off-plan purchases and premium-segment properties. Returns are not guaranteed, so we recommend reviewing the payment schedule and speaking with an advisor before committing.

Call to Action

Only 54 Signature Villas will ever be built at Five Star Hills. If a spacious Runda home with generous gardens and layered security is what you are looking for, speak with the Block Real Estate team about current availability, the latest price list and the payment schedule.

An exclusive gated enclave of fourteen presidential-style villas in Karen. 6 en-suite bedrooms, twin staff quarters, home theatre and private garden. From KES 150M, completion Q2 2028, 24-month payment plan.

Welcome to Hibo Manor — Presidential Living in Karen

For families searching for luxury homes for sale in Karen, villas with garden space, or serene family homes in Nairobi, Hibo Manor presents a rare opportunity: an intimate gated enclave of just fourteen presidential-style 6-bedroom villas, set within Karen’s leafy, low-density heartland. This is a community designed for families who have outgrown the apartment and the standard suburban house — and are ready for the kind of residence that holds space for every chapter ahead.

Each villa spans approximately 9,349 sq ft (868 sqm) of impeccably designed living space, in a development where nature, privacy, and architectural elegance converge.

Exquisite Architecture

From the privacy of the driveway, the grand foyer welcomes you into a world where luxury architecture meets refined craftsmanship. The villa opens into sweeping interiors defined by clean contemporary lines, bespoke finishing, and an atmosphere of effortless sophistication.

At its heart, a stunning floating staircase — gracefully accented with vibrant indoor greenery — serves as both a sculptural centrepiece and a reflection of the home’s deep connection to nature.

The Signature Lounge

Designed for buyers searching for villas with expansive living spaces in Nairobi, the lounge is a soaring, sun-drenched expanse where design and comfort converge. A striking central fireplace anchors the room as its focal point — radiating warmth for intimate gatherings or peaceful evenings at home.

Esculent Dining & Chef’s Kitchen

The dining area celebrates indoor-outdoor living, perfectly suited for families who value connection. Framed by panoramic garden views, it elevates everyday moments — from casual breakfasts to special celebrations.

The adjoining chef’s kitchen with pantry flows seamlessly into a private outdoor herb garden, ideal for homeowners who appreciate fresh ingredients and natural living. A separate open-plan kitchen and a mud room with laundry access keep daily household function quietly out of sight.

A Room for Every Chapter

As modern families increasingly seek homes with a work office or flexible spaces, each Hibo Manor villa includes a multi-purpose room with endless possibilities — a quiet study, a creative studio, a fully-equipped home office, or an additional bedroom. It adapts effortlessly to every chapter of your life.

The Family Retreat

Journey to the upper level, where the family lounge presents a warm, inviting sanctuary for connection and shared moments. Just steps away, the home theatre delivers an immersive retreat for cinematic indulgence. Beyond it, a versatile space awaits — ready to be shaped as a children’s playroom, a wellness studio, or a focused home office.

Private Guest Haven

The guest wing is a private haven for friends or extended family, featuring two en-suite bedrooms thoughtfully designed for comfort and discretion. Opening onto a terrace with lush views, it provides a restful sanctuary — allowing guests to feel at home while the household moves to its own rhythm.

Master Suite — Reimagined

The impressive master suite redefines luxury living in Karen through its impeccable blend of design and functionality. Thoughtfully proportioned, it includes:

  • A private master lounge
  • A lavish en-suite bathroom
  • A walk-in closet
  • A serene garden-facing terrace

Three additional en-suite bedrooms sit on this floor, each with its own private terrace — perfectly balancing connection and personal space.

Indoor-Outdoor Living

For buyers searching for homes with outdoor spaces, Hibo Manor offers unmatched tranquillity. Every villa opens into lush greenery, mature trees, and curated landscaping designed for serenity. A custom-designed open-air amphitheatre provides an enchanting venue for movie nights, alfresco gatherings, or quiet reflection beneath the stars.

Tranquil Garden Terrace — and Your Own Pool

Just steps from the main living spaces, a shaded alcove offers an inviting retreat for family and friends, with a spacious terrace creating a luxurious outdoor living room ideal for hosting and relaxation. The terrace also features provision for a private swimming pool, giving each homeowner the opportunity to create their own resort-style oasis.

Why Karen, Why Hibo Manor

Karen remains Nairobi’s most established and sought-after suburb — defined by mature gardens, large plots, and the measured pace of life that high-net-worth households and the diplomatic community continue to choose. Within Karen, Hibo Manor sits among the most discreet and exclusive enclaves: just 14 villas, professionally managed security, and a genuinely intimate community.

Residents are within easy reach of Karen Country Club, Karen Hospital, The Hub Karen, Galleria Mall, Nairobi National Park, and Karen’s leading international schools (Brookhouse, Hillcrest, Banda). The Nairobi Expressway puts the CBD and Jomo Kenyatta International Airport comfortably within reach.

  • Mud room with laundry access

Ikhaya Sunrise is an off-plan apartment development on USIU Road in Thome, Nairobi, beside USIU Africa. It offers studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments from KES 3,120,000, sized 24–69 sqm (258–743 sq ft), with completion expected end of 2028. Verified amenities include a rooftop gym and three high-speed lifts per block.

Listing updated: 24 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

Bathroom counts, tenure, the developer name and a reference number are not published for this development, so we have left those rows out rather than estimate them. We will confirm each in writing at enquiry.

About Ikhaya Sunrise

Ikhaya Sunrise is an off-plan apartment development on USIU Road, in Thome on the Thika Road side of Nairobi. It is built around compact, efficient layouts — studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments — with shared amenities that do a lot of the work a small home cannot: a rooftop gym, a rooftop lounge with creative studio space, and a co-working hub in the building.

Homes are planned for practical space use and natural light. The published specification includes granite kitchen countertops with fitted cabinetry, imported sanitaryware, fixtures and fittings, built-in wardrobes, large windows and glass balustrade balconies. The two-bedroom layout has a master en-suite, and the one- and two-bedroom units include a utility area.

Price List by Unit Type

These are indicative starting prices for each unit type, published subject to availability. They are full purchase prices, not deposits or payment-plan instalments. Final pricing varies by floor, aspect and unit, and the price field elsewhere on this listing has carried a lower figure that we have not been able to reconcile — so please ask us for the current, confirmed price list before you commit.

The Units

Studio — 24 to 26 sqm (258 to 280 sq ft)

The entry unit and the one the KES 3,120,000 from-price refers to. A single open living and sleeping space with a fitted kitchen and a balcony. The number of bathrooms is not stated in the published specification; we confirm it against the floor plan at enquiry.

1 Bedroom — 46 to 47 sqm (495 to 506 sq ft)

A separate bedroom, a fitted kitchen, a balcony and a utility area. From KES 5,980,000.

2 Bedroom — 64 to 69 sqm (689 to 743 sq ft)

Two bedrooms with the master en-suite, a fitted kitchen, a balcony and a utility area. From KES 8,840,000.

Verified Amenities

  • Three high-speed lifts per block
  • Rooftop gym
  • Rooftop lounge and creative studio spaces
  • Co-working hub
  • Borehole and ample water storage
  • Backup generator for common areas
  • Landscaped recreation zones, courtyard and multi-purpose court
  • Secure parking and bicycle stands
  • ICT and fibre-ready connectivity
  • Controlled access, CCTV and a security system

Some amenity tags attached to this listing — a swimming pool, a rooftop cinema, a kids play area, in-unit laundry and wheelchair access — do not appear in the development materials we hold. Please treat them as unconfirmed and ask us to check them against the current drawings before you rely on any of them.

Location and Connectivity

Ikhaya Sunrise sits on USIU Road in Thome, immediately beside the USIU-Africa campus — the coordinates recorded for this listing put the site a few hundred metres from the university boundary. The wider setting is the Thika Road corridor, with the Thika Superhighway giving access to the CBD and out towards Ruiru and Thika.

The drive times below are the ones published in the development’s own materials. We have not independently timed them, and traffic on this corridor varies a great deal by time of day, so treat them as indicative:

  • Thika Road Mall (TRM) – about 5 minutes
  • Safari Park Hotel – about 5 minutes
  • Kasarani Stadium – about 7 minutes
  • Garden City Mall – about 10 minutes

USIU-Africa is a genuine landmark here and the reason the road carries its name. We name it as a location fact only; we draw no conclusions from it about who will rent, or how often.

The Investment Case

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that Ikhaya Sunrise is an off-plan development on USIU Road in Thome, Nairobi, adjoining the USIU-Africa campus; that studios start from KES 3,120,000 at 24 sqm, one-bedroom apartments from KES 5,980,000 at 46 sqm and two-bedroom apartments from KES 8,840,000 at 64 sqm; that completion is expected at the end of 2028; and that the shared amenities include a rooftop gym, a co-working hub, three lifts per block, a borehole with water storage and a backup generator for common areas. We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building’s management rules and on applicable regulations — worth confirming before you buy.

Compare Nearby Entry-Price Apartments

The closest comparable sub-market on our books is Mirema Drive, a little further along the Thika Road corridor, where entry-price apartments sit in the same bracket:

  • Royal Mirema West, Mirema Drive — studios and 1 bedroom apartments off Thika Road
  • Studio apartment, Royal Mirema West — 31 sqm from KES 2.5M
  • 1 bedroom apartment, Royal Mirema West — 40 sqm from KES 3.3M
  • Spacious 1 bedroom apartment, Royal Mirema West — 70 sqm at KES 5.2M
  • All Block Real Estate listings in Thome

Frequently Asked Questions

Where exactly is Ikhaya Sunrise?

Ikhaya Sunrise is on USIU Road in Thome, Nairobi, immediately beside the USIU-Africa campus, within the Thika Road corridor in Kasarani. The coordinates recorded for this listing place the site a few hundred metres from the university boundary.

Exactly what does KES 3,120,000 buy at Ikhaya Sunrise?

It is the indicative starting purchase price of a studio of about 24 sqm (258 sq ft). It is a full purchase price for that unit, not a deposit and not a payment-plan instalment. It is a from-price, so individual units vary by floor and position, and the price field elsewhere on this site has previously shown a different figure. Please confirm the current price list with us before you commit.

What unit types and sizes are available?

Studios of 24 to 26 sqm (258 to 280 sq ft), one-bedroom apartments of 46 to 47 sqm (495 to 506 sq ft) and two-bedroom apartments of 64 to 69 sqm (689 to 743 sq ft). The two-bedroom layout has a master en-suite, and the one- and two-bedroom units include a utility area.

When is Ikhaya Sunrise due for completion?

The development is off-plan, with completion expected at the end of 2028 according to the development materials. No firmer handover date has been published for this listing, and we will share the developer current construction programme at enquiry.

What amenities are confirmed at Ikhaya Sunrise?

Three high-speed lifts per block, a rooftop gym, a rooftop lounge with creative studio spaces, a co-working hub, a borehole with ample water storage, a backup generator for common areas, landscaped recreation zones, a courtyard and multi-purpose court, secure parking, bicycle stands, controlled access and CCTV.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. Non-citizens may hold Kenyan property on a leasehold interest, and apartments are normally sold on sectional title over that leasehold. You will need a passport or Alien ID and a KRA PIN, which we can help you register, and stamp duty of 4 per cent applies on transfer. We can arrange a virtual walkthrough and handle the paperwork on your behalf.

Can I let out an apartment at Ikhaya Sunrise?

Letting is a decision for you and your own advisers. We do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or forecasts of tenant demand, including demand from the university next door, because no one can guarantee them. If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building management rules and on applicable regulations, which is worth confirming before you buy.

Is a payment plan available at Ikhaya Sunrise?

The development is sold off-plan and a payment plan is offered, but the deposit, the instalment schedule and the completion terms are not published on this listing. We will share the developer current payment schedule and reservation terms alongside the price list. Budget also for statutory costs, including 4 per cent stamp duty.

listings.content_html:
Some neighbourhoods are built around houses. Lakehills is built around the people who live in them.

Set in a quiet valley off Kiambu Road, overlooking the Paradise Lost lake and minutes from Runda, Ridgeways and Gigiri, Lakehills is a gated community of 114 four-bedroom villas across 14.48 acres of landscaped greenery. Each villa has its own private garden, open-plan living and terraces or balconies extending from most rooms. Beyond your gate sits a shared community park and a residents-only retreat with an infinity pool, gym and yoga lawn.

Prices start from KES 44 million, with payment over 24 months and completion scheduled for Q2 2028. For families who want space, greenery and a real sense of community without paying the prices of Nairobi’s most established suburbs, Lakehills is a development worth a close look.

Project Snapshot

A Development Designed for Family and Community Living

Lakehills is planned around calm, connection and belonging. The master plan places villas facing the community park, the lake or the landscaped internal boulevard, so outlooks vary from home to home. Each villa sits within its own garden, with open-plan living spaces oriented toward the greenery.

Shared life happens at two hubs. Lakehills Park, a 23,751 sq ft landscaped space, has playing fields, picnic lawns, reflection pools, cabanas, a kids play area and a pickleball court. Lakehills Retreat is a residents-only leisure hub built around an infinity pool, with a lounge, outdoor dining spaces, a gym, a yoga lawn and a kids play area.

The result is a neighbourhood where children can play outdoors, neighbours meet naturally, and the working week can be balanced with movement, quiet and time outside.

Unit Types

Lakehills offers a single villa type: a 4-bedroom villa with a private garden, from KES 44 million.

Ground level

  • Double-height entry foyer with natural light
  • Glass-wrapped lounge beneath extended-height windows
  • Open-plan living, dining and kitchen spaces
  • Entertainer’s kitchen at the heart of the home
  • Discreet chef’s kitchen behind, keeping preparation out of sight
  • Private garden wrapping around the living spaces

First floor

  • Three en-suite bedrooms
  • Master suite with generous layout, refined textures and a private terrace
  • Terraces and balconies extending from most rooms
  • Elevated views

Exact villa sizes, plot sizes, room dimensions, bathroom counts and the configuration of any staff accommodation are to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Please request the latest floor plans and brochure.

Amenities

Lakehills Park

  • Playing fields
  • Picnic lawns
  • Reflection pools
  • Cabanas
  • Kids play area
  • Pickleball court
  • Outdoor movie lawn
  • Walkways

Lakehills Retreat

  • Infinity-edge pool
  • Lap pool
  • Play pool
  • Fully fitted gym
  • Yoga lawn
  • Refined lounge and outdoor lounge and dining spaces
  • Kids play area

Residents lounge

  • A flexible space to meet over coffee, work, read or host a book club

Details on security, access control, management arrangements, service charge and amenity opening hours are to be confirmed at point of enquiry.

Location Advantage

Lakehills is located off Kiambu Road, in a quiet valley overlooking the Paradise Lost lake. It sits minutes from the diplomatic corridor of Runda, Ridgeways and Gigiri, which borders some of Nairobi’s most established suburbs, yet the setting is calm and green.

The developer highlights two points about the area:

  • The northern corridor. The expansion of the UN complex has reinforced this part of Nairobi as a diplomatic hub, which the developer links to steady residential demand.
  • Planned road improvements. An upgrade of Kiambu Road to a dual carriageway is described as planned, which would improve access to the area.

Please note that infrastructure plans and timelines can change. Ask for the latest information on the road upgrade, and drive the routes to schools, workplaces and the CBD at your usual travel times before deciding. A full list of nearby schools, hospitals and shopping is to be confirmed at point of enquiry.

Payment Plan

Lakehills offers payment over 24 months. Deposit requirements, instalment amounts and dates, and what is payable at completion (Q2 2028) are to be confirmed at point of enquiry.

Please request the latest payment schedule and price list, and have your advocate review the sale agreement before you commit.

Why It Works for Homeowners

  • Space and privacy at a more accessible entry point. A four-bedroom villa with its own garden, from KES 44 million, in an area bordering well-known suburbs.
  • A layout built for family life. Open-plan living keeps everyone connected, while the chef’s kitchen keeps the main living space uncluttered when you host.
  • Outdoor living, every day. Private gardens, terraces, balconies, a community park and a lake outlook make the outdoors part of daily routine.
  • Amenities that build community. Children have a park, a play area and a play pool. Adults have a gym, a yoga lawn, a pickleball court and a lounge.
  • A quiet setting with city access. The valley feels removed from the noise, yet the neighbourhood is near Runda, Ridgeways and Gigiri.
  • Time to plan. A Q2 2028 completion and a 24-month payment period give buyers room to organise their finances.

Why It Works for Investors

Lakehills is an off-plan development, so it suits investors with a medium- to long-term view.

  • A scarce product type. The developer notes that well-planned, low-density villa communities in this neighbourhood are limited.
  • Demand drivers nearby. The area’s proximity to the diplomatic corridor and international institutions is one reason for interest in the neighbourhood.
  • Lower entry price than neighbouring suburbs. The developer positions Lakehills as offering a more accessible price point than the surrounding established areas.
  • Phased payments. Payment over 24 months lets investors stage their capital.
  • Community amenities. Shared facilities can support long-term desirability for both owner-occupiers and tenants.

Rental income, price appreciation and resale timing are not guaranteed. Off-plan purchases carry construction and timeline risk, and returns depend on completion, market conditions, fees and holding costs. We recommend requesting current comparable sales and rental data for the area, confirming the developer’s track record and completion safeguards, and taking independent financial and legal advice before purchasing.

Finishes and Specifications

Confirmed from the developer’s material

  • Double-height entry foyer
  • Glass-wrapped lounge with extended-height windows
  • Open-plan living, dining and kitchen
  • Entertainer’s kitchen with a separate chef’s kitchen
  • Private garden to each villa
  • Terraces and balconies to most rooms
  • Master suite with private terrace and refined textures

Full specifications, including flooring, kitchen and bathroom fittings, appliances, joinery, glazing, security and CCTV systems, power backup, water supply, and internet readiness, are to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Please request the latest specification sheet.

Who This Development Suits Best

  • Families who want four bedrooms, a private garden and safe outdoor space for children
  • Buyers seeking a community feel with a park, pools and shared spaces on the doorstep
  • Professionals connected to Gigiri, Runda and the diplomatic corridor who want a calmer home nearby
  • Buyers stepping up from apartments who want a villa with a garden at a more accessible price point
  • Longer-term investors comfortable with off-plan timelines and a Q2 2028 completion

It may be less suitable for buyers who need to move in immediately, or who want a smaller unit or lower ticket size.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Lakehills located?
Off Kiambu Road in Nairobi, overlooking the Paradise Lost lake and minutes from Runda, Ridgeways and Gigiri.

How many villas are in the development?
114 four-bedroom villas across 14.48 acres.

How much do the villas cost?
Prices start from KES 44 million. Confirm current pricing and availability at point of enquiry.

When will Lakehills be complete?
Completion is scheduled for Q2 2028. Please confirm the latest timeline at point of enquiry.

What is the payment plan?
Payment is over 24 months. Deposit and instalment details are to be confirmed at point of enquiry.

What amenities are included?
Lakehills Park (playing fields, picnic lawns, reflection pools, cabanas, kids play area, pickleball court, movie lawn) and Lakehills Retreat (infinity pool, lap pool, play pool, gym, yoga lawn, lounges), plus a residents lounge.

Does each villa have a garden?
Yes. Every villa is anchored by a private garden.

How big are the villas?
Sizes are to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Please request the floor plans.

Is the development gated?
Yes, Lakehills is a gated community. Confirm security arrangements at point of enquiry.

Is the Kiambu Road upgrade confirmed?
The developer describes a planned upgrade to a dual carriageway. Timelines can change, so please ask for the latest update.

Is Lakehills a good investment?
It offers a scarce product type near an established corridor at a lower entry price, but returns are not guaranteed and off-plan purchases carry risk. Review current data and seek independent advice.

Call to Action

If you can picture your family in a garden villa near the lake, with a park and pool a short walk from your door, speak to the Block Real Estate team. We will share the latest floor plans, price list and payment schedule, walk you through the master plan and arrange a site visit or private briefing.
