Luminara Residency is an off-plan development in Westlands, Nairobi offering 1 and 2 bedroom apartments from KES 6,830,000, sized 56 to 113 square metres (603 to 1,216 square feet). Residents share a rooftop temperature-controlled infinity pool with a sky garden, restaurant and gym overlooking the city.

Listing updated: 19 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

About Luminara Residency

Luminara Residency is one of the newer apartment developments coming up in Westlands. The building is anchored by a dark stone base and traced with sleek metal lines, and the architecture pairs fluid curves with bold geometric forms. Inside, the intent is closer to a hotel than a conventional block of flats: a double-height lobby designed as a social space, an executive reception between Towers A and B, and a ground-floor cafe that suits residents who work from home or meet clients near the building.

The location is the practical argument. Westlands is one of Nairobi’s main business and entertainment nodes, and the site sits within immediate reach of the area’s offices, restaurants and transport links. Apartments are laid out on an open-concept plan to make the most of natural light and city views, and every published layout has a balcony of some kind.

Prices and Unit Sizes

The published entry price for the development is KES 6,830,000. Prices move by floor, orientation and the stage of construction at which you reserve, so the figure for a specific unit is confirmed at the point of enquiry and put in writing before you commit. The current price list is below and is also available on request.

Special-Offer-Prices2026

Apartment Types and Layouts

1 Bedroom Comfort, 56 sqm (603 sq ft)

A compact open-concept residence. Its distinguishing feature is an enclosed balcony, which adds privacy and effectively extends the indoor living area. It suits a professional who wants a refined, low-maintenance home base in Westlands.

1 Bedroom Premium, 65 sqm (700 sq ft)

A layout arranged for a seamless flow between the living and sleeping areas, with a full-length balcony connecting the living room and the bedroom. It is the pick for anyone who wants the outdoor space to be usable from both rooms.

1 Bedroom Luxury, 82 sqm (883 sq ft)

The largest of the one-bedroom options. The open kitchen and living area merge with a 270-degree panoramic balcony that wraps the corner of the building, which makes it the natural choice for an owner who entertains and wants the skyline in view.

2 Bedroom Luxury, 113 sqm (1,216 sq ft)

A two-bedroom, two-bathroom residence with a 270-degree wraparound balcony that functions as a private sky garden. It is the largest published layout in the development and the one that works for a small family.

Amenities

Luminara Residency is designed to work as a self-contained building, with most of the shared facilities gathered on the roof and at ground level.

  • Rooftop sky deck: a temperature-controlled infinity pool, a fine-dining restaurant and a sky garden with panoramic views over Nairobi.
  • Wellness: a fully equipped modern gym with yoga space.
  • Business hub: an executive reception centre between Towers A and B, plus a premium ground-floor cafe.
  • Convenience: a ground-floor mini-mart for daily essentials.
  • Arrival: a hotel-inspired lobby designed as a social space for receiving guests.
  • Security and services: 24-hour manned security, CCTV surveillance and high-speed lifts.

Location: Westlands, Nairobi

Westlands is one of Nairobi’s principal commercial districts, and the development sits in the heart of it, with immediate access to the area’s business nodes, entertainment and dining, and the transport networks that connect it to the rest of the city. For buyers, the appeal is short trips: the office, the restaurant and the school run are all local rather than a commute across town. The exact plot, the road frontage and walking distances to specific landmarks are confirmed at the point of enquiry, and we will walk the site with you.

The Investment Case

On the investment case we keep our guidance honest: we do not publish rental yields, occupancy figures or capital-appreciation forecasts, because those depend on the market at the time you buy, let and eventually sell, and no one can guarantee them. What can be said plainly is that Luminara Residency is an off-plan development in Westlands, one of Nairobi’s main business districts, and that the published entry price is KES 6,830,000 against a smallest published layout of 56 sqm (603 sq ft). We are glad to help you review comparable sales and lettings and connect you with independent advisers.

If you are considering a furnished or short-let strategy, note that this depends on the building’s management rules and on applicable regulations — worth confirming before you buy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Luminara Residency located?

Luminara Residency is in Westlands, Nairobi, a commercial and residential hub with direct access to the city business nodes, entertainment districts and transport networks.

What apartment types are available at Luminara Residency?

Four layouts are published: a 1 Bedroom Comfort at 56 sqm (603 sq ft), a 1 Bedroom Premium at 65 sqm (700 sq ft), a 1 Bedroom Luxury at 82 sqm (883 sq ft) and a 2 Bedroom Luxury at 113 sqm (1,216 sq ft) with two bathrooms.

How much do apartments at Luminara Residency cost?

Prices start from KES 6,830,000. The current price for each specific unit, floor and orientation is confirmed at the point of enquiry, and the full price list is available on request.

What amenities does Luminara Residency have?

The development has a rooftop temperature-controlled infinity pool, a rooftop restaurant, a sky garden, a gym with yoga space, a ground floor cafe, a mini-mart, an executive reception between Towers A and B, a hotel-inspired lobby, high-speed lifts, CCTV surveillance and 24-hour manned security.

When will Luminara Residency be completed?

Luminara Residency is listed as off-plan and ongoing. The completion and handover date is confirmed at the point of enquiry, and we put it in writing before you commit.

What payment plan and tenure apply at Luminara Residency?

The payment plan and the tenure of the title are confirmed at the point of enquiry. We put both in writing, with the deposit, the instalment schedule and the title document you receive on completion.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. A passport or Alien ID is enough to begin. Block registers your KRA PIN and handles the paperwork, and we can arrange a virtual walkthrough of the site. Stamp duty of 4% applies on transfer. Call or WhatsApp 0725 937 686 or email loyd@block.ke.

How do I arrange a viewing at Luminara Residency?

Call or WhatsApp Block Real Estate on 0725 937 686 or email loyd@block.ke. We confirm current availability, share the price list and meet you on site in Westlands.

listings.content_html:
Silver Hill is a gated community of 94 Georgian-style 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses (218–231 sqm) by Unity Homes in Tatu City, priced from KES 38.5 million with tiered cash discounts of up to KES 7.2 million and 24–36 month payment plans. Phase 1 is sold out with handover projected Q2 2026; Phase 2 is selling now with completion projected Q2 2028. The estate sits near Tatu City’s wildlife sanctuary, about 30 minutes from Nairobi CBD.

Listing updated: 8 August 2026 · Prices verified against the developer’s current price list

There is a particular kind of appeal in a home that offers genuine space, a secure community, and enough distance from the city to breathe — while still keeping Nairobi within easy reach. Silver Hill, in Tatu City, is built around exactly that balance: a development of 94 residences finished in a refined Georgian design, set within a 5,000-acre planned municipality near Tatu City’s Wildlife Sanctuary, with 764 acres of green space at its doorstep.

Developed by Unity Homes — the developer behind several established Tatu City neighbourhoods, including Unity Parkside — Silver Hill suits buyers looking for a genuinely spacious family home outside the city’s density, as well as investors considering an asset within one of Kenya’s most established master-planned developments.

Project Snapshot

Ask our team for the latest brochure, floor plans, price list, and payment schedule — details are updated as construction progresses and units move.

A Development Designed for Family Living

Silver Hill’s townhouses are built around a private master floor and a refined Georgian design — a quieter, more classical architectural language than the glass-and-steel towers found elsewhere in Nairobi’s newer developments. Each home is arranged over 218 to 231 square metres, with open-plan living, a private garden of 53–92 sqm, and a dedicated utility room that makes the home practical as well as comfortable. Extended units in Phases II and III offer larger living and dining areas.

Set within the wider Tatu City master plan, the development pairs that private space with a genuinely communal setting: a private clubhouse, a landscaped central park, a modern gym, an outdoor pool, and children’s play areas designed to bring neighbours together — all within a five-thousand-acre municipality that includes 764 acres of dedicated green space.

Unit Types & Prices

  • Private master floor
  • Private garden (53–92 sqm yards)
  • Open-plan living
  • Dedicated utility room
  • Balcony

94 residences in total. Phase 1 is sold out; Phase 2 units are selling now. Exact floor plans, bedroom configuration by unit, and current availability are shared on request — speak to our team for the latest unit schedule.

Amenities

Silver Hill is set within a secure, green, and well-serviced community offering:

  • Private clubhouse
  • Outdoor swimming pool
  • Modern gym
  • Landscaped central park and green spaces
  • Children’s play areas
  • CCTV security
  • Backup generator
  • Parking spaces
  • Street lighting throughout the development

Location Advantage

Silver Hill sits within Tatu City, a 5,000-acre planned municipality in Ruiru, near Tatu City’s own Wildlife Sanctuary and surrounded by 764 acres of green space. The location offers a rare combination for a development of this scale: roughly 5 minutes from Thika Highway, about 30 minutes from Nairobi’s CBD, and approximately 45 minutes from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. For homeowners, this means genuine distance from the city’s density, framed by green space and proximity to wildlife, without losing straightforward access to it. For investors, it places the property within one of Kenya’s most established master-planned communities.

Payment Plan

Silver Hill offers structured 24 and 36-month instalment plans, along with tiered cash discounts of up to KES 7.2 million that reward earlier payments. Full payment terms, instalment schedules, and current discount structures are confirmed at point of enquiry — our team will share the latest schedule on request, including options for diaspora buyers purchasing remotely.

Why It Works for Homeowners

A 218–231 sqm townhouse, with a private master floor, private garden, and open-plan living, offers a level of space and privacy that is genuinely difficult to find within Nairobi’s city limits at this price point. Built-in Bosch appliances, stone countertops, and solar water heating add a level of everyday finish that reduces the usual post-purchase to-do list, while the wider Silver Hill community — clubhouse, pool, gym, central park, play areas — gives a family reason to spend more of daily life at home rather than travelling for it. The show home is open daily from 8am to 6pm, so you can walk the actual finish before you decide.

Why It Works for Investors

Tatu City’s scale — a 5,000-acre municipality with 764 acres of green space and its own Wildlife Sanctuary — and its position near Thika Highway, Nairobi’s CBD, and JKIA have made it one of the more established planned developments on the city’s outskirts. Silver Hill’s phase structure gives investors flexibility: Phase 2 off-plan units carry a comparatively lower entry price with time to pay over 24–36 months, while the tiered cash discount of up to KES 7.2 million materially improves the entry price for cash buyers.

As with any leasehold investment, actual rental performance, resale values, and appreciation will depend on market conditions at the time of letting or sale, and cannot be guaranteed. We recommend requesting current comparable sales and rental data for Tatu City, and consulting an independent advisor on the specifics of leasehold tenure, before committing.

Finishes and Specifications

  • Refined Georgian architectural design
  • Private master floor
  • Private garden (53–92 sqm)
  • Open-plan living areas
  • Stone countertops
  • Built-in Bosch appliances
  • Dedicated utility room
  • Solar water heating
  • Balcony

Detailed interior finish specifications and floor plans are available in the full brochure on request.

Who This Development Suits Best

  • Families seeking genuine space, privacy, and a secure, green environment outside Nairobi’s densest neighbourhoods
  • Buyers who value design — the Georgian architectural language and private master floor layout set Silver Hill apart from more conventional townhouse developments
  • Buyers prioritising connectivity who want easy access to Thika Highway, Nairobi CBD, and JKIA
  • Investors considering a leasehold asset within an established, large-scale master-planned development, with Phase 2 off-plan entry pricing and cash discounts

Frequently Asked Questions About Silver Hill

How much do townhouses at Silver Hill cost?

Prices start from KES 38.5 million for the 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses (218–231 sqm). Tiered cash discounts of up to KES 7.2 million are available, alongside 24 and 36-month instalment plans. Current pricing by unit is confirmed on the latest price list from Block Real Estate.

Who is the developer of Silver Hill?

Silver Hill is developed by Unity Homes, the developer behind several established Tatu City neighbourhoods including Unity Parkside. The community comprises 94 Georgian-style townhouses.

Is Silver Hill ready to move into?

Phase 1 (Units 1–35) is sold out, with handover projected for Q2 2026. Phase 2 units are selling now, with construction commencing Q2 2026 and completion projected for Q2 2028. Contact our team to confirm current unit-by-unit availability.

Where exactly is Silver Hill located?

Silver Hill is within Tatu City, near the Wildlife Sanctuary — roughly 5 minutes from Thika Highway, about 30 minutes from Nairobi CBD, and approximately 45 minutes from JKIA.

What payment plan is available at Silver Hill?

Unity Homes offers structured 24 and 36-month instalment plans, plus tiered cash discounts of up to KES 7.2 million that reward earlier payments. Request the current payment schedule and discount terms from Block Real Estate.

What is the tenure at Silver Hill?

Silver Hill is offered on a leasehold tenure. Please request full tenure details and terms at point of enquiry.

Can I view a finished home before buying?

Yes — the Silver Hill show home is open daily from 8am to 6pm. Contact Block Real Estate to arrange a site visit, or a virtual tour if you are buying from abroad.

Is Silver Hill a good investment?

Tatu City is an established, large-scale master-planned development with strong connectivity and 764 acres of green space. Phase 2 off-plan pricing, 24–36 month plans and cash discounts of up to KES 7.2M improve the entry point — though returns depend on market conditions, so request current comparable data before deciding.

listings.content_html:
Some homes ask you to compromise on space. The Opal does the opposite. This is a development built around genuinely large apartments — three, four, and five-bedroom homes that give a family room to spread out, entertain, and settle in for the long term, set in the heart of Nyali, one of Mombasa’s most sought-after residential areas.

Developed by Heimat Consult, The Opal comprises three residential blocks rising over thirteen floors, with a considered set of shared amenities — from two swimming pools and a fitness centre to a rooftop terrace and landscaped gardens — and secure basement and ground-floor parking. The apartments are designed for real family life at the coast: separate dirty kitchens, dedicated staff quarters, generous family areas, and ensuite bedrooms that open onto private balconies.

Below is everything currently confirmed about the development, together with the details worth requesting directly before you decide. Where a figure or feature has not yet been formally confirmed by the developer, we have said so plainly — we would rather give you the real picture than a polished one.

Project Snapshot

A Development Designed for Spacious Coastal Family Living

The Opal is, first and foremost, a family proposition — and the layouts make that clear.

Every apartment here is built to a generous scale, from the 322.6 sqm three-bedroom homes up to the 465.7 sqm five-bedroom residences. Inside, the plans are thoughtful in a way that matters day to day: a main kitchen paired with a separate dirty kitchen so the cooking mess stays out of sight, dedicated domestic staff quarters, a distinct family area alongside the main lounge, and a master suite with a walk-in closet and private bathroom. Most bedrooms are ensuite, and nearly every room opens onto a balcony — so coastal light and air run right through the home.

For families putting down roots at the coast, it is a home you grow into rather than out of. For those who value their space — room to host, room for children, room for extended family and staff — The Opal is designed around exactly that kind of life.

Unit Types

The Opal offers five apartment layouts across its three blocks. Sizes are shown in square metres with the square-foot equivalent alongside.

* The developer’s floor plans and price list show both Block B layouts at 376.0 sqm (4,047 sqft); the marginally smaller figure shown for B1 is drawn from the brochure’s summary schedule. The exact size for this layout should be confirmed at point of enquiry.

What’s inside each home. Across the layouts, apartments are configured with a main lounge and separate family area, a dining space, a fitted kitchen with an adjoining pantry and dirty kitchen, a laundry room, and dedicated domestic staff quarters (DSQ). Bedrooms are generously sized and largely ensuite, with the master suite including a walk-in closet, private bathroom, and balcony. Detailed room-by-room dimensions for each layout are set out in the brochure floor plans, which we’re happy to share on request.

Amenities

The Opal’s shared facilities are designed for wellbeing, security, and everyday convenience. Confirmed amenities include:

  • Two swimming pools — separate pools for ladies and gents
  • Rooftop terrace
  • State-of-the-art fitness centre
  • Sauna
  • Dedicated yoga space
  • Kids’ play area
  • Landscaped gardens
  • In-house café
  • Boardroom / meeting area for visitors
  • Laundry room
  • Reception
  • High-speed elevators
  • Multi-level parking with automatic number-plate recognition
  • Automatic power backup
  • Smart-house features
  • Waste-water treatment plant
  • CCTV surveillance, electric fence, and a dedicated access-control room for enhanced security

The precise specification and any usage terms for these facilities are set out in the development brochure — worth requesting so you know exactly what is included.

Location Advantage

Nyali is one of Mombasa’s most established and desirable residential suburbs, and The Opal sits comfortably within it — close to the area’s business, shopping, schooling, and leisure amenities, with the coast never far away.

The immediate surroundings are genuinely convenient. Within a short drive you’ll find:

  • Everyday shopping and dining: Chandarana FoodPlus, Nyali Bazaar, The Promenade Mall, and the well-known Tamarind Dhow and English Point Marina
  • Business and leisure: Epic Business Park, Nyali Cinemax, Wild Waters, Mamba Village, and the Nyali Golf & Country Club
  • Schools: The Mombasa Academy, Oshwal Academy, The Light International School, Busy Bee School, and Little Leaps International School, among others
  • Healthcare: Premier Hospital and Nyali Children’s Hospital

For a family, that combination is the real draw — reputable schools, healthcare, shopping, and recreation all within easy reach of home, in a neighbourhood known for its calm, green, coastal character. Specific distances and drive times can be confirmed at the point of enquiry, and we’re always happy to walk you through the surroundings on a site visit.

Payment Plan

The Opal is offered on a straightforward, construction-linked payment structure.

The developer’s terms call for a 30% deposit, with the balance payable in stages within the construction period, and a commitment fee payable within seven days to secure a chosen unit. The published price list is valid to June 2026.

Because the payment terms are central to planning your purchase, we’d recommend requesting the current, detailed payment schedule directly so you can budget against confirmed figures rather than assumptions. Block will share the up-to-date plan and talk you through it in plain terms.

Full payment schedule beyond the headline deposit: to be confirmed at point of enquiry.

Pricing

Prices at The Opal vary by block, apartment size, and floor level, generally rising with height. The table below sets out the developer’s current guide prices in Kenyan shillings.

Guide prices per the developer’s current price list (valid to June 2026). Selected units may already be sold or reserved — current availability is confirmed at the point of enquiry. Ground-floor and basement levels are allocated to parking.

A note on shared amenities and service charge. As a development with substantial shared facilities — two pools, a gym, gardens, security systems, and a waste-water treatment plant among them — The Opal will carry a service charge to maintain and run these amenities. The current service charge and exactly what it covers are worth confirming in writing before you commit, and Block will help you obtain those details as part of your enquiry.

Why It Works for Homeowners

If you’re buying a home to live in, the case here is space, quality of life, and location.

The apartments are large by any measure, and — more importantly — they’re laid out for how families actually live at the coast, with separate cooking areas, staff quarters, a distinct family room, and ensuite bedrooms opening to balconies. The shared amenities mean much of daily life sits within your own building: a morning swim, a workout, the kids in the play area, a coffee downstairs. And Nyali itself offers something increasingly rare — an established, green, well-serviced neighbourhood with schools, hospitals, and shopping close at hand.

For families, executives relocating to Mombasa, and anyone seeking a spacious coastal base, it’s a home that gives you room to breathe without asking you to move away from convenience.

Why It Works for Investors

For buyers considering a unit at The Opal as an investment, the reasoning rests on fundamentals rather than projections.

Nyali is a long-established, sought-after residential address in Mombasa, with steady demand from families, professionals, and the expatriate community — the kind of location factors that tend to keep well-presented, well-located homes in demand. The Opal’s large, well-specified apartments and full amenity offering sit at the upper end of the local market, which is a distinct segment with its own tenant and buyer profile.

We deliberately don’t publish projected rental yields or capital-appreciation figures for this development. Forward-looking returns depend on many variables — the price you buy at, the eventual service charge, market conditions, and how the building is managed — and we’d rather you assess those with real evidence than take a headline number on trust. What we will do is share comparable rental and sales data for Nyali, help you model the running costs, and give you an honest read on the numbers so you can reach your own judgement with confidence.

Finishes and Specifications

The Opal is presented as a modern, well-appointed development, and confirmed building specifications include smart-house features, high-speed elevators, automatic power backup, an on-site waste-water treatment plant, and a comprehensive security setup (CCTV, electric fence, access-control room, and automatic number-plate recognition).

The full interior finishes and specifications for the apartments — including kitchen and bathroom fittings, flooring, joinery, and any appliances — are set out in the developer’s specification schedule. As these details can vary by layout, we’d recommend requesting the current specification document and, where possible, viewing a show unit before you commit.

Detailed interior finishes and specifications: to be confirmed at point of enquiry. Request the latest specification schedule and floor plans.

Who This Development Suits Best

The Opal tends to suit:

  • Larger and multi-generational families who need genuine space, staff quarters, and multiple ensuite bedrooms
  • Executives and professionals relocating to or established in Mombasa, looking for a spacious, well-serviced coastal home
  • Families prioritising schooling and healthcare, given Nyali’s concentration of reputable schools and hospitals
  • Diaspora buyers seeking a substantial coastal home or a considered investment in an established Mombasa neighbourhood
  • Buyers seeking a lock-up-and-leave coastal base with amenities and security handled on their behalf

It’s less suited to buyers looking for a compact, low-maintenance city apartment, or to those who would prefer a home without the service-charge commitment that a fully-amenitised development involves.

Buying From the Diaspora

Buying from abroad is straightforward, and we handle the complexity on your behalf. A passport or Alien ID is sufficient to purchase — Block handles your KRA PIN registration and guides you through the 4% stamp duty and the rest of the process. Remote purchase is fully supported, so you can complete without needing to travel, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage. Just let us know you’re buying from the diaspora and we’ll tailor the process accordingly, including arranging a virtual walkthrough of the show unit and the neighbourhood.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where exactly is The Opal located? It’s in Nyali, one of Mombasa’s most established residential suburbs, close to Epic Business Park, English Point Marina, the Nyali Golf & Country Club, and a range of reputable schools and hospitals. The exact plot and access road are confirmed at the point of enquiry.

What apartment types and prices are available? The Opal offers 3-bedroom apartments from KES 22.0M, 4-bedroom apartments from KES 26.0M, and 5-bedroom apartments from KES 32.0M. Prices rise with floor level; the exact figure for a specific unit is confirmed on the developer’s current price list.

How big are the apartments? They’re generously sized — from 322.6 sqm (3,472 sqft) for the three-bedroom homes up to 465.7 sqm (5,012 sqft) for the five-bedroom residences, with separate family areas, dirty kitchens, staff quarters, and largely ensuite bedrooms.

What is the payment plan? The developer’s terms call for a 30% deposit, with the balance payable within the construction period and a commitment fee within seven days. The current price list is valid to June 2026. We recommend requesting the detailed payment schedule so you can plan against confirmed figures.

What amenities are included? Confirmed amenities include two swimming pools (separate ladies’ and gents’), a fitness centre, a rooftop terrace, a sauna, a yoga space, a kids’ play area, landscaped gardens, an in-house café, a visitors’ boardroom, multi-level parking, high-speed elevators, power backup, smart-house features, a waste-water treatment plant, and a comprehensive security setup.

Is there a service charge? As a development with substantial shared facilities, The Opal will carry a service charge to run and maintain those amenities. The current amount and what it covers are worth confirming in writing; Block will help you obtain these details.

When will The Opal be completed? The completion and handover timeline has not been confirmed here. Please request the current programme directly and we’ll share it as soon as it’s available.

Who is the developer? The Opal is developed by Heimat Consult Ltd.

Can I buy while living abroad? Yes. A passport or Alien ID is enough to purchase, Block handles your KRA PIN registration, and we support the full process — including the 4% stamp duty — remotely, so you can complete without travelling.

Ready to Take a Closer Look?

If The Opal feels like the right fit — whether as your family’s next home or a considered coastal investment — the best next step is to see the detail for yourself. We can share the latest brochure, floor plans, price list, and payment schedule, and arrange a site visit or a remote walkthrough at a time that suits you.

Speak to Loyd at Block Real Estate: 📧 loyd@block.ke 📞 0725 937 686

Ubora Living is an off-plan development of over 300 one and two-bedroom apartments at the junction of Ring Road and General Mathenge, Westlands, Nairobi, priced from KES 10,100,000. The one-bedroom starts at about 713 sq ft (66 sqm). A rooftop swimming pool, sauna, gym, clubhouse and hotel-style management serve the building, completing May 2028.

Listing updated: 10 August 2026 · Verified by Block Real Estate

Development at a Glance

Set at the junction of Ring Road and General Mathenge in Westlands, Ubora Living introduces a premium residential address designed for buyers who want the convenience of city living, the comfort of modern amenities, and the investment strength of one of Nairobi’s most active rental markets.

This is a development shaped for both the discerning homeowner and the smart investor. With over 300 elegantly designed units set on approximately 0.5 hectares, Ubora Living brings together urban accessibility, hotel-style services, and a lifestyle experience that feels calm, polished, and easy to live in.

For investors, the development is positioned around strong rental demand, professional management, and developer-projected yields ranging from 10% to 18% depending on unit type and rental strategy. For homeowners, it offers a well-connected Westlands address with the security, comfort, and convenience expected from a modern urban residence.

Project Snapshot

Location: Junction of Ring Road and General Mathenge, Westlands, Nairobi
Residence Types: 1 Bedroom and 2 Bedroom Apartments
Development Size: Approximately 0.5 hectares
Number of Units: Over 300 units
1 Bedroom Size: From approximately 713 sq ft (about 66 sqm)
Price From: KES 10,100,000
Project Status: Off-plan / Under construction
Expected Completion: May 2028
Payment Plan: Flexible payment plan linked to construction milestones
Estimated Service Charge: From approximately KES 5,000 per month for selected units
Projected Rental Yield: Developer-projected 10% to 18%, subject to unit type, furnishing, occupancy, management costs, and market conditions
Best Suited For: Investors, corporate rental buyers, diaspora buyers, professionals, and homeowners seeking a prime Westlands address

A Haven Within the Urban Energy of Westlands

Ubora Living has been designed as a refined retreat within one of Nairobi’s busiest and most connected neighborhoods. Westlands is known for its corporate offices, malls, restaurants, nightlife, medical facilities, international schools, and road connectivity, making it one of the city’s most reliable locations for both living and investment.

The development responds to that setting with a residential experience that feels calm, serviced, and secure. It is not simply about placing apartments in a prime area. It is about creating a home where residents can move easily, live comfortably, and access the kind of lifestyle services that make urban living more effortless.

For buyers who want to live in Westlands, this means convenience without compromise. For investors, it means a product that fits the needs of corporate tenants, expatriates, professionals, business travelers, and long-stay occupants.

Available Apartment Types at Ubora Living

Ubora Living offers a focused mix of 1 and 2 bedroom apartments, designed to suit both homeowners and investors looking for efficient, high-demand urban units.

1 Bedroom Apartments

The 1 bedroom apartments start from approximately 713 sq ft (about 66 sqm) and are positioned for professionals, frequent travelers, corporate tenants, and investors targeting manageable, high-demand rental units in Westlands.

This category is especially attractive for buyers looking for a lower-maintenance investment, a lock-and-leave Nairobi base, or a compact city home in a prime location. Developer projections indicate possible annual rental yields of approximately 10% to 12% for selected 1 bedroom units, subject to market performance and cost assumptions.

2 Bedroom Apartments

The 2 bedroom apartments are designed for buyers who want more flexibility, broader tenant appeal, and stronger income potential. This typology can work well for young families, shared professional living, corporate tenants, expatriates, and long-stay residents who want more space within Westlands. The 2 bedroom floor area is not published on this listing — request the floor plans and unit schedule.

Developer projections indicate possible annual rental yields of approximately 14% to 18% for selected 2 bedroom units, subject to occupancy, furnishing quality, management costs, service charges, and prevailing rental rates at the time of completion.

The Ubora Investment Advantage

Ubora Living is positioned as an investor-focused development in a high-demand Westlands corridor. Its location at the junction of Ring Road and General Mathenge places it close to corporate offices, embassies, shopping hubs, restaurants, healthcare facilities, and major transport routes.

This combination gives the development a strong rental story. Tenants in this part of Westlands often prioritize location, convenience, security, building services, and access to amenities. Ubora Living is designed around those priorities.

Key Investment Strengths

  • Prime Westlands location at Ring Road and General Mathenge
  • Easy access to the CBD and Nairobi Expressway
  • Strong appeal to corporate tenants, expatriates, and professionals
  • Hotel-style services and professional property management
  • Lifestyle amenities that support premium tenant appeal
  • Flexible payment plan linked to construction milestones
  • Developer-projected rental yields of 10% to 18% depending on unit type
  • Off-plan purchase structure with potential for capital appreciation before completion

The investment appeal is strong, but buyers should evaluate projected returns carefully. Before purchasing, request current rental comparables, furnishing budgets, service charge estimates, management fees, expected occupancy assumptions, tax considerations, and the developer’s full rental projection model.

Professional Management and Hotel-Style Living

One of the strongest features of Ubora Living is its focus on managed, hotel-style residential living. This is especially important for investors who want a more hands-off ownership experience.

Professional property and tenancy management can help support tenant acquisition, rent collection, maintenance coordination, service standards, and resident experience. For tenants, this creates convenience. For investors, it can reduce day-to-day involvement and help maintain a consistent standard across the building.

This kind of structure is particularly attractive for diaspora buyers, busy professionals, and investors who want income potential without personally managing every operational detail.

Amenities at Ubora Living

Ubora Living has been designed with a complete lifestyle offering that supports wellness, leisure, family living, security, and everyday convenience.

Wellness and Leisure

  • Modern gym
  • Rooftop swimming pool
  • Sauna
  • Rooftop terraces
  • Clubhouse

Family and Community Spaces

  • Kids’ play area
  • Clubhouse and shared social spaces
  • Resident leisure areas

Security and Utilities

  • 24/7 security
  • Electric fence
  • 24-hour CCTV surveillance
  • Borehole water supply
  • Backup generator
  • Ample parking

Hotel-Style Services

  • Professional property management
  • Tenancy management
  • Concierge-style support
  • Maintenance coordination
  • Resident service support

These amenities help position the development strongly for both residents and tenants. For homeowners, they improve daily comfort. For investors, they strengthen the property’s rental appeal in a competitive Westlands market.

Location Advantage: Ring Road and General Mathenge

Ubora Living’s location is one of its most important strengths. Sitting at the junction of Ring Road and General Mathenge, the development places residents at the center of a highly connected Westlands address.

From this location, residents can access the Westlands commercial district, Sarit Centre, Westgate Mall, restaurants, entertainment spots, medical facilities, schools, and major road networks with ease. The development also benefits from access to the Nairobi Expressway, improving movement toward the CBD, Upper Hill, JKIA, and other parts of the city.

For tenants, this level of connectivity is highly attractive. For homeowners, it makes daily movement easier. For investors, it supports demand from people who want a residence close to work, lifestyle, and transport.

Why Ubora Living Works for Homebuyers

For homeowners, Ubora Living offers a practical and polished way to live in Westlands. The development combines a central location with amenities, security, backup utilities, and managed services that support a more convenient urban lifestyle.

It is well suited for buyers who want:

  • A prime Westlands address
  • A lock-and-leave Nairobi home
  • Modern amenities within the building
  • Easy access to malls, offices, and major roads
  • A secure residence with backup power and water
  • A home that feels serviced and easy to manage

The development’s appeal lies in how it simplifies city living. It gives residents access to the best of Westlands while offering the comfort of a well-managed residential environment.

Why Ubora Living Works for Investors

For investors, Ubora Living is designed around income potential, tenant appeal, and ease of management. The combination of location, hotel-style services, amenities, and professional property management gives the development a strong investment narrative.

The 1 bedroom apartments may appeal to single professionals, consultants, expatriates, and short-to-medium stay tenants. The 2 bedroom apartments may appeal to corporate tenants, small families, shared professional living, and long-stay occupants who want more space.

Developer projections indicate possible rental yields ranging from 10% to 18%, depending on unit type and assumptions. These figures should be treated as projections, not guaranteed returns. Buyers should verify the numbers using current market rents, expected occupancy, furnishing costs, service charges, management fees, taxes, and maintenance costs.

Payment Plan

Ubora Living offers a flexible payment plan linked to construction milestones. This allows buyers to secure a unit early and manage payments progressively as the project develops.

Buyers should request the latest payment schedule, reservation terms, construction milestone structure, sales agreement, unit availability, and price list before making a commitment.

This payment approach may be suitable for buyers who want to enter the Westlands market without paying the full purchase price upfront.

Finishes and Specifications

Ubora Living is positioned as a premium residential tower with modern apartments, quality finishes, hotel-style services, and lifestyle amenities.

Specific details on finishes, fitted appliances, flooring, cabinetry, sanitaryware, parking allocation, service charges, furnishing packages, and management arrangements should be confirmed at the point of enquiry.

Buyers should request the latest brochure, floor plans, finish schedule, payment plan, service charge estimate, and rental projection model before reserving a unit.

Investment Considerations

If purchasing Ubora Living for rental income, buyers should evaluate the opportunity with a clear view of both income and operating costs.

Key items to verify include:

  • Current rental comparables in Westlands
  • Expected rent for the chosen unit type
  • Occupancy assumptions
  • Furnishing costs
  • Monthly service charge
  • Property management fees
  • Maintenance costs
  • Taxes and statutory obligations
  • Short-let or long-let policy
  • Tenant management structure
  • Exit strategy and resale potential

This ensures that the investment decision is based on realistic numbers, not just headline yield projections.

Who This Development Suits Best

Ubora Living is ideal for:

  • Investors targeting rental income in Westlands
  • Diaspora buyers seeking a managed Nairobi investment
  • Professionals looking for a prime city residence
  • Corporate rental buyers
  • Buyers seeking hotel-style living
  • Homeowners who want convenience, security, and amenities
  • Investors looking for 1 and 2 bedroom units in a high-demand rental corridor
  • Buyers who value accessibility to the CBD, Expressway, malls, offices, and lifestyle destinations

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does an apartment at Ubora Living cost?

Ubora Living is listed from KES 10,100,000. That is a development-wide from price; the price for each unit type is not published on this listing, so request the current price list and unit schedule from Block Real Estate before reserving.

What apartment types and sizes are available at Ubora Living?

The development offers 1 bedroom and 2 bedroom apartments across over 300 units on approximately 0.5 hectares. The 1 bedroom starts from approximately 713 sq ft, about 66 sqm. The 2 bedroom floor area is not published on this listing, so request the floor plans.

Where is Ubora Living located?

Ubora Living is at the junction of Ring Road and General Mathenge in Westlands, Nairobi, close to the Westlands commercial district, Sarit Centre, Westgate Mall, medical facilities and schools, with access to the Nairobi Expressway toward the CBD, Upper Hill and JKIA.

Can I buy from abroad?

Yes. Ubora Living suits diaspora buyers seeking a managed Nairobi investment, because professional property and tenancy management is built into the development. Block Real Estate can send the brochure, floor plans and price list, arrange a virtual site visit, confirm availability and coordinate with your lawyer on payment and transfer. Call or WhatsApp +254 725 937 686 or email loyd@block.ke.

When will Ubora Living be completed?

Completion is expected in May 2028. The development is off-plan and under construction, so confirm the current construction programme with Block Real Estate before committing.

What payment plan is available at Ubora Living?
